sourceFields.name: Moon Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Look at that cheesy grin.

sourceFields.name: Dragon Tail
sourceFields.str_version_22: We warned you to stay away from the toxic waste barrels.

sourceFields.name: Clown Shoes
sourceFields.str_version_22: You want respect, you gotta EARN it. Or wear these shoes. BAM, instant respect.

sourceFields.name: Clown Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: They come complete with suspenders! Which is a good thing, since they're a BIT big.

sourceFields.name: Plain White Tee
sourceFields.str_version_22: Just the basics!

sourceFields.name: Clown Nose
sourceFields.str_version_22: HONK HONK

sourceFields.name: Crazy Purple Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: It's just crazy, man.

sourceFields.name: Foam Finger
sourceFields.str_version_22: If you wear this, then YOU'RE #1! YOU'RE #1! YOU'RE #1!

sourceFields.name: Astronaut Pack
sourceFields.str_version_22: This contains all the essentials you need for a successful extravehicular activity trip, including a book of sudoku. It also makes you jump like you're on the moon.

sourceFields.name: Space Suit
sourceFields.str_version_22: Multiple layers offer protection against cold, vacuum, radiation, and parasitic alien infestation. Of course it's also sleeveless, so....?

sourceFields.name: Space Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: A space suit isn't going to protect you very well if you don't put on the pants too.

sourceFields.name: Moon Boots
sourceFields.str_version_22: It's just one small step for a Growtopian, one giant leap for Growtopia.

sourceFields.name: Astronaut Helmet
sourceFields.str_version_22: Now you can be one of those creepy astronauts with a chrome-plated face, where nobody knows who you are and what you're up to.

sourceFields.name: Zorbnik Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: ZYERBLRB! This little zorbnik will follow you everywhere you go! Mainly because it's tied to your wrist.

sourceFields.name: Vampire Cape
sourceFields.str_version_22: This cape imparts mystical powers upon its wearer.

sourceFields.name: Slick Black Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: You must have a really greasy pillow.

sourceFields.name: Vampire Fangs
sourceFields.str_version_22: Wearing these impedes lip movement just enough to induce a Transylvanian accent.

sourceFields.name: Vamp Vest
sourceFields.str_version_22: Looks like you won the gold medal in bloodsucking!

sourceFields.name: Aimster's Nightmare
sourceFields.str_version_22: Shouldn't this belong to INightmareI?

sourceFields.name: Skeletal Horsie
sourceFields.str_version_22: Did you forget to feed your horse again?

sourceFields.name: Spiritual Resonator
sourceFields.str_version_22: This miraculous device allows you to commune with spirits from the Other Side.

sourceFields.name: Hockey Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Surely you're just a big sports fan... right?  Right?

sourceFields.name: Mummy Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: It's hard to speak through these bandages!

sourceFields.name: Skull Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: You're bad to the bone.

sourceFields.name: Wolfman Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: The fun bonus is that you can take this off, and then you're wearing your "daytime wolfman mask".  It's almost 2 masks in one!

sourceFields.name: Black Cat Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: Mrow! The bad thing about wearing this leash is that you end up with a black cat constantly crossing your path.

sourceFields.name: Creepy Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: Your hair's such a mess, you look like you just stepped out of a TV.

sourceFields.name: Focused Eyes
sourceFields.str_version_22: These eyes are a bit shocking.

sourceFields.name: Devil Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: You don't jump higher than with normal wings, but man, you do look pretty cool.

sourceFields.name: Familiar Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: Mrow HISS! This black cat contains the very essence of dark magic. Unfortunately, it's a cat, so you can't get it to use the magic for you.

sourceFields.name: Cultist Hood
sourceFields.str_version_22: You look a little shady in this thing...

sourceFields.name: Cultist Robe
sourceFields.str_version_22: Just the thing to worship Growganoth in!

sourceFields.name: Green Dragon Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Greenswe is indecisive, but stylish.

sourceFields.name: Frankenhair
sourceFields.str_version_22: Did you stick your finger in a light socket?

sourceFields.name: Sonar Bracelet
sourceFields.str_version_22: Meep meep! This bracelet attracts bats. Well, A bat.

sourceFields.name: Scrub Cap
sourceFields.str_version_22: Keep your hair out of your eyes while performing surgery with this sterile cap.

sourceFields.name: Scrub Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Stop spreading your germs around!

sourceFields.name: Scrub Top
sourceFields.str_version_22: Special sterilized clothes, for chopping folks up!

sourceFields.name: Scrub Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: Even your knees need to be kept sterile when you are operating.

sourceFields.name: Bride Of Reanimator Remote
sourceFields.str_version_22: Its wife is ALLLLIIVVVVEEE!!!

sourceFields.name: Magnifying Glass
sourceFields.str_version_22: This has over 10,000,000x magnification, allowing you to clearly see the virus that is ... wait, is that virus following you around? RUN!

sourceFields.name: Retro Magnifying Glass
sourceFields.str_version_22: This has over 10,000,000x magnification, allowing you to clearly see the retrovirus that is totally grooving on your vibes.

sourceFields.name: Ambulance
sourceFields.str_version_22: For the sake of your fellow Growtopians, we limited the siren. But you can still enjoy the flashing lights!

sourceFields.name: Edison Zoomster
sourceFields.str_version_22: Only the chief of surgery can afford a speedy electric car like this!

sourceFields.name: Candy Striper Cap
sourceFields.str_version_22: Red wig included. And stapled on.

sourceFields.name: Candy Striper Uniform
sourceFields.str_version_22: I wonder where on earth this nurse's uniform gets its name from...

sourceFields.name: Candy Striper Skirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: This is also nice if you want to work at the kind of burger restaurant that requires Pieces of Flair from its wait staff.

sourceFields.name: Bushy Beard
sourceFields.str_version_22: You look like you should be in charge of magical animals with this beard.

sourceFields.name: Ponytail
sourceFields.str_version_22: Unlike an actual pony, your tail grows out of the back of your head.

sourceFields.name: Happy Sun Shirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: Take joy in the great glowing orb that provides energy for all those toilet trees to grow!

sourceFields.name: Blue Sun Shirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: "Well, what you plan and what takes place ain't ever exactly been similar."

sourceFields.name: Riding Raptor
sourceFields.str_version_22: I know, they're supposed to have feathers and stuff nowadays... Well, this is an old-school raptor!

sourceFields.name: Caveman Club
sourceFields.str_version_22: We've come a long way in methods of settling disputes, but this technique still works.

sourceFields.name: Sabertooth-Skin Toga
sourceFields.str_version_22: Clothing so stylish it'll make you shout "Rabble Dabble Goo!" - you know, to make sure you don't get sued.

sourceFields.name: Caveman Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: The chicken grease helps the bone stay in, and it adds luster.

sourceFields.name: Sabertooth Growtopian
sourceFields.str_version_22: I think you've gone feral.

sourceFields.name: Cavewoman Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: The chicken grease helps the bone stay in, and it adds luster.

sourceFields.name: Fuzzy Bikini Top
sourceFields.str_version_22: Is it for cold weather or warm weather? Who knows! It's the world's smallest parka.

sourceFields.name: Fuzzy Bikini Bottom
sourceFields.str_version_22: It's kind of itchy.

sourceFields.name: Mini Mammoth Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: The word "mammoth" has really lost all meaning at this point.

sourceFields.name: Yeonnalligi
sourceFields.str_version_22: Fly this colorful kite to ring in the new year!

sourceFields.name: Ice Dragon Hand
sourceFields.str_version_22: Another of the `4Dragons of Legend``! Please be aware the legends may have been a bit exaggerated.

sourceFields.name: Elf Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Hey hey hey!

sourceFields.name: Antler Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: The red checkers alert other hunters not to shoot you, but the antlers make you a prime target. We've scientifically designed this hat to ensure that your odds of being shot remain precisely the same as if you weren't wearing it. Note: `4Wearing this also makes guns and bows kill you!``

sourceFields.name: Glowing Nose
sourceFields.str_version_22: Warning: wearing this could result in exclusion from reindeer games.

sourceFields.name: Buckskin Hood
sourceFields.str_version_22: So warm and toasty! It's like you sliced open a deer and crawled inside.

sourceFields.name: Buckskin Jacket
sourceFields.str_version_22: So warm and toasty! It's like you sliced open a deer and crawled inside.

sourceFields.name: Buckskin Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: So warm and toasty! It's like you sliced open a deer and crawled inside.

sourceFields.name: Polar Bear Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: If you look out your window and see this guy, you are looking south. Or at a zoo. Or at somebody playing Growtopia.

sourceFields.name: Mini Growtopian
sourceFields.str_version_22: Ah, he just wants to tag along!

sourceFields.name: Party Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: PARTY DOWN!!!!

sourceFields.name: Party Vest
sourceFields.str_version_22: PARTY DOWN!!!!

sourceFields.name: Party Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: PARTY DOWN!!!!

sourceFields.name: Party Horn
sourceFields.str_version_22: PBBBBBLLLLTTTT DOWN!!!!

sourceFields.name: Party Socks
sourceFields.str_version_22: PARTY DOWN!!!!

sourceFields.name: Party Glasses
sourceFields.str_version_22: PARTY DOWN!!!!

sourceFields.name: Golden Pickaxe
sourceFields.str_version_22: This tool, made to honor Diichaan's service as a moderator, is worth more than the stuff you mine with it!

sourceFields.name: Evil Space Helmet
sourceFields.str_version_22: Found in a teeny-tiny spaceship, this helmet is surprisingly normal-sized. What brave star traveler could have worn this?

sourceFields.name: Burning Face
sourceFields.str_version_22: Styx has a burning sensation.

sourceFields.name: Frosty Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: Brr! This shivering style is only for the coldest of the cold. Whoever created it must have been a chilly soul indeed - where could they be now?

sourceFields.name: Meaty Apron
sourceFields.str_version_22: Kiss the cook!

sourceFields.name: Gold Chain
sourceFields.str_version_22: I pity the fool who doesn't wear a set of these.

sourceFields.name: Golden Angel Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Better than a Halo, these will actually let you double jump! Plus they're shiny!

sourceFields.name: Golden Diaper
sourceFields.str_version_22: If you find yourself lost in a world without any Toilet Seeds, you'll be glad you have this. Plus it's shiny!

sourceFields.name: Golden Heartbow
sourceFields.str_version_22: Once used by Cupid himself, this bow shoots golden hearts! You can yank other players toward you with it. Plus it's shiny!

sourceFields.name: Golden Diamond Necklace
sourceFields.str_version_22: Sparkles with the undying light of eternal love. Plus it's shiny!

sourceFields.name: Emerald Necklace
sourceFields.str_version_22: Emeralds are May's birthstone. This particular one is lab-created, which you'd think is less classy, but they're much prettier.

sourceFields.name: Ruby Necklace
sourceFields.str_version_22: It's a red rock on a metal string. But I guess people like that!

sourceFields.name: Ducky Pajama Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: There's ducks on these pants!!!

sourceFields.name: Ducky Pajama Top
sourceFields.str_version_22: There's ducks on this shirt!!!

sourceFields.name: Atomic Shadow Scythe
sourceFields.str_version_22: So sharp it can slice atoms, this scythe is part shadow and all malice. The first person to wield it must have been very, very evil.

sourceFields.name: Rushboard
sourceFields.str_version_22: Just like they predicted, we finally have hoverboards in 2014! Well, virtual ones.

sourceFields.name: Winter Scarf
sourceFields.str_version_22: This scarf is made of fuzzy aquamarine yarn with little sparklies in it. It's tres chic.

sourceFields.name: Old-Timey Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: If you're a grizzled old prospector, this is surely the hat for you. Also useful for hard-boiled reporters who always get their story.

sourceFields.name: Medical Scarf
sourceFields.str_version_22: These elaborate scarves may only be worn by medical professionals (or anyone else with the title "Doctor").

sourceFields.name: Pet Leprechaun
sourceFields.str_version_22: He's hidden a pot of gold somewhere... but you'll never find it!

sourceFields.name: Black-Rimmed Glasses
sourceFields.str_version_22: These stylish glasses can be custom matched to any prescription.

sourceFields.name: Diving Bell
sourceFields.str_version_22: Protect yourself from the crushing pressures of the great deep in this steel helmet. Of course, if you wear a normal wetsuit, you could end up sucked up into the helmet and crushed to death. So, you know, watch for that.

sourceFields.name: Wetsuit Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: Lay off the donuts, because these things are skin-tight!

sourceFields.name: Wetsuit Top
sourceFields.str_version_22: Lay off the donuts, because this thing is skin-tight!

sourceFields.name: Cuddly Piranha
sourceFields.str_version_22: He just won't stay in his bowl because he LIKES YOU. This is one fish you'll never forget to feed!

sourceFields.name: Mid-Pacific Owl
sourceFields.str_version_22: This friendly pet owl will fall asleep on your head if you don't keep him entertained! Dedicated to the students of the Mid-Pacific Institute.

sourceFields.name: Battle Trout
sourceFields.str_version_22: Why, it's a dead fish. And you're holding it. Oooookayyyy.

sourceFields.name: Green Bowtie
sourceFields.str_version_22: Bowties are cool.

sourceFields.name: Green Pageboy
sourceFields.str_version_22: This is NOT a helmet, don't call it a helmet! But if you want to use it as a helmet, go ahead. It's hair though.

sourceFields.name: Easter Bonnet
sourceFields.str_version_22: This fashionable accessory matches ANY outfit with style.

sourceFields.name: Bubble Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: With a pair of wings, you can double-jump! With these wings, you can also bubble.

sourceFields.name: Pet Bunny
sourceFields.str_version_22: bunny bunny bunny bunny bunny bunny

sourceFields.name: Lucky Pinata Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Not only is this hat festive and suitable for formal occasions, but wearing it when you break an Ultra Pinata will reward you with a personal gift from The Great Burro!

sourceFields.name: Mariachi Guitar
sourceFields.str_version_22: When you /dance with this, you can perform for your friends!

sourceFields.name: Parrot Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Polly want a double jump?

sourceFields.name: Fiesta Dragon
sourceFields.str_version_22: This ferocious beast spews deadly PARTY at your enemies.

sourceFields.name: Pink Cadillac
sourceFields.str_version_22: There's nothing quite like cruising the Vegas strip in a pink Cadillac!

sourceFields.name: Pet Burrito
sourceFields.str_version_22: So fuzzy! This is not to be eaten.

sourceFields.name: Clapboard
sourceFields.str_version_22: The loud clacking sound this can produce is useful for syncing up audio with video. We've silenced this particular one for the sake of the other players.

sourceFields.name: 3D Glasses
sourceFields.str_version_22: It's like Growtopia is COMING RIGHT AT YOU!

sourceFields.name: Black Beret
sourceFields.str_version_22: Nobody understands your genius.

sourceFields.name: Unicorn Horn
sourceFields.str_version_22: This pretty much rules out the possibility of hats, but it's so glowy!

sourceFields.name: Horse Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: These things are just creepy. I don't get the appeal.

sourceFields.name: Unicorn Jumper
sourceFields.str_version_22: A gift from your friendly neighborhood unicorn!

sourceFields.name: Unicorn Garland
sourceFields.str_version_22: This magical garland from the mystic land of Unicornopianialandburg joins your soul with that of a unicorn. Great for you, but for the unicorn it's pretty much slavery. Not cool, dude.

sourceFields.name: Pink Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: Oh, is that your natural color?

sourceFields.name: Aqua Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: It takes a liberal dose of Aqua Net to make it look like this.

sourceFields.name: Sea Monster Floatie
sourceFields.str_version_22: Blow it up and take a swim!

sourceFields.name: Water Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Not a strong swimmer? Strap these on so at least your arms will stay above water as you drown.

sourceFields.name: Summer Kite
sourceFields.str_version_22: Fly this colorful kite to celebrate summertime!

sourceFields.name: Rainbow Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Somewhere over the rainbow is a Growtopian, flapping away. These let you double jump. Sponsored by Oricho and Oriche.

sourceFields.name: Phoenix Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Is it hot in here, or is it just you? These wings let you double jump, and there are only 500 of them in existence! Don't throw them away!

sourceFields.name: Squirt Gun
sourceFields.str_version_22: Squirt your friends with this usually harmless weapon! Or load it with hydrochloric acid and use it to dissolve metal, it works equally well. Longer range than normal punches, but less damage.

sourceFields.name: Pith Helmet
sourceFields.str_version_22: Dr. Koop, I presume?

sourceFields.name: Safari Jacket
sourceFields.str_version_22: The comfortable fit you need to run away from giant rolling boulders.

sourceFields.name: Jodhpurs
sourceFields.str_version_22: Does these pants make my butt look fat?

sourceFields.name: Adventuring Mustache
sourceFields.str_version_22: Wot wot too right tally ho jolly good ermf ermf

sourceFields.name: Explorer's Ponytail
sourceFields.str_version_22: This sensible hairstyle minimizes the number of cobwebs that stick to you when exploring ancient tombs. The glasses also help you avoid them in the first place.

sourceFields.name: Explorer's Shovel
sourceFields.str_version_22: This is not a whole lot different from a garden shovel, but holding it makes you feel adventurous. It also lets you dig faster than you can by punching dirt. I still don't get why punching dirt works at all.

sourceFields.name: Keytar
sourceFields.str_version_22: You can't punch when holding this, you're too busy ROCKING! Punch anywhere to play music. If you punch to your left or right, you can bend the note higher or lower. Punch in your own column to play the same notes that Sheet Music: Piano Note plays.

sourceFields.name: Bass Guitar
sourceFields.str_version_22: You can't punch when holding this, you're too busy ROCKING! Punch anywhere to play music. If you punch to your left or right, you can bend the note higher or lower. Punch in your own column to play the same notes that Sheet Music: Bass Note plays.

sourceFields.name: Tambourine
sourceFields.str_version_22: You can't punch when holding this, you're too busy ROCKING! Punch anywhere to play drums. If you punch to your left or right, you can play different drums. Punch in your own column to play the same drums that Sheet Music: Drums plays.

sourceFields.name: Flat-top
sourceFields.str_version_22: Keep that haircut regulation, soldier!

sourceFields.name: Starchild Makeup
sourceFields.str_version_22: You came down from a distant planet, to conquer the Earth with the power of ROCK.

sourceFields.name: Shredded T-Shirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: This shirt isn't ruined, it's COOL.

sourceFields.name: Leopard Leggings
sourceFields.str_version_22: These are the easiest pants to do leaping splits in, if that happens to be important to you. I mean, you might as well jump. Go ahead and jump.

sourceFields.name: Rockin' Headband
sourceFields.str_version_22: When you rock, you sweat. Soak it up!

sourceFields.name: Kuma-boshi
sourceFields.str_version_22: Akiko's extra special hat.

sourceFields.name: Knight Helmet
sourceFields.str_version_22: This helmet was forged by the awesome art god Hamumu. Sponsored by Knightmare.

sourceFields.name: Crystal Cape
sourceFields.str_version_22: Though less flexible than your average cape, this is a whole lot sparklier. Allows you to double jump off of an imaginary Crystal Block. Sponsored by Edvoid20, HemeTems, and Aboge.

sourceFields.name: StarBoard
sourceFields.str_version_22: Just like they predicted, we finally have hoverboards in 2014! Well, virtual ones. Sponsored by Miwsky, Chudy, and Dawid.

sourceFields.name: Puppy Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: Berf! This little puppy is modeled after Hamumu's dog Mia, and can also be found in the fabulous smash hit Flash game Mia's Happy Day! Go play it!

sourceFields.name: Fuel Pack
sourceFields.str_version_22: This backpack contains volatile fuels you can use to power a flamethrower!

sourceFields.name: Flamethrower
sourceFields.str_version_22: The deadliest weapon in Growtopia! The downside is that you need to wear a Fuel Pack to use it, and it uses up 1 Fuel Pack for every single punch. KILL IT WITH FIRE!

sourceFields.name: Growboard
sourceFields.str_version_22: Just like they predicted, we finally have hoverboards in 2014! Well, virtual ones. This one spits fire. Sponsored by Coinman, iOliver, and Legomanz.

sourceFields.name: Spiritfire Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: For the less technologically-inclined, this mask relies on black magic to raise an evil spirit.

sourceFields.name: Soda Jetpack
sourceFields.str_version_22: Use the power of carbonation to leap tall buildings in a single bound, and then drift gently to Earth. Comes with a lifetime supply of soda, connected via wormhole for continuous refueling.

sourceFields.name: Dominatus Moderateus
sourceFields.str_version_22: Could there be more than one cult in Growtopia? Sponsored by Moderate.

sourceFields.name: Pacifier
sourceFields.str_version_22: Oh, grow up.

sourceFields.name: Legendbot-009
sourceFields.str_version_22: This legendary battle armor was the turning point in the war of Growtopia Valley.

sourceFields.name: Dragon of Legend
sourceFields.str_version_22: This blade calls forth the Ancient Dragon of Unexaggerated Legends and binds it to your command. It's a biggun'.

sourceFields.name: Legendary Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Turns out you had to do a lot more than ring a bell to get these suckers.

sourceFields.name: Minotaur Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: MOOOOooooooo.

sourceFields.name: Muscle Suit
sourceFields.str_version_22: It's faster than exercise!

sourceFields.name: Zeus' Lightning Bolt
sourceFields.str_version_22: It's 1.21 gigawatts in the palm of your hand!  Sponsored by Dodoman11, Hercule, and the RTSoft Forumers.

sourceFields.name: Chinese Dragon Head
sourceFields.str_version_22: You're lucky, you get to be the head!

sourceFields.name: Chinese Dragon Body
sourceFields.str_version_22: This really adds a lot of body to your hair.

sourceFields.name: Chinese Dragon Tail
sourceFields.str_version_22: Looks like you got stuck with the tail end. Again.

sourceFields.name: Ssireum Shorts - Red
sourceFields.str_version_22: Wear these shorts when you are wrestling! If you play in a Game Pack game, your shorts will change color to match your team.

sourceFields.name: Ssireum Shorts - Blue
sourceFields.str_version_22: Wear these shorts when you are wrestling! If you play in a Game Pack game, your shorts will change color to match your team.

sourceFields.name: Ssireum Shorts - Yellow
sourceFields.str_version_22: Wear these shorts when you are wrestling! If you play in a Game Pack game, your shorts will change color to match your team.

sourceFields.name: Ssireum Shorts - Purple
sourceFields.str_version_22: Wear these shorts when you are wrestling! If you play in a Game Pack game, your shorts will change color to match your team.

sourceFields.name: Ssireum Shorts - Grey
sourceFields.str_version_22: Wear these shorts when you are wrestling! If you play in a Game Pack game, your shorts will change color to match your team.

sourceFields.name: Golden Air Robinsons
sourceFields.str_version_22: These sporty shoes are coated with a layer of pure sparkling gold. Sponsored by Kubeti and Rooted.

sourceFields.name: Autumn Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: A leaf falls on a still pond. These wings let you double jump, and contain an endless supply of dried leaves for some reason!

sourceFields.name: Harvester
sourceFields.str_version_22: This advanced harvesting machine will chop down trees as it runs them over. If you wear a Fuel Pack, it has a 10 chance of harvesting double fruit from each tree below rarity 100! This burns up one Fuel Pack.

sourceFields.name: Diamond Flashaxe
sourceFields.str_version_22: I'm not sure why you're bothering to mine stuff when you already have an entire pickaxe made of diamonds, but at least you know this is harder than whatever you want to mine! Sponsored by Kloe, PartyFrog, and xShaDo.

sourceFields.name: Hot Pink Highlights
sourceFields.str_version_22: You got style.

sourceFields.name: Long Black Bangs
sourceFields.str_version_22: This is the hair for people with flawed foreheads.

sourceFields.name: Pink Pageboy
sourceFields.str_version_22: This is NOT a helmet, don't call it a helmet! But if you want to use it as a helmet, go ahead. It's hair though.

sourceFields.name: Long Blonde Bangs
sourceFields.str_version_22: Cover your forehead and shoulders in one fell swoop!

sourceFields.name: Messy Auburn Tresses
sourceFields.str_version_22: It's messy and it's red, what more could you want from hair?

sourceFields.name: Growbans
sourceFields.str_version_22: These are some fierce designer sunglasses!

sourceFields.name: Pink Hair Bow
sourceFields.str_version_22: You're like Ms. Pac-Man without the eating disorder!

sourceFields.name: Butterfly Hair Pin
sourceFields.str_version_22: It looks like a real butterfly! A real robot butterfly.

sourceFields.name: Bee Hair Pin
sourceFields.str_version_22: Psst, I think there's a bee in your hair...

sourceFields.name: Simple Purple Dress
sourceFields.str_version_22: Sometimes simpler is better!

sourceFields.name: Red Sun Dress
sourceFields.str_version_22: It looks like a whole galaxy of suns.

sourceFields.name: Blue Skirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: This skirt is long, and thus classy.

sourceFields.name: Checkered Dress
sourceFields.str_version_22: You are now the referee of fashion.

sourceFields.name: Cardboard Box
sourceFields.str_version_22: The ultimate in stealth technology. Sponsored by JakeShore, ADMex1, and bankai.

sourceFields.name: Violet Protodrake Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: Congratulations on completing all the holiday achievements!  Have a dragon!

sourceFields.name: Ring Of Force
sourceFields.str_version_22: This ring replaces your punch with a devastating blast of energy that can shatter nearby blocks!

sourceFields.name: Ring Of Winds
sourceFields.str_version_22: This ring floats you on a cloud. Hold the jump button while falling to glide safely down to earth.

sourceFields.name: Lion Taming Whip
sourceFields.str_version_22: This is a cruel way to get somebody to do what you want. Keep it in video games only!

sourceFields.name: The One Ring
sourceFields.str_version_22: This ring is your precious, and if you had pocketses you'd put the ring in them for safekeeping.

sourceFields.name: Ringmaster Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: This top hat is a bit rumpled, but it still has a certain rustic panache.

sourceFields.name: Ringmaster Suit
sourceFields.str_version_22: The classic burgundy suit - the essence of style.

sourceFields.name: Fistful Of Rings
sourceFields.str_version_22: None of these rings have any magical powers, but there sure are a lot of them!

sourceFields.name: Orbs Of Elixir
sourceFields.str_version_22: These orbs contain a dark elixir said to be the blood of Growganoth... but it's probably just grape juice. Sponsored by Cukuzz and PikaPi.

sourceFields.name: Platinum Blonde Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: On average, blondes tend to have more fun, but live 20% shorter lives. That sounds like science, but luckily it's not!

sourceFields.name: Electric Bow
sourceFields.str_version_22: This crossbow is mounted to a glove, so nobody can steal it from you. It shoots electric bolts! Why not?  Sponsored by iNoodles.

sourceFields.name: Golden Aura
sourceFields.str_version_22: You are burning with furious energy! And double-jump power. Sponsored by Palestinian, Signle, StardusJr.

sourceFields.name: Pineapple Head
sourceFields.str_version_22: Here's a useful tip: if you find a pineapple big enough, you can hollow it out and jam it on your head! Wait a minute, that's not useful at all.

sourceFields.name: Fruity Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Similar to the classic Beer Hat, this hat presents you with a movable feast! You'll never go hungry with this on. Note: fruit is made of wax.

sourceFields.name: Hawaiian Shirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: This stylish classic is adorned with pineapples and tropical flowers. Suitable for any pineapple occasion.

sourceFields.name: Pineapple Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: Though hard to distinguish from Clay Brick Pants by appearance, the key here is in the soft, squishy, juicy lining. Yeah, they're kinda gross to wear.

sourceFields.name: Pineapple Launcher
sourceFields.str_version_22: This pistol provides the power to pelt people with perilously pointy pineapples.

sourceFields.name: Demonic Arm
sourceFields.str_version_22: It got into your arm and it went bad, so you have to lop it off at the shoulder. Sponsored by Edvoid20, SpamG, CrimsonSwag.

sourceFields.name: The Gungnir
sourceFields.str_version_22: The legendary spear of Odin is yours! Sponsored by ZeroRarity, CoffeeGuy, and xAzureHKF.

sourceFields.name: Pineapple Juice
sourceFields.str_version_22: This backpack contains pineapple juice you can use to power a flamethrower or Harvester!

sourceFields.name: Pineapple Earrings

sourceFields.name: Pineapple Kite

sourceFields.name: Super Logo - Pineapple
sourceFields.str_version_22: Emblazon this logo on your super costume to fight crime as... Power Pineapple? Tropicanus? Dr. Pineapple? It's up to you!

sourceFields.name: Penguin Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: Waddle waddle. Sponsored by TypoPig and IcyMeltz.

sourceFields.name: Poseidon's Trident
sourceFields.str_version_22: This trident has been blessed by Poseidon, God of the seas. The glowy blue signifies all of the servants who served under Poseidon in his battles. What Poseidon left along with this trident is unknown - that's for you to figure out. Sponsored by mythicdawn and angel42.

sourceFields.name: Phoenix Pacifier
sourceFields.str_version_22: Aww, so cute you just wanna snuggle him all day! But you should really pace yourself on that, with a trip to the burn ward in between each snuggle. No more than 500 of these little guys exist in all of Growtopia.

sourceFields.name: Wizard's Staff
sourceFields.str_version_22: Congratulations on solving the Wizard's Riddle (or just googling what somebody else figured out). Since you're not legendary enough to obtain an actual Legendary Item, here's a replica of the great Wizard's staff. (Be careful, the winds might hurt you.) Sponsored by Devinn and PonyGarYelow.

sourceFields.name: White Fury
sourceFields.str_version_22: This thoroughbred steed is burning with furious power. Sponsored by Hercule, HERMIUS, and PRONGS.

sourceFields.name: Seafoam Beard
sourceFields.str_version_22: You're looking a little green around the gills.

sourceFields.name: Seafoam Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: You've got that windblown chlorinated surfer look. It either makes you cool or a filthy beach bum. It's a fine line.

sourceFields.name: Oceanic Crown
sourceFields.str_version_22: You are the KING OF THE SEAS!... Is what's written on the tag of this cheap plastic knock-off.

sourceFields.name: BLYoshi's Free Dirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: It's an unlimited supply of free dirt blocks! Unfortunately, it spews them at high velocity so they splatter on impact. Sponsored by BLYoshi.

sourceFields.name: FC Cleats
sourceFields.str_version_22: Every pair of cleats comes with a new high-tech soccer ball capable of returning to you automatically! These cleats come from Funtimes College, the #1 party school on Earth. Sponsored by The Admins of FC.

sourceFields.name: Man U Cleats
sourceFields.str_version_22: Every pair of cleats comes with a new high-tech soccer ball capable of returning to you automatically! These cleats come from Man University, the school for manly men of masculinity.

sourceFields.name: FC Jersey
sourceFields.str_version_22: Represent Funtimes College in this stylish jersey! PARTY ON!

sourceFields.name: Man U Jersey
sourceFields.str_version_22: Represent Man University in this stylish jersey! Hallelujah, it's rainin' men! Notice of non-discrimination: Man University does not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, unless you're not a man. HOO HOO HOO MAN U!

sourceFields.name: Baseball Glove
sourceFields.str_version_22: Hidden inside this glove is a wormhole to a dimension filled with nothing but baseballs. Baseballs and popcorn shrimp. But the wormhole's at the baseball end of the dimension.

sourceFields.name: Pigskin
sourceFields.str_version_22: Don't worry, this isn't actually the skin of a pig. It's plastic. It's an American football! Also known as a hand-egg.  Throw it to somebody!

sourceFields.name: Basketball
sourceFields.str_version_22: Must... keep... dribbling...

sourceFields.name: Monkey On Your Back
sourceFields.str_version_22: This is not a metaphor. Sponsored by SweGamerHD's subscribers, Kizashi, and Inforced.

sourceFields.name: Football Helmet
sourceFields.str_version_22: Keep in mind that while headgear is necessary for dangerous sports, it doesn't eliminate brain damage. Keep your brain safe - play Growtopia instead.

sourceFields.name: Growies Cap
sourceFields.str_version_22: Show your pride in the Growtopia Growies with their cap! Root for the home team!

sourceFields.name: Tennis Racquet
sourceFields.str_version_22: Serve up an ace! Lifetime subscription to Rapidly Biodegradable Tennis Ball Supply is included.

sourceFields.name: Carrot Sword
sourceFields.str_version_22: This carrot is rather sharp. I wouldn't recommend eating, especially if it's a sword or if you're a bunny. Sponsored by MrMehMeh.

sourceFields.name: Emerald Staff
sourceFields.str_version_22: The Orb Of Ajanti is mounted atop this staff, held by a silver hand - just make sure you never touch it with your human hand, or you will be incinerated. Sponsored by SilentRebel, COMBUSTION, and jason747.

sourceFields.name: Fishing Rod
sourceFields.str_version_22: Equip this and then use bait on water next to you to go fishing! All you have to do is wait for a bite, and then punch the fish before it escapes! If you miss, your bait is wasted, so punch fast.

sourceFields.name: Smarty Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: These pants are colorful and tasty! But they do not enhance intelligence in any way.

sourceFields.name: Camo Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: Put these pants on and people will think you're just a floating torso!  With some shoes underneath.

sourceFields.name: Carrot Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: It's the latest fashion! I guess...

sourceFields.name: Golf Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: It's a mystery as to why golfers have to wear ugly pants, but they really do. Have some!

sourceFields.name: Acid-Washed Skinny Jeans
sourceFields.str_version_22: You need skinny legs to put in the skinny jeans, or perhaps just let the acid slim you down a bit.

sourceFields.name: Tiny Red Skirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: YOUNG LADY. You are NOT going out in that skirt. In my day, people couldn't even see our ankles.

sourceFields.name: Flower Sarong
sourceFields.str_version_22: This delicate flower print works both as a swimsuit cover-up, or an elegant skirt for a night on the town.

sourceFields.name: Purple Crystal Skirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: As long as you don't mind clinking as you walk around, this is a beautifully sparkly style.

sourceFields.name: Golden Crystal Skirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: As long as you don't mind clinking as you walk around, this is a beautifully sparkly style.

sourceFields.name: Aqua Crystal Skirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: As long as you don't mind clinking as you walk around, this is a beautifully sparkly style.

sourceFields.name: Digger's Spade
sourceFields.str_version_22: This shovel is very specifically designed for one purpose: to shovel dirt. It is pretty useless at digging anywhere else, but dang if it doesn't rip dirt apart (and Cave Background).

sourceFields.name: Disguise Glasses
sourceFields.str_version_22: Wait a second... WHO ARE YOU!?!? How did you get in here?!

sourceFields.name: Growch Cultist Robe
sourceFields.str_version_22: Just the thing to worship The Growch in!

sourceFields.name: Wedding Dress
sourceFields.str_version_22: You look radiant on this special day!

sourceFields.name: Bridal Veil
sourceFields.str_version_22: Today's modern bride doesn't want to conceal her face, so we've swept the veil aside for you.

sourceFields.name: Ring Of Water
sourceFields.str_version_22: This mystical ring encases you in a bubble, allowing you to swim at high velocity. The cool bubble also protects you from dangerous burns like lava.

sourceFields.name: Spikey Anime Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: The great thing about this hairstyle is you just wake up with it every morning! Sure, some people use a comb to fix that, but you just call it anime!

sourceFields.name: Red Bicycle
sourceFields.str_version_22: It's easy to remember how to ride this - it's just like riding a bike!

sourceFields.name: Cybernetic Eye
sourceFields.str_version_22: We've rebuilt you - better, faster, stronger than before.

sourceFields.name: Jester's Cap
sourceFields.str_version_22: Bring joy to Growtopia in this classically designed headwear!

sourceFields.name: Blanket Cape
sourceFields.str_version_22: If you can't afford a real cape, just fake it with a blanket!

sourceFields.name: Riding War Wolf
sourceFields.str_version_22: It's just like a horse... except you MAY want to avoid kicking it with your heels.

sourceFields.name: Wolf Tamer's Glove
sourceFields.str_version_22: When you stare into a wolf's eyes, you're staring into the untameable heart of nature itself. But you can tame it anyway if you've got the right fashion accessories!

sourceFields.name: Dire Wolf Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: This mask is usually kept in a glass case, with a tiny hammer and a sign that says "Break glass only in case of dire emergency!"

sourceFields.name: E-Z Rod
sourceFields.str_version_22: Equip this and then use bait on water next to you to go fishing! All you have to do is wait for a bite, and then punch the fish before it escapes! If you miss, your bait is wasted, so punch fast. This is a beginner's fishing rod - it keeps fish on the line twice as long as other rods, so it's easy as pie.

sourceFields.name: Licorice Rod
sourceFields.str_version_22: Equip this and then use bait on water next to you to go fishing! All you have to do is wait for a bite, and then punch the fish before it escapes! If you miss, your bait is wasted, so punch fast. This delicious fishing rod gets bites twice as often as other rods.

sourceFields.name: Goldenrod
sourceFields.str_version_22: Equip this and then use bait on water next to you to go fishing! All you have to do is wait for a bite, and then punch the fish before it escapes! If you miss, your bait is wasted, so punch fast. This enchanted rod will catch 25% bigger fish than normal.

sourceFields.name: Fishing Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Congratulations on winning the Fishing Frenzy Daily Challenge! With this hat on, there's a 5% chance to not use up your bait when you fish (I mean, there's a bunch of extra bait right there on the hat!).

sourceFields.name: Firefighter Helmet - Red
sourceFields.str_version_22: Protect your head from falling embers, or occasionally falling buildings!

sourceFields.name: Firefighter Helmet - Yellow
sourceFields.str_version_22: Protect your head from falling embers, or occasionally falling buildings!

sourceFields.name: Oxygen Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Strap this on when people start tossing rotten eggs. You'll be much happier.

sourceFields.name: Firefighter Boots
sourceFields.str_version_22: Finally, the technology exists to protect your feet from fire without exposing them to dangerous asbestos! Wear these for fire safety.

sourceFields.name: Firefighter Pants - Red
sourceFields.str_version_22: These pants are made of stylish rubber to ensure you are as overheated as possible while standing in a burning building.

sourceFields.name: Firefighter Pants - Yellow
sourceFields.str_version_22: These pants are made of stylish rubber to ensure you are as overheated as possible while standing in a burning building.

sourceFields.name: Firefighter Jacket - Red
sourceFields.str_version_22: Is it hot in here? Throw on a jacket!

sourceFields.name: Firefighter Jacket - Yellow
sourceFields.str_version_22: Is it hot in here? Throw on a jacket!

sourceFields.name: Fire Hose
sourceFields.str_version_22: Where is the other end of this hose plugged in? I don't know, but it has an infinite supply of water! This does no damage to blocks at all, but it puts out fires with great ease!

sourceFields.name: Fire Truck
sourceFields.str_version_22: For the sake of your fellow Growtopians, we limited the siren. But you can still enjoy the flashing lights!

sourceFields.name: Fire Ax
sourceFields.str_version_22: Chop your way into burning buildings to rescue puppies! This device is not licensed for any other use.

sourceFields.name: Floating Leaf
sourceFields.str_version_22: This magic leaf can float you around. Just cuz.

sourceFields.name: Soul Harvester Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Feast on their souls!!

sourceFields.name: Dried Leaf Crown
sourceFields.str_version_22: Handle with care or you're gonna end up with potpourri instead of the Heralded Crown Of Autumn.

sourceFields.name: Cursed Fishing Rod
sourceFields.str_version_22: Equip this and then use bait on water next to you to go fishing! All you have to do is wait for a bite, and then punch the fish before it escapes! If you miss, your bait is wasted, so punch fast. You will suffer mysterious effects when catching fish with this rod. Beware the curse!

sourceFields.name: Flaming Cape
sourceFields.str_version_22: This cape burns eternally with eldritch fire. It's also lined with asbestos, so you're all good. Probably.

sourceFields.name: Ghost Costume
sourceFields.str_version_22: Nothing spookier than a bedsheet with two holes cut in it!

sourceFields.name: Chainsaw Hand
sourceFields.str_version_22: If you ever get a possessed hand and have to lop it off at the wrist, here's a handy replacement for it! Also good for ice sculpture.

sourceFields.name: Inside-Out Vampire Cape
sourceFields.str_version_22: You accidentally made your cape inside-out!

sourceFields.name: Black Aura
sourceFields.str_version_22: I'm pretty sure it's a bad sign when your aura is this color.

sourceFields.name: Riding Demon Dog
sourceFields.str_version_22: It's just like a horse... except PURE EVIL.

sourceFields.name: Teeny Devil Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Even as tiny as they are, these wings allow you to jump in mid-air!

sourceFields.name: Soul Orb
sourceFields.str_version_22: This orb devours the souls of anything it touches - Growtopians, blocks, trees, whatever!

sourceFields.name: Stethoscope
sourceFields.str_version_22: Congratulations on winning the Doctor's Duel Daily Challenge! With this Stethoscope on, you are half as likely to make mistakes in surgery!

sourceFields.name: Super Logo - Crown
sourceFields.str_version_22: Emblazon this logo on your super costume since you won the Card Clash Daily Challenge! With this logo on, you get +2 health during card battles!

sourceFields.name: Wolf Spirit
sourceFields.str_version_22: Congratulations on winning the War of Wolves Daily Challenge! With this spirit equipped (it is a back item, by the way), you can double jump, and the guidance of the Wolf Spirit will improve your Wolfworld rewards (usually).

sourceFields.name: Challenge Crown
sourceFields.str_version_22: Congratulations! You were #1 in a Daily Challenge! Show off with a shiny crown.

sourceFields.name: Ring Of Savings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Congratulations on winning the Carnie Contest Daily Challenge! With this ring equipped, you save 10% on Golden Ticket prices (pay 90 rarity per ticket, or get 33 per World Lock).

sourceFields.name: Cosmic Cape
sourceFields.str_version_22: This cape sparkles and very very rarely finds leftover Comet Dust in blocks you break when it's not The Night Of The Comet!

sourceFields.name: Sword And Shield
sourceFields.str_version_22: This is a classic warrior's combo - a nice cutlass for your main hand, and a shield in the other. The shield makes you harder to knock back!

sourceFields.name: Twin Swords
sourceFields.str_version_22: Why waste time with a shield? Just get two swords!

sourceFields.name: Preppy Blonde Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: I think you've got just enough gel in there to go to the sock hop with Buffy!

sourceFields.name: Pet Slime
sourceFields.str_version_22: Nothing cuter than a sentient ball of slime that follows you around!

sourceFields.name: Strawberry Slime
sourceFields.str_version_22: So much tastier than the mucus flavor!

sourceFields.name: Legal Briefs
sourceFields.str_version_22: Not only are these comfortable undergarments for everyday use, they also have a legal use: put them on when you are in trouble for Malpractice, and you'll be freed from your punishment! This uses up the briefs.

sourceFields.name: Ring Of Smithing
sourceFields.str_version_22: To be honest, this ring doesn't really do anything. Well, that is unless you want to smith something. Then you're definitely gonna need to wear this!

sourceFields.name: Blacksmith's Apron
sourceFields.str_version_22: This apron is made of heavy leather, making it very effective for protecting you from stray sparks when forging things.

sourceFields.name: Lumber Axe
sourceFields.str_version_22: This axe is precisely balanced to chop down trees in just a single hit! Now, you might not be impressed since you can do that with your bare hands already. But wait - this axe can chop down the `2GROWCH'S`` trees! Of course, doing that will shatter it. They're very special trees.

sourceFields.name: Axe Of Winter
sourceFields.str_version_22: Mittens are recommended when wielding this icy monstrosity, which does extra damage to blocks.

sourceFields.name: Moose Cap
sourceFields.str_version_22: This beautifully styled hat, suitable for all formal occasions, has the unique property of attracting wild meese to follow you around.

sourceFields.name: Toboggan
sourceFields.str_version_22: This sled was called "Onion Bulb" by its original owner, but you can call it whatever you want. It comes with a free purple blanket to keep your legs warm!

sourceFields.name: Winter Robe
sourceFields.str_version_22: Be the King of Winter in this luxurious satiny robe! Note: this is a "chest item", like a necklace, so you can wear any shirts and back items you want underneath it.

sourceFields.name: Magical Carrot
sourceFields.str_version_22: With just a touch of winter magic, it's really not that hard to bring a snowman to life. I don't know why more people don't do it!

sourceFields.name: Riding Winter Wolf
sourceFields.str_version_22: It's just like a horse... except soft and fuzzy!

sourceFields.name: Elf Stockings
sourceFields.str_version_22: This is really just long underwear. You probably should wear pants over them, but hey, Growtopia doesn't support that, so you'll just have to be cold!

sourceFields.name: Growtopia Fan Shirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: This amazing psychic shirt can actually display your thoughts with spectacular new morphing ink technology. Note: yeah, it just says the one thing, but you know you're thinking it.

sourceFields.name: T-Shirt Cannon
sourceFields.str_version_22: Powered by a Fuel Pack on your back, this gun can launch free T-shirts at your fellow Growtopians! Don't waste shots at anything else, it still burns fuel!

sourceFields.name: Ghost Fan Shirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: You like ghosts? No? Sure looks like you do.

sourceFields.name: Pineapple Fan Shirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: Who doesn't pineapple GT?

sourceFields.name: Steampunk Corset
sourceFields.str_version_22: Tired of always choosing the survival of your internal organs over looking skinny? The corset is the thing for you!

sourceFields.name: Steampunk Skirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: Multiple layers of petticoats keep you warm!

sourceFields.name: Steampunk Top Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Keep an extra pair of goggles up there. You never know when you'll need them.

sourceFields.name: Steampunk Waistcoat
sourceFields.str_version_22: The perfect garment for housing a pocketwatch, monocle, and perhaps taxidermy needles. Definitely some weird stuff in those pockets.

sourceFields.name: Steampunk Leggings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Works equally well for a steampunk or a pirate! Or maybe a dancer from the 80's.

sourceFields.name: Steampunk Trenchcoat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Keep warm on those frosty London evenings in this stylish piece by Grow Couture! Note: this is a "chest item", like a necklace, so you can wear any shirts and back items you want underneath it.

sourceFields.name: Party Blaster
sourceFields.str_version_22: Take the party with you every where you go!

sourceFields.name: Silk Turban
sourceFields.str_version_22: Cover up that hair!

sourceFields.name: Patchwork Mess
sourceFields.str_version_22: An experiment in sewing gone horribly wrong.  This is just a bunch of silk stitched together in random directions.

sourceFields.name: Silk Vest - Red
sourceFields.str_version_22: A snappy vest suitable for any occasion.

sourceFields.name: Lovebird Pendant
sourceFields.str_version_22: Pip pip! This little bird will follow you around forever, because it loves you. Or at least it loves that necklace, and possibly wants it back.

sourceFields.name: Dark Cult Hood
sourceFields.str_version_22: When you reach level 7 in the cult, like Jairrocket, your eyes get glowy.

sourceFields.name: Serpent Staff
sourceFields.str_version_22: St. Patrick wandered around Ireland with one of these. It scared away all the other snakes because they saw it and thought he was constantly strangling a snake.

sourceFields.name: Lucky Pendant
sourceFields.str_version_22: This pendant symbolizes two snakes eating themselves. Whatever that means, it also causes a luck dragon to follow you around! Note: it's the dragon that's lucky, not you. I guess you're just lucky to get to hang around with it!

sourceFields.name: Riding Bumblebee
sourceFields.str_version_22: You're too heavy for this bee to fly, but it can help you jump an extra time.

sourceFields.name: Spring Crown
sourceFields.str_version_22: Keep it watered or you'll end up with a crown of thorns instead of the Heralded Crown Of Spring.

sourceFields.name: Brainflower
sourceFields.str_version_22: Flower power! This flower's roots growing down into your brain make you smarter at finding Magic Eggs in an Egg-Hunting Basket. Who knows, you might even find two sometimes!

sourceFields.name: Mermaid Tail
sourceFields.str_version_22: You don't need to trade your voice for a pair of legs... just take this off and you're all set! But this tail does make you move faster in the water, and slower on land.

sourceFields.name: Sushi Knife
sourceFields.str_version_22: This razor-sharp blade has the unique ability to slice fish up into fresh chunks for sushi! Just drop a fish item on a Cutting Board, then attack it with the Sushi Knife!

sourceFields.name: Spring Bouquet
sourceFields.str_version_22: Aw, a lovely bunch of flowers to share!

sourceFields.name: Paintbrush
sourceFields.str_version_22: Paint the town a variety of delightful colors with this here brush! Paint not included.

sourceFields.name: Saturday Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Anulot's bringing in the funk.

sourceFields.name: Raspberry Beret
sourceFields.str_version_22: This is the kind you find at a second-hand store.

sourceFields.name: Artist's Smock
sourceFields.str_version_22: Looks like you spilled a little there. No, over there. And there. And the first place you thought I meant.

sourceFields.name: Goatee
sourceFields.str_version_22: You're either a hipster or an evil twin. Or perhaps ... a hipster's evil twin? How would you know which one was evil!?

sourceFields.name: Orange Shirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: I know you dreamed about this since Day 1 of Growtopia. It is finally here. For real. Yes - there is an Orange Shirt, and it's not just a block, you can WEAR IT.

sourceFields.name: Battle Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: This amazing octohedron can actually contain two Battle Pets, primed and ready to strike. Unequip and re-equip to swap which pet is active. Wrench a Battle Pet Cage to load a pet into the Leash. Wrench another player with a Battle Leash to battle them! You must have 2 pets in the Battle Leash to battle.

sourceFields.name: Spelunker's Headlamp
sourceFields.str_version_22: This hardhat protects you from falling rocks, while the headlamp lights up dark caverns.

sourceFields.name: Night Vision Goggles
sourceFields.str_version_22: Equipping these lets you disregard darkness completely! If you're not in a world you own, they consume 1 D Battery for every minute you wear them. You can wear them without a battery if you just wanna look cool, though. `4Batteries not included.``

sourceFields.name: Hand Torch
sourceFields.str_version_22: British people would call a Flashlight this, but this is an actual torch, for your hand. As opposed to an Adventure Item or wall torch. Carrying this lights up dark caves. Torches burn out at unpredictable moments, so carry several!

sourceFields.name: Climbing Picks
sourceFields.str_version_22: These handy picks allow you to climb Climbing Walls. Just jump and hold the arrow towards the wall!

sourceFields.name: Climbing Boots
sourceFields.str_version_22: These handy boots allow you to climb Climbing Walls. Just jump and hold the arrow towards the wall!

sourceFields.name: Maracas
sourceFields.str_version_22: Shake shake shake your maracas!

sourceFields.name: Pinata Pal
sourceFields.str_version_22: When you are feeling down and lonely, nothing cheers you up like a rainbow-colored friendly burro filled with candy!

sourceFields.name: Fiesta Dress
sourceFields.str_version_22: Got a festive occasion to celebrate? Pop on this colorful number for a night on the town!

sourceFields.name: Pineapple Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: This hair isn't made of pineapple, it's just been dyed and gelled to look like pineapple leaves.

sourceFields.name: Pet Trainer Cap
sourceFields.str_version_22: This hat says PT on it. You can wear it to show you're a Pet Trainer, but you could also use it to celebrate Physical Therapy, or Popcorn Time, or whatever you like!

sourceFields.str_version_22: Silkworm on a silk string.

sourceFields.str_version_22: The more legs your ride has, the smoother it is. Too bad centipedes don't grow this big.

sourceFields.name: Pet Trainer Medal
sourceFields.str_version_22: Congratulations! You have been awarded a medal for defeating a Pet Trainer!

sourceFields.name: Thinking Cap
sourceFields.str_version_22: They say two heads are better than one. We can't arrange that, but we can get you two of what's inside your head!

sourceFields.name: Phlogiston
sourceFields.str_version_22: This fantastical substance contains the very essence of living flame.

sourceFields.name: Toy Lock-Bot
sourceFields.str_version_22: It's just like Lock-Bot, only tiny! And he doesn't trade locks, he SHOOTS them.

sourceFields.name: Riding Phoenix
sourceFields.str_version_22: Whoa, you're really sitting in the hotseat now. There are only 500 of these in existence, so don't lose yours!

sourceFields.name: Red Flip Flops
sourceFields.str_version_22: Bright rubber to protect your feet from pointy shells on the beach!

sourceFields.name: Green Flip Flops
sourceFields.str_version_22: Bright rubber to protect your feet from pointy shells on the beach!

sourceFields.name: Blue Flip Flops
sourceFields.str_version_22: Bright rubber to protect your feet from pointy shells on the beach!

sourceFields.name: B.O.O. Shirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: The official uniform of B.O.O. - Battlers Of the Otherworldly. Join today!

sourceFields.name: B.O.O. Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: The official uniform of B.O.O. - Battlers Of the Otherworldly. Join today!

sourceFields.name: Spectral Goggles
sourceFields.str_version_22: The spectrally polarized lenses of these goggles allow you to actually see paranormal activity. Be warned: it is very spooky! But it's there whether you can see it or not... wouldn't you rather know?

sourceFields.name: B.O.O. Helmet
sourceFields.str_version_22: The trouble with poltergeists is that they're always pushing things off of shelves (side note: cats pose the same problem). That's where the helmet comes in. Protect yourself from falling books and antiques!

sourceFields.name: Neutron Pack
sourceFields.str_version_22: This backpack contains a portable nuclear reactor. I know that sounds a bit unsafe, but... well, it is. It's a terrible idea. It has blinky lights, though. You'll need to wear a Neutron Pack to power a Neutron Gun.

sourceFields.name: Neutron Gun
sourceFields.str_version_22: This energy blaster looks impressive, but actually has no impact on our world. Rather, it creates a stream of neutrons that attracts spirits. Ghosts can't escape the beam. Which reminds me: Don't ever cross your beam with somebody else's! That would be bad.

sourceFields.name: Rubber Boots
sourceFields.str_version_22: These are tight-fitting boots made of a natural rubber that protects from slime while still allowing your feet to breathe.

sourceFields.name: Demon Control Cap
sourceFields.str_version_22: With this helmet, which is not a colander at all, you can control a demon dog from another dimension!

sourceFields.name: Haunted Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: What's that eerie noise coming from in there? These pants must be haunted!

sourceFields.name: Shark-Tooth Necklace
sourceFields.str_version_22: I don't know if this is a tooth from every shark you've killed, or each one that's bitten you, but either way it's impressive.

sourceFields.name: No-Face
sourceFields.str_version_22: Embarrassed? Feel like hiding your face? How about just removing it instead?

sourceFields.name: Purple Djellaba
sourceFields.str_version_22: This long robe is suitable for male or female Growtopians, provided they want to look snazzy and colorful!

sourceFields.name: Yellow Djellaba
sourceFields.str_version_22: This long robe is suitable for male or female Growtopians, provided they want to look snazzy and colorful!

sourceFields.name: Green Djellaba
sourceFields.str_version_22: This long robe is suitable for male or female Growtopians, provided they want to look snazzy and colorful!

sourceFields.name: Riding Broomstick
sourceFields.str_version_22: Which magic makes this fly? Witch magic makes this fly!

sourceFields.name: Techno Visor
sourceFields.str_version_22: This is handy technology for people who are overwhelmed with modern life - it blocks one of your ears from hearing things, and one of your eyes from seeing things. Just relax and enjoy the left half of the world.

sourceFields.name: Glowstick
sourceFields.str_version_22: This plastic tube of lethal radioactive elements is the perfect thing to swing around at a party! It also provides light.

sourceFields.name: Rhino Horn
sourceFields.str_version_22: Aw, it thinks you're its mama!

sourceFields.name: Octopus Head
sourceFields.str_version_22: This is why aquariums have rules.

sourceFields.name: Super Shirt - Autumn
sourceFields.str_version_22: Fight crime in this mighty leafy leotard!

sourceFields.name: Muscle Shirt - Autumn
sourceFields.str_version_22: Flex your muscles in this mighty leafy leotard!

sourceFields.name: Heroic Tights - Autumn
sourceFields.str_version_22: To be a leafy superhero, you really need to wear tights of some sort.

sourceFields.name: Super Tights - Autumn
sourceFields.str_version_22: To be a leafy superhero, you really need to wear tights of some sort.

sourceFields.name: Heroic Boots - Autumn
sourceFields.str_version_22: These leafy boots add nothing to your crimefighting skills except to protect you from stray Legos.

sourceFields.name: Superhero Mask - Autumn
sourceFields.str_version_22: Protect your secret identity!

sourceFields.name: Crimefighter Mask - Autumn
sourceFields.str_version_22: Protect your secret identity!

sourceFields.name: Super Cape - Autumn
sourceFields.str_version_22: You're no Heroman, but it's still pretty swell.

sourceFields.name: Superheroine Top - Autumn
sourceFields.str_version_22: Flex your muscles in this mighty leafy leotard!

sourceFields.name: Super Eye Mask - Autumn
sourceFields.str_version_22: Protect your secret identity, by hiding the inch of skin around your eyes.  Who could possibly recognize you?

sourceFields.name: Super Logo - Leaf
sourceFields.str_version_22: Emblazon this logo on your super costume to fight crime as... Leaf Lord? Lady Leaf? The Fallen Avenger? It's up to you!

sourceFields.name: Harvest Witch Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Normally this mask is only worn during the most profane of dark rituals, beneath a blood red moon. But you can wear it for shopping, parties, whatever!

sourceFields.name: Blue Hanbok Top
sourceFields.str_version_22: These festival clothes are extra festive!

sourceFields.name: Orange Hanbok Top
sourceFields.str_version_22: These festival clothes are extra festive!

sourceFields.name: Yellow Hanbok Skirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: These festival clothes are extra festive!

sourceFields.name: Sunflower Hair Pin
sourceFields.str_version_22: When sunflowers are out of season, stick this plastic replacement in your hair.

sourceFields.name: Lil' Sheepers
sourceFields.str_version_22: Baa. This little baby sheep will follow you everywhere you go! Mainly because it's tied to your wrist.

sourceFields.name: Harvest Robinsons
sourceFields.str_version_22: These special edition Air Robinsons are themed to celebrate the harvest, or just be bright crazy colors, like all basketball shoes.

sourceFields.name: Wooden Sword
sourceFields.str_version_22: They use these to train in Kendo. They won't cut much, but getting whacked with one certainly does hurt!

sourceFields.name: Wool Scarf
sourceFields.str_version_22: Your neck is toasty warm. Maybe you should put some pants on too.

sourceFields.name: Sheep Shears
sourceFields.str_version_22: This handy tool is a lot more effective at cutting wool than your fingers are, so you can get twice as much when you use it to shear a sheep!

sourceFields.name: Rock Hammer
sourceFields.str_version_22: A precision instrument for chipping fossils out of rocks. If you find a fossil, equip this hammer and start tapping - but do it *carefully!* If the fossil comes loose and you hit again, you'll break it!

sourceFields.name: Rock Chisel
sourceFields.str_version_22: So you've extracted a fossil from a rock, but the rock is still in your way. That's where the chisel comes in! It lets you chip away the rock without damaging the fossil.

sourceFields.name: Dinosaur Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: This is how you would look if a dinosaur snuck up behind you and swallowed you, but you got stuck in his throat. It's really a bad situation for everyone involved.

sourceFields.name: Red Pet Pteranodon
sourceFields.str_version_22: You've brought a dinosaur back to life with genetic engineering! There's no way that this could go badly!

sourceFields.name: Stone Spear
sourceFields.str_version_22: In ancient times, sticks and stones were about as good as it got. The upside is it's a magic stone - this spear will teleport back into your hand once thrown!

sourceFields.name: Blue Hardhat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Head protection is required in construction areas, and at some dig sites.

sourceFields.name: Outback Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: G'day! Barbie! Shrimp! That's not a knife, it's a hat! These hats are popular among paleontologists and other desert dwellers.

sourceFields.name: Heatbow
sourceFields.str_version_22: This bow shoots flaming arrows!

sourceFields.name: Doompunk Corset
sourceFields.str_version_22: Internal organs rotted away? The corset should fit you fine!

sourceFields.name: Doompunk Skirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: Multiple layers of petticoats keep you warm when stalking your prey!

sourceFields.name: Doompunk Top Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Keep an extra pair of goggles up there. You never know when you'll need them for evil.

sourceFields.name: Doompunk Waistcoat
sourceFields.str_version_22: The perfect garment for housing a pocketwatch, monocle, and perhaps poison needles. Definitely some evil stuff in those pockets.

sourceFields.name: Doompunk Leggings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Works equally well for a doompunk or a pirate! Or maybe a serial killer from the 80's.

sourceFields.name: Doompunk Trenchcoat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Keep warm while stalking people on those frosty London evenings in this stylish piece by Grow Couture! Note: this is a "chest item", like a necklace, so you can wear any shirts and back items you want underneath it.

sourceFields.name: Eye Of Growganoth
sourceFields.str_version_22: This accursed necklace binds one of the eternal and innumerable Eyes of Growganoth to your service. Just make sure you don't take *your* eye off of it - at the first sign of weakness, it will devour your soul!

sourceFields.name: Apocalypse Steed
sourceFields.str_version_22: The four horsemen have updated to more modern steeds. They're probably gonna be pretty mad when they find out you swiped one.

sourceFields.name: Jack o' Lantern Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Luckily this is just latex and not actually a gooey carved-out pumpkin.

sourceFields.name: Devil Tail
sourceFields.str_version_22: Why you little devil...

sourceFields.name: Death's Scythe
sourceFields.str_version_22: Careful where you swing that thing.

sourceFields.name: Demon Chariot
sourceFields.str_version_22: This thing goes pretty fast for a vehicle with only 2 horsepower.

sourceFields.name: Logarithmic Wheel
sourceFields.str_version_22: You know what a really good weapon is? A wagon wheel. Yeah, I mean... yeah.

sourceFields.name: Spiked Collar
sourceFields.str_version_22: Ah yeah, you look tough, like a junkyard dog.

sourceFields.name: Malevolent Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: What are you up to under that mop-top? Seems like something a little sneaky...

sourceFields.name: Riding Raven
sourceFields.str_version_22: Only dark magic could breed a raven so massive. It's so powerful it allows you to double-jump!

sourceFields.name: Demonic Horns
sourceFields.str_version_22: Mahhtin looks like Tim Curry.

sourceFields.name: Non La
sourceFields.str_version_22: This conical straw hat is useful for full sun protection, as well as carrying stuff!

sourceFields.name: Penguin Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Wanna be as COOL as Master Peng? Not gonna happen. But you can wear this mask and look like a dork.

sourceFields.name: Mini-Peng
sourceFields.str_version_22: Master Peng is so swift, he can appear to be in multiple places at once. But in the extra places, he looks very small.

sourceFields.name: Pet Fox
sourceFields.str_version_22: THE CUTENESS IS KILLING ME.

sourceFields.name: Present Goblin Disguise
sourceFields.str_version_22: Disguises you as a Present Goblin, bringer of joy.

sourceFields.name: Toy Train
sourceFields.str_version_22: Chugga chugga CHOO CHOO!

sourceFields.name: Hideous Holiday Sweater
sourceFields.str_version_22: Your grandma thinks you look adorable in this.

sourceFields.name: Winter Turtleneck
sourceFields.str_version_22: Celebrate Winterfest in cozy style, with no worries of chin-freeze.

sourceFields.name: Yo-Yo
sourceFields.str_version_22: It's a disc on a string. Try smacking stuff with it!

sourceFields.name: Meh, Bunny Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: MrMehMeh likes carrots.

sourceFields.name: Meh, Bunny Suit
sourceFields.str_version_22: MrMehMeh stores the carrots he eats here.

sourceFields.name: Stuff-4-Toys Shirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: Stuff-4-Toys is offering these stylish t-shirts to all Silver level donators!

sourceFields.name: Present Goblin Home Edition
sourceFields.str_version_22: Dress up as a Present Goblin for fun! You won't automatically drop presents, but it's festive year-round! This costume overrides all other clothing, but if you don't like tossing tennis balls, try equipping other sportsballs with it!

sourceFields.name: Solsascarf
sourceFields.str_version_22: Solsagann is tossing out yesterday's baguettes! They are quite stale.

sourceFields.name: Stuff-4-Toys Tote Bag
sourceFields.str_version_22: Tote around your shopping with our fabulous tote bag. It lets everybody know you are serious about donating Stuff for Toys.

sourceFields.name: Betty Bluetooth Doll
sourceFields.str_version_22: This high-tech doll is the big craze this Winterfest! Everybody wants a remote-controlled doll that fires deadly lightning bolts!

sourceFields.name: Plague Doctor Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: There was a time when actual medical professionals would go out on the streets wearing this. It was a creepy, creepy time.

sourceFields.name: Plague Doctor Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Rumpled and frumpy, really showing your dedication to your craft.

sourceFields.name: Plague Doctor Robe
sourceFields.str_version_22: This robe is intended to protect you from pestilence. Sadly, it was invented in pre-scientific times, so all it really protects you from is cold weather.

sourceFields.name: Living Dead Remote
sourceFields.str_version_22: You just couldn't accept your patients' deaths. And now you've created an abomination, haven't you? What has your foul science wrought?!

sourceFields.name: Water Spirit Necklace
sourceFields.str_version_22: Zfert's got spirit!

sourceFields.name: Fuzzy Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: Ah, classic fuzzy pants.

sourceFields.name: Wolf Skull Shoulders
sourceFields.str_version_22: Three heads are better than one, even if two of them are empty and skinless.

sourceFields.name: Sales Shades
sourceFields.str_version_22: Cover your eyes, the savings are simply too glorious to behold!

sourceFields.name: Ghost Wolf Monocle
sourceFields.str_version_22: This monocle is haunted by the spirit of an ancient wolf! That's more common than you'd expect among monocles.

sourceFields.name: Party Fowl
sourceFields.str_version_22: Whoa dude, major party fowl. You earned this for playing Growtopia for THREE YEARS, and over 300 hours, and reaching level 50! Wow, that's dedication.

sourceFields.name: Pink Cat As A Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Oh, the places you'll go wearing this hat! You can wear it on the train, or in the rain, or... well, actually don't wear it in the rain, it'll shrink.

sourceFields.name: Blue Cat As A Hat
