sourceFields.name: Pegasus
sourceFields.str_version_22: If you were a pegasus, you'd spend all your time flying too. Why walk on those teeny legs? Those mighty wings allow you both to double jump, too.

sourceFields.name: Golden Pegasus
sourceFields.str_version_22: If you were a pegasus, you'd spend all your time flying too. Why walk on those teeny legs? Those mighty wings allow you both to double jump, too.

sourceFields.name: Heart Glasses
sourceFields.str_version_22: The world just looks like a lovelier place through these rose-colored glasses.

sourceFields.name: Golden Heart Glasses
sourceFields.str_version_22: The world just looks like a more expensive place through these gold-tinted glasses.

sourceFields.name: Valentine Dress
sourceFields.str_version_22: Dress for the occasion!

sourceFields.name: Zombie Defense Force Helmet
sourceFields.str_version_22: This helmet covers your vital brain region from zombie attack. Unfortunately, zombies only need to punch you to infect you, so it's not terribly useful.

sourceFields.name: Zombie Defense Force Uniform
sourceFields.str_version_22: This is the official uniform of the Zombie Defense Force! It has lots of pockets for your lip balm, candy, paper clips, and other key zombie-fighting tools.

sourceFields.name: Zombie Defense Force Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: You could just wear any green pants and you probably wouldn't get in trouble, but these have a cool Z logo sewn into the inside waistband.

sourceFields.name: Camouflage Facepaint
sourceFields.str_version_22: They'll never see you coming. Unless they look anywhere other than your face. At least you might freak them out - "Ah, it's a guy with no face!!"

sourceFields.name: AK-8087
sourceFields.str_version_22: The ultimate zombie-slaying weapon. Or pumpkin-slaying.

sourceFields.name: Skull Launcher
sourceFields.str_version_22: The ultimate zombie weapon. Actually, the only zombie weapon - you can use this while you're a zombie! (Also usable by humans)

sourceFields.name: Rainbow Kite
sourceFields.str_version_22: The most colorful kite in all of Growtopia!

sourceFields.name: Zombie Hound
sourceFields.str_version_22: Braaainnss! This little puppy just wants to play! Or maybe he's hungry... hmmm...

sourceFields.name: Crazy Zombie Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: The undead use a lot of hairspray.

sourceFields.name: Chef's Whites
sourceFields.str_version_22: Spotless! Until you actually start cooking.

sourceFields.name: Chef's Cap
sourceFields.str_version_22: A real chef doesn't wear the big poofy hat... this cap keeps your hair out of your eyes and out of the food without catching on fire regularly.

sourceFields.name: Chef's Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: These are made of plastex polymer... all the sauce you spill on them just rolls right off! Onto your shoes.

sourceFields.name: Butcher Knife
sourceFields.str_version_22: This heavy blade is perfect for hacking through bones. Use it on a Cutting Board to chop up meat!

sourceFields.name: Unearthly Synthoid
sourceFields.str_version_22: It's completely synthetic life! Not of this Earth!

sourceFields.name: Radioactive Synthoid
sourceFields.str_version_22: It's completely synthetic life! Burning with radiation!

sourceFields.name: Mysterious Synthoid
sourceFields.str_version_22: It's completely synthetic life! How mysterious!

sourceFields.name: Haunted Synthoid
sourceFields.str_version_22: It's completely synthetic life! Possessed by synthetic unlife!

sourceFields.name: Wobbly Dress
sourceFields.str_version_22: It's difficult to tell whether Bungbi's dress is made of candy, or just styled to look like it...

sourceFields.name: Ladybug Leaf
sourceFields.str_version_22: Ladybugs are considered lucky, so consider yourself lucky that you found this sweet leaf that's making one follow you around!

sourceFields.name: Shamrock Hair Pin
sourceFields.str_version_22: Carry the luck of the Irish on your head! Only found in Blarney 6 and 8.

sourceFields.name: Golden Razor Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Slice through the air with the greatest of ease! And double jump.

sourceFields.name: Cosmic Sky Horse
sourceFields.str_version_22: This winged beast hails from a distant star system. Those mighty wings let you move fast, but they're not strong enough to double jump (living in space has atrophied its muscles).

sourceFields.name: Spaceman Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: I don't know why, but most alien cultures insist on wearing clothes made of tin foil.

sourceFields.name: Spaceman Suit
sourceFields.str_version_22: I don't know why, but most alien cultures insist on wearing clothes made of tin foil.

sourceFields.name: Synthetic Oculum
sourceFields.str_version_22: The human eye sees a limited spectrum. Replace yours with these synthetic models! They transmit visual data direct to your central cortex. Unfortunately they also make you look cross-eyed.

sourceFields.name: Cranial Lagomorph
sourceFields.str_version_22: Don't be alarmed, but there may be a bunny on your head...

sourceFields.name: Bunny Slippers
sourceFields.str_version_22: Snuggle your feet!

sourceFields.name: Zraei's Dragoscarf
sourceFields.str_version_22: When a normal scarf isn't enough... This dragon will assist you, granting Enhanced Digging, but only if you don't have it already. Sponsored by Bretz and Zraei - first to complete all epic quests!

sourceFields.name: Mini Mallard
sourceFields.str_version_22: Ducks instinctively follow their mothers around. This one just follows you because it's tied to your wrist, though.

sourceFields.name: Chemist's Goggles
sourceFields.str_version_22: The perfect eyewear for doing chemistry! Grants a 10% chance to not consume a chemical when you use a Chemsynth tool.

sourceFields.name: TXMom's Crown
sourceFields.str_version_22: Be honored to wear this beautiful crown. Sponsored by TXMom.

sourceFields.name: Kudo's Carriage
sourceFields.str_version_22: Your winged friends are happy to help you double jump! Sponsored by Kudobelle.

sourceFields.name: Saxamaphone
sourceFields.str_version_22: You can't punch when holding this, you're too busy ROCKING! Punch anywhere to play music. If you punch to your left or right, you can bend the note higher or lower. Punch in your own column to play the same notes that Sheet Music: Sax Note plays.

sourceFields.name: Hazmat Boots
sourceFields.str_version_22: In case of hazardous spills, you'll want a pair of these! Reduces Lava damage by 50%.

sourceFields.name: Hazmat Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: Don't get a tear in these, or you'll be exposed to whatever lurks outside!

sourceFields.name: Hazmat Suit
sourceFields.str_version_22: This suit protects you from any sort of biochemical leaks. Or it would if you had zipped it up right. Yikes, good thing this was just a test!

sourceFields.name: Hazmat Helmet
sourceFields.str_version_22: Protects your precious face from exposure to harmful stuff.

sourceFields.name: Uranium Necklace
sourceFields.str_version_22: Wearing this will dramatically decrease your lifespan, but you'll be looking GOOD until it's over!

sourceFields.name: Confetti Cannon
sourceFields.str_version_22: Precision telescopic sights ensure you deliver the lethal payload directly to center mass.

sourceFields.name: Riding Fiesta Burrito
sourceFields.str_version_22: This donkey likes to party.

sourceFields.name: Hotpants
sourceFields.str_version_22: You look hot in these. And so does your pet JalapeÃ±o!

sourceFields.name: Green Geiger V-Neck
sourceFields.str_version_22: This shirt is made of... stuff.

sourceFields.name: Blue Geiger V-Neck
sourceFields.str_version_22: This shirt is made of... stuff.

sourceFields.name: Purple Geiger V-Neck
sourceFields.str_version_22: This shirt is made of... stuff.

sourceFields.name: Orange Geiger V-Neck
sourceFields.str_version_22: This shirt is made of... stuff.

sourceFields.name: Xenoid Suit
sourceFields.str_version_22: This skin-tight outfit really makes you look like a freaky alien.

sourceFields.name: Xenoid Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: You seriously look like a freaky alien.

sourceFields.name: Xenoid Claws
sourceFields.str_version_22: These nasty claws make you look like a freaky alien.

sourceFields.name: Xenoid Leggings
sourceFields.str_version_22: These skin-tight leggings make you look like a freaky alien.

sourceFields.name: Xenoid Shoes
sourceFields.str_version_22: These awkward pointy heels make you look like a freaky alien.

sourceFields.name: Minecart
sourceFields.str_version_22: Nothing says adventure like riding around in a minecart! Tracks not included (But the wheels are modified to run on any surface).

sourceFields.name: Mariachi Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Not only does this fancy hat cover your head from the heat, it also makes you look amazing while you sing and dance.

sourceFields.name: Mariachi Suit
sourceFields.str_version_22: Look the part while playing your guitar like a true musician of Mexico.

sourceFields.name: Mariachi Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: Fiesta! Time to dance.

sourceFields.name: Seductive Rose
sourceFields.str_version_22: Sticking a rose in your mouth seems to make your voice so much more attactive when you sing.

sourceFields.name: Red Brimmed Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: A party hat for the most sophisticated.

sourceFields.name: Red Formal Dress
sourceFields.str_version_22: The finest dress for all your fancy dress parties.

sourceFields.name: Diamond Horn
sourceFields.str_version_22: This amazing horn transforms each time you unequip it. Try all 3 flavors! It also boosts your build range.

sourceFields.name: Diamond Horns
sourceFields.str_version_22: This amazing horn transforms each time you unequip it. Try all 3 flavors! It also boosts your build range.

sourceFields.name: Diamond Devil Horns
sourceFields.str_version_22: This amazing horn transforms each time you unequip it. Try all 3 flavors! It also boosts your build range.

sourceFields.name: Pet Frog
sourceFields.str_version_22: Ribbit ribbit. This little frog hops along everywhere you go!

sourceFields.name: Pineapple Finger Ring
sourceFields.str_version_22: This tasty pineapple ring is now stuck to your fingers. For some reason a creepy pineapple spider keeps following you around!

sourceFields.name: Pineapple Glasses
sourceFields.str_version_22: Pineapples in your eyes! Who wouldn't want that? Gives sticky vision which is suspiciously similar to normal vision but more sticky.

sourceFields.name: Adventurer's Whip
sourceFields.str_version_22: Only a true adventurer can swing this with such style.

sourceFields.name: Adventurer's Sling Bag
sourceFields.str_version_22: Look stylish while on all your greatest adventures. Who knows what you can hold in this. `4Doesn't actually give any more backpack space.``

sourceFields.name: Hula Skirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: Aloha. Sway those hips!

sourceFields.name: Floral Bikini Top
sourceFields.str_version_22: Scandalous!

sourceFields.name: Floral Lei
sourceFields.str_version_22: This particular one is lab-created, which you'd think is less classy, but they're much prettier.

sourceFields.name: Zinc
sourceFields.str_version_22: Protection from the sun. Well, at least your nose will be safe.

sourceFields.name: Frangipani
sourceFields.str_version_22: Put a flower in your hair. All the girls are doing it this summer! Just don't let Jim catch you stealing flowers from his garden... He's Crazy!

sourceFields.name: Short Surfer Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: You've got that windblown chlorinated surfer look. It either makes you cool or a filthy beach bum. It's a fine line.

sourceFields.name: Long Surfer Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: You've got that windblown chlorinated surfer look. It either makes you cool or a filthy beach bum. It's a fine line.

sourceFields.name: Phoenix Crown
sourceFields.str_version_22: Be honored to wear this beautiful crown. Light the way for all to see. No more than 500 of these exist in all of Growtopia.

sourceFields.name: Surfboard
sourceFields.str_version_22: Surf's up! This magical piece of fiberglass allows you to walk on water.

sourceFields.name: Surfboard - Flame
sourceFields.str_version_22: Surf's up! This magical piece of fiberglass allows you to walk on water. Now with Flames artwork!

sourceFields.name: Surfboard - Wave
sourceFields.str_version_22: Surf's up! This magical piece of fiberglass allows you to walk on water. Now with Wave artwork!

sourceFields.name: Surfboard - Electric Green
sourceFields.str_version_22: Surf's up! This magical piece of fiberglass allows you to walk on water. Now in Electric Green!

sourceFields.name: Balloon Launcher
sourceFields.str_version_22: With this launcher you can throw balloons farther. Not much good for anything else, though.

sourceFields.name: Team Shorts - Punch
sourceFields.str_version_22: Red with victory. Wear your team colors proudly.

sourceFields.name: Team Shorts - Grow
sourceFields.str_version_22: Green with glory. Wear your team colors proudly.

sourceFields.name: Team Shorts - Build
sourceFields.str_version_22: Blue with bravery. Wear your team colors proudly.

sourceFields.name: Team Shirt - Punch
sourceFields.str_version_22: Resplendent with redness. Wear your team colors proudly.

sourceFields.name: Team Shirt - Grow
sourceFields.str_version_22: Glorious with greenness. Wear your team colors proudly.

sourceFields.name: Team Shirt - Build
sourceFields.str_version_22: Beautiful with blueness. Wear your team colors proudly.

sourceFields.name: Super Squirt Gun Jetpack
sourceFields.str_version_22: Strap these to your back and get ready for the ride of your life. Use the power of pressurization to leap tall buildings in a single bound, then drift gently to Earth.

sourceFields.name: Team Headband - Punch
sourceFields.str_version_22: When there's a war on, sweat, water, and balloon fragments fly everywhere! This'll keep them all out of your eyes for more effective fighting!

sourceFields.name: Team Headband - Grow
sourceFields.str_version_22: When there's a war on, sweat, water, and balloon fragments fly everywhere! This'll keep them all out of your eyes for more effective fighting!

sourceFields.name: Team Headband - Build
sourceFields.str_version_22: When there's a war on, sweat, water, and balloon fragments fly everywhere! This'll keep them all out of your eyes for more effective fighting!

sourceFields.name: Red Facepaint
sourceFields.str_version_22: Looks like you've been punched in the face... or have you? Nope, it's just face paint and a whopping dose of team spirit.

sourceFields.name: Green Facepaint
sourceFields.str_version_22: Blend in with the trees for a surprise attack like a true Grow supporter.

sourceFields.name: Blue Facepaint
sourceFields.str_version_22: Even Sir William Wallace would be envious of your team spirit. FREEEEDDDOOOOMMMMM! Wait! This is just a balloon war...

sourceFields.name: Red Floaty Balloon
sourceFields.str_version_22: Hold on tight and hopefully you won't float up into the sky. There's a song with 99 red balloons, but sadly, this is only 1.

sourceFields.name: Green Floaty Balloon
sourceFields.str_version_22: Hold on tight and hopefully you won't float up into the sky. Make everyone green with envy when they see your beautiful balloon.

sourceFields.name: Blue Floaty Balloon
sourceFields.str_version_22: Hold on tight and hopefully you won't float up into the sky. The balloon might be blue, but you'll never be!

sourceFields.name: Super Squirt Gun Jetpack Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: Strap these to your hips and get ready for the ride of your life. Use the power of pressurization to leap tall buildings in a single bound, then drift gently to Earth.

sourceFields.name: Solar Chariot
sourceFields.str_version_22: Run at the speed of, well... horses. On FIRE!

sourceFields.name: Silk Corset
sourceFields.str_version_22: Feeling fat? You could exercise... or you could just cram your gut into one of these! Oh sure, you may end up with spinal deformities, but beauty demands pain!

sourceFields.name: Gothic Corset
sourceFields.str_version_22: Feeling fat? You could exercise... or you could just cram your gut into one of these! Oh sure, you may end up with spinal deformities, but beauty demands pain!

sourceFields.name: Unicorn Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: Like unicorns? Well, so does the rest of the internet, and now you can look like one, too!

sourceFields.name: Emerald Pickaxe
sourceFields.str_version_22: This tool is worth more than the stuff you mine with it!

sourceFields.name: Megalodon
sourceFields.str_version_22: Amazing! You have caught the incredibly rare and elusive Megalodon. The largest shark ever. Class: MEGA-SIZED! Along with a mega diet, it's incredibly powerful and deadly. See this shark in action in Hungry Shark World!

sourceFields.name: Black Espadrille
sourceFields.str_version_22: Perfect for kicking back - or kicking butt! - in the tropical sun.

sourceFields.name: Checkered Espadrille
sourceFields.str_version_22: Perfect for kicking back - or kicking butt! - in the tropical sun.

sourceFields.name: Sports Bra
sourceFields.str_version_22: Get running and show off your curves while you're at it!

sourceFields.name: Pink Aura
sourceFields.str_version_22: You are burning with lively energies! Also, double-jump power.

sourceFields.name: Blue Aura
sourceFields.str_version_22: You are burning with brilliant energy! Also, double-jump power.

sourceFields.name: Wedding Headdress
sourceFields.str_version_22: Everyone should look like a queen at their own wedding.

sourceFields.name: Sarong
sourceFields.str_version_22: Casual, comfortable, and affordable! What more could you want?

sourceFields.name: Dress with Smock
sourceFields.str_version_22: This light cotton dress is adorned with adorable stripes. Aww, how cute.

sourceFields.name: Waistcoat and Jacket
sourceFields.str_version_22: The perfect garment for housing a pocketwatch and monocle. Will also keep you warm during those long winter days.

sourceFields.name: Inside-Out Devil Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: You don't jump higher than with normal devil wings, but man, you DO look pretty cool, like an inside-out devil. Wait... doesn't that make you an angel?!

sourceFields.name: Speed Medallion
sourceFields.str_version_22: This amulet bestows you with speed energy, making you run so fast that lightning trails behind you!

sourceFields.name: Skateboard
sourceFields.str_version_22: Skate or die! Alternatively you can live by doing other things, like eating and breathing. Actually, do those even if you ARE skating.

sourceFields.name: Burning Hands
sourceFields.str_version_22: Spew jets of flame from your hands!

sourceFields.name: Riding Turtle
sourceFields.str_version_22: It's not the fastest transportation around, but it is the bumpiest!

sourceFields.name: Playful Fire Sprite
sourceFields.str_version_22: Looks like a little blob of fire is following you! Makes sense.

sourceFields.name: Playful Wind Sprite
sourceFields.str_version_22: Looks like a little purple blob is following you! Doesn't make as much sense, but the air-colored ones didn't show up so well, so we dyed it!

sourceFields.name: Playful Wood Sprite
sourceFields.str_version_22: Looks like a little green blob is following you! Makes sense.

sourceFields.name: Playful Water Sprite
sourceFields.str_version_22: Looks like a little blob of water is following you! Makes sense.

sourceFields.name: Plate Greaves
sourceFields.str_version_22: Tired of being kicked in the shins? Aren't we all?

sourceFields.name: Flaming Horsie
sourceFields.str_version_22: There was a saddle on here, but it burned up. Eh, you can probably ride bareback.

sourceFields.name: Newspaper
sourceFields.str_version_22: Great for checking the daily gazette. Equip to read.

sourceFields.name: Riding Chicken
sourceFields.str_version_22: A feathered friend to carry you to and fro! Best part? He'll never peck you to death with hordes of his angry pals!

sourceFields.name: Prismatic Aura
sourceFields.str_version_22: A fantastic aura of prismatic energy pulses around you, turning heads and bending the laws of gravity to your will. The power to double jump - and look awesome - is yours!

sourceFields.name: Chicken Plow
sourceFields.str_version_22: Ancient magic has unlocked the secrets of advanced chicken farming! Now, for the first time, your chicken will PLANT seeds instead of eating them! (When equipped, will plant whatever seed you have selected as you move!)

sourceFields.name: Ancestral Totem of Wisdom
sourceFields.str_version_22: Incredible forces of willpower and mental strength have been combined with the building blocks of creation to forge this totem. Equip it and ancient knowledge will be yours...

sourceFields.name: Ancestral Tesseract of Dimensions
sourceFields.str_version_22: Astonishing whirls of space and time have been combined with the building blocks of creation to forge this tesseract. Equip it and watch your hoard grow...

sourceFields.name: Ancestral Seed of Life
sourceFields.str_version_22: Fantastic powers of verdant might have been combined with the building blocks of creation to forge this seed. Equip it and the bloom of life will bend to your will...

sourceFields.name: Ancestral Lens of Riches
sourceFields.str_version_22: Unrelenting luck and luxury have been combined with the building blocks of creation to forge this lens. Equip it and unstoppable fortune will be yours... but do be careful. Power tends to corrupt, after all.

sourceFields.name: Ghastly Robe
sourceFields.str_version_22: Clutching darkness whispers from the very essence of this dire robe. A mantle of unfathomable shadow, only the brave dare wear it, for it is marked by the haunting touch of the grave. We don't know where it came from - only that it must have been incredibly, deeply dark.

sourceFields.name: Scarecrow Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Act out your inner villain - or scare the bejeezus out of some birds - with this creepy harvest headgear. Who knew burlap and stitches could be so unsettling?

sourceFields.name: Rake
sourceFields.str_version_22: Tear up some topsoil with this handy home implement! Can anything really be better than punching, though?

sourceFields.name: Cloud Rabbit
sourceFields.str_version_22: Bunny bunny bunny cloud cloud cloud bunny cloud bunny cloud bunny bunny cloud cloud

sourceFields.name: Dryad
sourceFields.str_version_22: This pint-sized woodland sprite will defend the beauty of nature - and you - with all her adorable might! Just don't eat salads around  her - it's very insensitive.

sourceFields.name: Ancestral Totem of Wisdom : Level 2
sourceFields.str_version_22: Incredible forces of willpower and mental strength have been combined with the building blocks of creation to forge this totem. Equip it and ancient knowledge will be yours... Gives you an improved chance of getting double XP!

sourceFields.name: Ancestral Totem of Wisdom : Level 3
sourceFields.str_version_22: Incredible forces of willpower and mental strength have been combined with the building blocks of creation to forge this totem. Equip it and ancient knowledge will be yours... Gives you an uncommonly improved chance of getting double XP!

sourceFields.name: Ancestral Totem of Wisdom : Level 4
sourceFields.str_version_22: Incredible forces of willpower and mental strength have been combined with the building blocks of creation to forge this totem. Equip it and ancient knowledge will be yours... Gives you an extra-improved chance of getting double XP!

sourceFields.name: Ancestral Totem of Wisdom : Level 5
sourceFields.str_version_22: Incredible forces of willpower and mental strength have been combined with the building blocks of creation to forge this totem. Equip it and ancient knowledge will be yours... Gives you a super-improved chance chance of getting double XP!

sourceFields.name: Ancestral Totem of Wisdom : Level 6
sourceFields.str_version_22: Incredible forces of willpower and mental strength have been combined with the building blocks of creation to forge this totem. Equip it and ancient knowledge will be yours... Gives you a super-duper-improved chance chance of getting double XP!

sourceFields.str_version_22: Astonishing whirls of space and time have been combined with the building blocks of creation to forge this tesseract. Equip it and watch your hoard grow... Gives you an improved chance of dropping an additional block when breaking blocks!

sourceFields.name: Ancestral Seed of Life : Level 2
sourceFields.str_version_22: Fantastic powers of verdant might have been combined with the building blocks of creation to forge this seed. Equip it and the bloom of life will bend to your will... Improves the growth time for all seeds planted!

sourceFields.name: Ancestral Seed of Life : Level 3
sourceFields.str_version_22: Fantastic powers of verdant might have been combined with the building blocks of creation to forge this seed. Equip it and the bloom of life will bend to your will... Uncommonly improves the growth time for all seeds planted!

sourceFields.name: Ancestral Seed of Life : Level 4
sourceFields.str_version_22: Fantastic powers of verdant might have been combined with the building blocks of creation to forge this seed. Equip it and the bloom of life will bend to your will... Extra-improves the growth time for all seeds planted!

sourceFields.name: Ancestral Seed of Life : Level 5
sourceFields.str_version_22: Fantastic powers of verdant might have been combined with the building blocks of creation to forge this seed. Equip it and the bloom of life will bend to your will... Super-improves the growth time for all seeds planted!

sourceFields.name: Ancestral Seed of Life : Level 6
sourceFields.str_version_22: Fantastic powers of verdant might have been combined with the building blocks of creation to forge this seed. Equip it and the bloom of life will bend to your will... Super-duper-improves the growth time for all seeds planted!

sourceFields.str_version_22: Unrelenting luck and luxury have been combined with the building blocks of creation to forge this lens. Equip it and unstoppable fortune will be yours... but do be careful. Power tends to corrupt, after all... Gives you an improved chance of dropping extra gems!

sourceFields.name: Ancestral Lens of Riches : Level 3

Equip it and unstoppable fortune will be yours... but do be careful. Power tends to corrupt, after all... Gives you an uncommonly improved chance of dropping extra gems!

Equip it and unstoppable fortune will be yours... but do be careful. Power tends to corrupt, after all... Gives you a super-duper-improved chance of dropping extra gems!

sourceFields.name: Harvest Scarf
sourceFields.str_version_22: A whirling wisp of fabric to accent your perfect harvest style. Will also keep you warm with extra snuzzly fibers. Seriously, this thing is, like, TEN times snuzzlier than the next leading scarf.

sourceFields.name: Cloak of Falling Waters
sourceFields.str_version_22: Mystic whorls of water have been bound in shifting fabric to forge a cape fit for only the wettest, wildest Growtopians. Command one of the primeval elements through the Azure Gem of Waters pinned to this gorgeous cloak and use it to extinguish even the mightiest blazes. Or, y'know, spray people with it. It's your cape.

sourceFields.name: Demon Megalodon
sourceFields.str_version_22: Oh, what have you DONE?! This terrifying shark combines prehistoric predator power with the unholy corruption of Growganoth to create an unstoppable chomping machine! Class: DEMON-SIZED! See this shark in action in Hungry Shark World!

sourceFields.name: El Pollo Diablo
sourceFields.str_version_22: THE DEMON CHICKEN! A feathered fiend to scare and carry you to and fro! The best part? He'll absolutely peck you to death, just for fun! ...wait, that's bad.

sourceFields.name: Doom Plow
sourceFields.str_version_22: Are your crops not sufficiently terrified? Well, buckle up, because the power of Growganoth has overcharged the measely chicken plow into this fire-belching, flame-spewing monstrosity. Crazed chicken included. Do not operate while on prescription medication. Or for any other reason.

sourceFields.name: Killer Doctor's Smock
sourceFields.str_version_22: Calmly perform surgery in this horrific top. Your new and gruesome bedside manner will be an instant hit with those meat sack- uh, I mean, patients.

sourceFields.name: Killer Doctor's Cap
sourceFields.str_version_22: Terror is the new black! Nurse, pass me the scalpel!

sourceFields.name: Killer Doctor's Face Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Scare the bejeezus out of your patients with this deeply creepy surgeon's item. No unwanted surgery is complete without an evil mask to veil your villainous smile!

sourceFields.name: Killer Doctor's Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: Hit the dance floor - or the nearest surgery suite - in these breezy, yet unsettling scrubs. Nothing says comfort like a two-legged memento of your latest surgery success (or failure)!

sourceFields.name: Demon Clown Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Hey, don't run away! IT really hurts my feelings when everyone flees my festive presence!

sourceFields.name: Neon Voodoo Mask - Pure White
sourceFields.str_version_22: Electric voodoo stylings to put the frighteners on your friends! Now in woeful white!

sourceFields.name: Neon Voodoo Mask - Electric Blue
sourceFields.str_version_22: Electric voodoo stylings to put the frighteners on your friends! Now in blazing blue!

sourceFields.name: Neon Voodoo Mask - Shocking Pink
sourceFields.str_version_22: Electric voodoo stylings to put the frighteners on your friends! Now in petrifying pink!

sourceFields.name: Neon Voodoo Mask - Plasma Green
sourceFields.str_version_22: Electric voodoo stylings to put the frighteners on your friends! Now in ghastly green!

sourceFields.name: Fish Monster Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Ew! This thing is frilly, wet, and slimy - most places won't want you around in it, except maybe those hipster fish restaurants. May I recommend the "Black Lagoon Risotto"?

sourceFields.name: Demented Cowl
sourceFields.str_version_22: Make friends with the shadows in this crazed - yet cool - cowl of darkness! Looming darkness may give those who wear this creepy cloth a pass...

sourceFields.name: Headsman's Hood
sourceFields.str_version_22: Heading to a Halloween party and don't want your beautiful face to take attention away from everyone else? Hide it behind this creepy hood and sneak about in secret!

sourceFields.name: Neon Nerves
sourceFields.str_version_22: Check it out, chummer! Slap this colour-shifting circuitry under your skin and dazzle those dataslaves with wired speed! The only thing they'll catch is a trail of arctic light as you leave them in the dust!

sourceFields.name: Static Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: A shocking style, for sure, but there might be more to it than that! Maybe you should check to see if it reacts with any other electrical sources...

sourceFields.name: Amethyst Choker
sourceFields.str_version_22: Clasp your neck in this flawlessly cut piece of jewelwork, and be the envy of all.

sourceFields.name: Celestial Lance
sourceFields.str_version_22: Everyone's heard of crafting swords from fallen stars, but this incredible weapon is forged from the CONSTELLATIONS themselves, radiating with the might of the heavens. Vile corruption and ancient darkness are no match for the glory of this device, for it can banish them utterly.

sourceFields.name: Celestial Halo
sourceFields.str_version_22: Ripped from the heavens, stolen by demons, and now bequeathed to you. This miraculous crown will make you as light as the aether itself - a fitting gift for one who would stand against the darkness.

sourceFields.name: Turkey Onesie Hood
sourceFields.str_version_22: The crown of your turkey ensemble! Just don't lose your head over it! Gobble gobble gobble!

sourceFields.name: Turkey Onesie Body
sourceFields.str_version_22: No turkey is complete without a gobbly body, and this is the best you can find! Gobble gobble gobble!

sourceFields.name: Turkey Onesie Legs
sourceFields.str_version_22: Do the turkey trot with these gobble-tastic gams! Gobble gobble gobble!

sourceFields.name: Turkey Onesie Feet
sourceFields.str_version_22: Find your fall footing with these turkey toes! Gobble gobble gobble!

sourceFields.name: Turkey Carving Set
sourceFields.str_version_22: Reach out and get a handle on the holidays with a turkey touch! Gobble gobble gobble!

sourceFields.name: Turkey Onesie Tail
sourceFields.str_version_22: Look your Thanksgiving best with this wobbly tail! Gobble gobble gobble!

sourceFields.name: Turkey Onesie Beak
sourceFields.str_version_22: Peck your dinner to death - just like a real turkey! Gobble gobble gobble!

sourceFields.name: Zephyr Helm
sourceFields.str_version_22: We've captured mystic winds in gleaming gold and used super-complicated rituals to transform them into a helm fit for a king! Don't bother trying to figure out how we did it, though. We, uh, kinda lost the notes after someone left a window open.

sourceFields.name: Gingerbread Man
sourceFields.str_version_22: A deliciously dangerous Gingerbread Man. Watch out! He's full of anger - as well as sugar - and ready to defend you against all your holiday foes!

sourceFields.name: Ice Skates of Winter
sourceFields.str_version_22: Glide across the ice like a pro in these dashing ice skates. No more sliding around like a jerk!

sourceFields.name: Snowshoes
sourceFields.str_version_22: Perfect for trekking through snow and doubles up as a nice pair of rackets, if you get the urge to play some tennis while you're out on the tundra.

sourceFields.name: Sleigh of Winter
sourceFields.str_version_22: Everyone will want a ride on this luxurious winter sleigh, especially with your trusty Reindeer leading the way! (We recommend charging competitive rates and hiring a marketing firm for any new sleigh-focused business models).

sourceFields.name: Winter Frost Bow
sourceFields.str_version_22: Tired of shooting boring old arrows from stupid normal bows? Well THIS holiday beast of a bow shoots freezing ice shards! How cool is that?!

sourceFields.name: Ice Serpent Scarf
sourceFields.str_version_22: You might think a frosty ice serpent wouldn't be useful in the cold, but think again! This elegant creature will wrap your neck in so much friendship, you'll stay toasty warm all winter. Um, just don't let it snuggle you TOO hard...

sourceFields.name: Lumberjack Coat - Scarlet
sourceFields.str_version_22: Everybody toss on this scarlet coat and say: "I'm a lumberjack and I'm okay, I chop down trees and I work all day..."

sourceFields.name: Lumberjack Coat - Olive
sourceFields.str_version_22: Everybody toss on this olive coat and say: "I'm a lumberjack and I'm okay, I chop down trees and I work all day..."

sourceFields.name: Lumberjack Coat - Navy
sourceFields.str_version_22: Everybody toss on this navy coat and say: "I'm a lumberjack and I'm okay, I chop down trees and I work all day..."

sourceFields.name: Lumberjack Coat - Midnight
sourceFields.str_version_22: Everybody toss on this midnight coat and say: "I'm a lumberjack and I'm okay, I chop down trees and I work all day..."

sourceFields.name: Mountain Coat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Toss this on to keep warm and become one with the wilderness. Maybe try to befriend a bear while you're at it? No, that's crazy...

sourceFields.name: Mountain Cap
sourceFields.str_version_22: Whatever critter became this cap, I hope it was proud to know it would be forever immortalized as a sweet accessory for the top of your head.

sourceFields.name: Mountain Boots
sourceFields.str_version_22: Trudge through trackless forests and raging mountain rivers in these old-timey boots.

sourceFields.name: Parka Hood - Orange
sourceFields.str_version_22: Mmmph mmph mmph!

sourceFields.name: Parka Hood - Blue
sourceFields.str_version_22: Prevent your face from freezing off and avoid the embarrassing outcome of having icicles dangling from your nose with the help of this cozy blue parka hood.

sourceFields.name: Puffy Blue Jacket
sourceFields.str_version_22: If you ever saw a jacket and thought, "That's not NEARLY puffy enough for me," then this poofed-up piece of apparel will be perfect for you. Get it now to stay warm AND awesome all winter long!

sourceFields.name: Gross Golden Holiday Sweater
sourceFields.str_version_22: Finally, the most luxuriously horrible holiday sweater you've been waiting for. Your super-wealthy, ultra-classy grandma would be proud.

sourceFields.name: Silverstar Bow
sourceFields.str_version_22: Forged from stardust, aether winds, and purest silver, this beautiful bow belongs amongst the heavens - you must have been incredibly fortunate to count it among your possessions. Well, that or you're just a really good trader. Either way, let's shoot some stuff!

sourceFields.name: Rayman's Fist
sourceFields.str_version_22: The perfect punch! Ever wanted to send a disembodied fist flying across the land like Rayman? Well, now you can! Land a blow like none other with this furious fist. It even comes with a friend: Globox!

sourceFields.name: Rayman's Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: Halt your fall with this helicopter hair, courtesy of Rayman himself! How does it spin like that? And more importantly, how does it look so amazing?

sourceFields.name: Rayman's Hoodie
sourceFields.str_version_22: Stay warm and stylish with Rayman's personal hoodie. It even smells like him: waffles, vanilla, and determination!

sourceFields.name: Rayman's Shoes
sourceFields.str_version_22: Rayman's spectacular shoes are yours! These are a toe-tingling delight, with all kinds of padding and luxury features you'd expect from a platform-hopping pro like Rayman. Toss these on and enjoy comfortable - and stylish - foot-based movement from now on!

sourceFields.name: Rayman's Nose
sourceFields.str_version_22: Taking "Got your nose!" to a whole new level, aren't you? Somehow, some way, you've wound up with Rayman's nose! I hope he has a spare!

sourceFields.name: Equalizer Tee
sourceFields.str_version_22: Celebrate optimal sound balance and look great at the same time!

sourceFields.name: Ultra Equalizer Tee
sourceFields.str_version_22: This ultra version not only celebrates optimal sound balance, but it does it with mesmerizing movement! Ooh, the colors...

sourceFields.name: Flame Tee
sourceFields.str_version_22: Don't worry - no matter how realistic this t-shirt's flames may be, it won't light anything on fire! ...though you WILL look super hot!

sourceFields.name: Ultra Flame Tee
sourceFields.str_version_22: Don't let the flickering flames of this ultra version fool you - this shirt is NOT currently on fire! ...but your dance moves are!

sourceFields.name: Party Light Wave Vest
sourceFields.str_version_22: Be the light of the party with this bright and beautiful vest!

sourceFields.name: Ultra Party Light Wave Vest
sourceFields.str_version_22: Turn up the awesome with this ultra version - it'll really light up the night!

sourceFields.name: Party Style Top Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: This isn't just a great party hat - it's the GREATEST party hat. Top the evening (and your noggin) with this finely-honed piece of wearable art!

sourceFields.name: Ultra Party Glow Top Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: We've taken the greatest party hat known to science and given it an ultra upgrade. Okay, NOW this is clearly the best possible hat. How else could it be better?

sourceFields.name: Party Style Shades
sourceFields.str_version_22: Hypnotize your fellow Growtopians as they stare longingly into these dazzling shades!

sourceFields.name: Ultra Party Glow Shades
sourceFields.str_version_22: Take your party powers of shade-based hypnotism to the next level with this ultra version and never be friendless again!

sourceFields.name: Party Glow Sneakers
sourceFields.str_version_22: Light up the night - and the dance floor - by popping these hotly-glowing goodies over your toes!

sourceFields.name: Party Style Scarf
sourceFields.str_version_22: Wow, look at those colors! Ring your neck with the perfect party scarf.

sourceFields.name: Ultra Party Glow Scarf
sourceFields.str_version_22: Turn up the heat with this ultra version of the party scarf - just be careful the only thing you set on fire is the dance floor! Those bulbs get hot!

sourceFields.name: Maidmare
sourceFields.str_version_22: A terrifying creature forged by the awful effects of radiation! Your enemies will flee in terror from this creepy creature's mega fishy, slimetacular wet smooch attack!

sourceFields.name: Riding Double-Headed Angel-Devil Fish
sourceFields.str_version_22: Good heavens! This is one heck of a riding fish. Embodying the best (and worst) of the cosmos, this split-faced aberration loves giving good and bad advice while carrying you to and fro.

sourceFields.name: Double-Headed Angel-Devil Fish Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: Good heavens! This is one heck of a pet. Embodying the best (and worst) of the cosmos, this split-faced aberration loves giving good and bad advice while floating at your side.

sourceFields.name: Absolutely Real Elephant Fish Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: A genuine elephant fish pet that totally exists. Ha! Look at his silly nose! Will delight onlookers as it follows you around, dispensing wisdom and menacing peanut sellers.

sourceFields.name: Riding Cuttlefish
sourceFields.str_version_22: Writhing tentacles clear the way as you ride into town on this slimy beast! All shall tremble before your mighty fish- err... mollusc!

sourceFields.name: Cuttlefish Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: You may think this is a fish, but you'd be wrong! Cuttlefish are molluscs - but "Cuttlemollusc," doesn't quite roll off the tongue does it? Either way, it'll be happy to follow you around, no matter what you call it.

sourceFields.name: Riding Stonefish
sourceFields.str_version_22: Through careful training, one of the most poisonous fish in the world can now be ridden without fear! Careful, though - they're still quite pointy.

sourceFields.name: Stonefish Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: This is one of the most poisonous fish in the world... and you have it following you around?! You're crazy!

sourceFields.name: Riding Sand Shark
sourceFields.str_version_22: Out of the sand and happy on land, this sand shark has decided to let you ride it around. Isn't that nice of him?

sourceFields.name: Sand Shark Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: Out of the sand and happy on land, this sand shark has decided to follow you around like a toothy balloon. Isn't that nice of him?

sourceFields.name: Riding Seahorse
sourceFields.str_version_22: Neither fish nor horse, but after careful feeding, it's still a trusty steed! Ride this undersea mount into battle and become a Knight of the Seahorse! It's a very prestigious order, you know.

sourceFields.name: Seahorse Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: This rare fish is very hard to keep in an aquarium. Lucky for you, this is a videogame, and it's happy to float beside you and impress everyone who sees it!

sourceFields.name: Battle Gar
sourceFields.str_version_22: The snappiest, toothiest, chompin'est fish is out of the tank - and out for blood! This battle gar will chow down on your foes and bring you victory! ...just don't get too close to those snappy jaws!

sourceFields.name: Battle Mutant Fish
sourceFields.str_version_22: Strange mutations can make for the meanest fish, as this battling mutant will prove! Good thing it's on your side - with that extra eye, it can always keep a lookout while it takes down your foes!

sourceFields.name: Riding Alpha Great White Shark
sourceFields.str_version_22: How do you make the king predator of the sea even cooler? Toss a saddle on and ride them into the sunset, of course! Little-known fact: Great whites love Westerns, and secretly wish they could survive in the desert.

sourceFields.name: Alpha Great White Shark Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: The king predator of the sea will follow you around and watch your back. Take him on dates for an extra-romantic companion. Nobody can resist the owner of a deep sea terror, and this is one of the deepest, most terrifying things you can get!

sourceFields.name: Riding Weird Manta Ray
sourceFields.str_version_22: This voracious beast can now be ridden across the land, striking fear (and awe) into all who gaze upon it. Perfect for those who always wanted to ride a carpet with teeth.

sourceFields.name: Weird Manta Ray Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: Flapping wings curl through the air at your side, but this is no pet bird - it's a really creepy manta ray! Happy to be freed from toxic sludge, it floats beside you as a loyal friend.

sourceFields.name: Goldfish Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: These aren't made of gold, which is actually a good thing - otherwise they'd be too heavy to float beside you, looking all fishy and cool!

sourceFields.name: Catfish Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: Hey! It's not a real cat at all! It doesn't even purr! Well, at least it's friendly enough to follow you around. Here kitty!

sourceFields.name: Sunfish Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: If there's one fish that can brighten your day as it follows you around, this is it. Warning: Not a real sun.

sourceFields.name: Bass Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: Don't slap the bass - you'd just hurt it, and all it wants is to follow you around.

sourceFields.name: Mahi Mahi Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: The fish so nice they named it twice - now it will follow you around, and thrice as nice!

sourceFields.name: Dogfish Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: This adorable Dogfish will follow you around like a little lost puppy. They're so obedient!

sourceFields.name: Whale Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: This giant of the ocean is a mammal and extremely heavy - so how the heck does it float whilst following you around?

sourceFields.name: Picasso Triggerfish Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: Also known as Hawaii's state fish, the Humuhumunukunukuapua'a, which is probably the best name ever. Regardless of what you call it, it'll still follow you around with majestic grace.

sourceFields.name: Goldfish Bowler Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Who's to say you can't wear a goldfish on your head? Silly people, that's who. They just don't understand how great it is to rock a goldfish upstairs. Don't listen to them. They're not cool like you.

sourceFields.name: Catfish Slippers
sourceFields.str_version_22: The warmest, fluffiest fish-based slippers around, these are the cat's meow!

sourceFields.name: Dogfish Slippers
sourceFields.str_version_22: Arf! For times when your dogs are barkin', slide on a pair of these slippers and relax in fishy comfort.

sourceFields.name: Picasso Face
sourceFields.str_version_22: Someone's turned this triggerfish into a masterpiece for your face! Awesome!

sourceFields.name: Tentacle Beard
sourceFields.str_version_22: Arrrr, me hearties! Sail the seven seas with flailing tentacles on your face, and all will know your name and tremble before your rubbery glory.

sourceFields.name: Cupid Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: This cherubic companion brings romance wherever he goes! With feathery wings and a love-laced bow, he's an unstoppable source of sweetness.

sourceFields.name: Heart Shirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: Forget wearing your heart on your sleeve - put it right out there on your shirt so everyone can see how lovable you are!

sourceFields.name: Golden Heart Shirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: True heartthrobs don't just assume people will realize how amazing they are - they wear awesome animated shirts like this to show off their romantic might for them!

sourceFields.name: USMom's Talaria
sourceFields.str_version_22: Made to the exacting specifications of its angelic sponsor, these winged wonders will get you where you need to be in a blur of flapping finery! Sponsored by USMom.

sourceFields.name: Golden Talaria
sourceFields.str_version_22: For times when ordinary winged shoes won't do, pop these shining masterpieces on and show the world you're not just faster and flightier than the average footwearer - you're also fancier.

sourceFields.name: Heart Necklace
sourceFields.str_version_22: A heart that's incomplete is a symbol of want, of the need to belong, and that means this necklace is looking for a match. Find your valentine out there and be whole again!

sourceFields.name: Will of the Wild
sourceFields.str_version_22: The powerful forces of the wild elements; fire, water and earth live in this ethereal hair - just don't mention the air element! The mage that tamed these wild forces could never control his wind, and he's already the butt of all jokes at mage parties!

sourceFields.name: Drinks Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Celebrate alllll day - *hic* - long with this hands-free, extra-*hic*-strong drinking device. Urp. 'Scuse me.

sourceFields.name: Faerie Face Paint
sourceFields.str_version_22: Bring out your natural beauty and turn yourself into a true spirit of nature. You won't get magic powers from it, though - unless you count looking lovely as a power!

sourceFields.name: Irish Dance Dress
sourceFields.str_version_22: You might fling your shoes off when the spirit of the dance takes over, but at least you can be confident this dress will stay firmly on your body.

sourceFields.name: Rainbowfish Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: Nobody knows where the name of this fish came from - it's quite mysterious - but what we DO know is that it'll fill your world with happiness and glee as it follows you around.

sourceFields.name: Rainbow Cape
sourceFields.str_version_22: A mesmerizing rainbow ripple cape. Dazzle your friends!

sourceFields.name: Magical Rainbow Fishing Rod
sourceFields.str_version_22: Equip this and then use bait on water next to you to go fishing! All you have to do is wait for a bite, and then punch the fish before it escapes! If you miss, your bait is wasted, so punch fast. You will suffer mischievous effects when catching fish with this rod! Only found in Blarney 6 and 8.

sourceFields.name: Draconic Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Shimmering scales of pure power coat these marvelous wings, marking them as the sign of the truly fortunate. These give you the power to double jump... and look amazing. Fortune has smiled on you for possessing this! There are only 1300 in existence!

sourceFields.name: Red Dragon Head
sourceFields.str_version_22: The head of the dragon! What else could you add to this, I wonder...?

sourceFields.name: Red Dragon Body
sourceFields.str_version_22: The body of the dragon! See how long you can make it!

sourceFields.name: Red Dragon Legs
sourceFields.str_version_22: The legs of the dragon! See how long you can make it!

sourceFields.name: Red Dragon Tail
sourceFields.str_version_22: The tail of the dragon! An end, perhaps... or is it a new beginning?

sourceFields.name: Bunny Toy
sourceFields.str_version_22: You can never have enough cute bunnies! Carry this little guy with you wherever you go!

sourceFields.name: Pastel Dress - Blue
sourceFields.str_version_22: Spring fashion has arrived! 'Tis the seasons for brightening skies, growing seeds, and this blue pastel dress!

sourceFields.name: Pastel Dress - Pink
sourceFields.str_version_22: Spring fashion has arrived! 'Tis the seasons for brightening skies, growing seeds, and this pink pastel dress!

sourceFields.name: Pastel Dress - Purple
sourceFields.str_version_22: Spring fashion has arrived! 'Tis the seasons for brightening skies, growing seeds, and this purple pastel dress!

sourceFields.name: Pastel Dress - Orange
sourceFields.str_version_22: Spring fashion has arrived! 'Tis the seasons for brightening skies, growing seeds, and this orange pastel dress!

sourceFields.name: Pastel Dress - Yellow
sourceFields.str_version_22: Spring fashion has arrived! 'Tis the seasons for brightening skies, growing seeds, and this yellow pastel dress!

sourceFields.name: Pastel Dress - Aqua
sourceFields.str_version_22: Spring fashion has arrived! 'Tis the seasons for brightening skies, growing seeds, and this aqua pastel dress!

sourceFields.name: Pastel Dress - Green
sourceFields.str_version_22: Spring fashion has arrived! 'Tis the seasons for brightening skies, growing seeds, and this green pastel dress!

sourceFields.name: Pastel Tie
sourceFields.str_version_22: Show your business side this spring with a power pastel tie! That promotion is yours!

sourceFields.name: Totally Legit Bunnyfish Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: Amazing! You have trained the incredibly rare, elusive, and completely real Bunnyfish! 100% cute, 0% fake!

sourceFields.name: Totally Legit Bunny Ears
sourceFields.str_version_22: These totally legit ears somehow allow you to have your actual ears too. Now that's bunny magic!

sourceFields.name: Bear Spirit
sourceFields.str_version_22: You are one with your spirit animal! The awesome guidance of the Bear Spirit has given you the gift of double jump! Which is something wild bears do. Don't look it up. Just trust us.

sourceFields.name: Rainbow Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: Style your hair in shimmering rainbow light to amuse your friends and infuriate Leprechauns. Also works great for reading late at night.

sourceFields.name: Intergalactic Warrior Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: YOUR HAIR IS NOW PURE POWER AND THAT POWER IS OVER NINE THOUSAAAAAAAAAAND! BELIEVE IN THIS HAIR, FOR THIS HAIR BELIEVES IN YOU!

sourceFields.name: Whip of Truth
sourceFields.str_version_22: Whirling with wisdom and knowledge long forgotten, the Whip of Truth can pull secrets from the very air - AND those you whap with it! Under its gleaming golden might, no falsehoods can survive...

sourceFields.name: Ring Of Shrinking
sourceFields.str_version_22: Become your very own Mini-You! Fool your friends with this amazing optical illusion, now with complete lack of particle emitters! Once again, we reiterate that this is an illusion - Growtech accepts no responsibility for users getting stuck in tight spaces (or inability to use auras convincingly).

sourceFields.name: Axolotl Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: Kudos to you! You've trained a fish that's actually a salamander! Now that he's worldly and wise, this mighty little Mexican salamander is all too happy to follow you around!

sourceFields.name: Riding Axolotl
sourceFields.str_version_22: After some intensive training, this cute little Mexican critter can now be ridden across the land - and he's stronger than he looks. Ride through town and give a jaunty wave to jealous passersby from atop this majestic steed!

sourceFields.name: Riding Fiesta Axolotl
sourceFields.str_version_22: What's this now? The cute little Mexican critter is wearing a sombrero? Well, things just got a whole lot more adorable, didn't they?

sourceFields.name: Feather Headdress
sourceFields.str_version_22: If you're the slightest bit ticklish, stay away from this flamboyant, feather-adorned headgear. If not, then wear it with grace and become The Tickle Master!

sourceFields.name: Fiesta Mariachi Guitar
sourceFields.str_version_22: Bring the party everywhere you go. When you /dance with this, you can perform for your friends!

sourceFields.name: Bandolier
sourceFields.str_version_22: The favored garb of a legendary outlaw, this is the perfect gear for rustling cattle, robbing trains, and - surprisingly - afternoon tea. Who knew?

sourceFields.name: Dual Six-Shooters
sourceFields.str_version_22: Did you shoot 11 bullets... or 12? Trick question: These guns never run out! Sure, NONE of Growtopia's guns ever run out, but these come loaded with extra grit and vigor! Yahoo!

sourceFields.name: Spirit Guide
sourceFields.str_version_22: This little ghost will guide you on your travels, and he'll even reduce the chance of a Spirit Board breaking when summoning ghosts! Aww, isn't that nice of him?

sourceFields.name: Neutron Power Glove
sourceFields.str_version_22: Summons deadly spectral energies to give you the awesome power to punch ghosts dead! Well, again. Actually, we're not sure where they go... but they're not happy about it!

sourceFields.name: Foil Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Paranoid there's someone out there, inclined to meddle with your mind? Don this fancy little hat and fear no more! Its foily goodness will protect you from even the most powerful mind control!

sourceFields.name: Pineapple Fish Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: This sweet (and slightly sour) fish has flopped out of the tropical waters it calls home and onto a leash! Take him out for your next luau!

sourceFields.name: Pineapple Tiki Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Show off your pineapple spirit with this leering mask! Looks just as great on a shelf as it does on your face! Wait... was this actually a fish at one point?

sourceFields.name: Pineapple Spear
sourceFields.str_version_22: Now you're playing with pine-power! Wield the true might of the pineapple and blast blocks into oblivion with this delicious spear!

sourceFields.name: Pine-ch Buggy
sourceFields.str_version_22: Part car, part pineapple, all style. There might be a lot of cars on the road, but none can compare to the four-wheeled fury of the Pine-ch Buggy!

sourceFields.name: Super Pineapple Guardian Charm
sourceFields.str_version_22: Pining for protection? Make the power of the pineapple guardian personal with this amazing necklace! When activated, grants immunity to thrown consumables for 5 seconds (starts as soon as you get hit), followed by a 5-minute cooldown.

sourceFields.name: Aurora Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Glowing with the majesty of the high heavens, these wings shift and shimmer with all the colors of a wild aurora. They also send out shimmering motes of light, which not only look amazing, but also make everything 200% more sparkly!

sourceFields.name: Tunic - Royal Red
sourceFields.str_version_22: Rocking the clothing world for thousands of years and still going strong, this tunic isn't just a medieval fashion statement: It's also red.

sourceFields.name: Tunic - Royal Blue
sourceFields.str_version_22: Rocking the clothing world for thousands of years and still going strong, this tunic isn't just a medieval fashion statement: It's also blue.

sourceFields.name: Tunic - Royal Green
sourceFields.str_version_22: Rocking the clothing world for thousands of years and still going strong, this tunic isn't just a medieval fashion statement: It's also green.

sourceFields.name: Guild Steed
sourceFields.str_version_22: A trusty steed for a trusted guildmate! Collect one for all your allies and have a parade! Or keep them all to yourself and taunt your friends. Either way, this horse is just happy to help.

sourceFields.name: Guild Night Stallion
sourceFields.str_version_22: A mighty steed for a mighty guild. This midnight mount has giant hooves and an even bigger attitude. Perfect for real leaders!

sourceFields.name: Architect's Robes
sourceFields.str_version_22: Keep warm long into the night with these well-tailored robes. Perfect for workaholic architects who want to jot down just a few more diagrams before bedtime!

sourceFields.name: Architect's Compass
sourceFields.str_version_22: Keep your finest tools close at hand by putting them around your neck on a chain! Looks pretty blingin' too, which, as any architect will tell you, is a must-have for neckwear.

sourceFields.name: Architect's Beret
sourceFields.str_version_22: Cover up your wispy architect hair with this classy beret, ensuring the whole world will know you're cultured, and making it less likely for them to guess you're bald.

sourceFields.name: Architect's Beard
sourceFields.str_version_22: No master of diagrams and charts can be trusted unless they also have a big, highly-educated beard to back them up. Now THAT'S the face of an architect!

sourceFields.name: Anomalizing Reliable Hammer
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected blocks, and guaranteed to never break!

sourceFields.name: Anomalizing Pristine Hammer
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected blocks! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break! Use with care!

sourceFields.name: Exquisite Hammer
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected blocks!

sourceFields.name: Anomalizing Reliable Scythe
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected trees, and guaranteed to never break!

sourceFields.name: Anomalizing Pristine Scythe
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected trees! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break! Use with care!

sourceFields.name: Exquisite Scythe
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected trees!

sourceFields.name: Anomalizing Reliable Bone Saw
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected patients, and guaranteed to never break!

sourceFields.name: Anomalizing Pristine Bone Saw
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected patients! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break! Use with care!

sourceFields.name: Exquisite Bone Saw
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected patients!

sourceFields.name: Reliable Anomarod
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected fish, and guaranteed to never break!

sourceFields.name: Pristine Anomarod
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected fish! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break! Use with care!

sourceFields.name: Exquisite Anomarod
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected fish! This exquisite rod will catch 10% bigger fish than normal.

sourceFields.name: Amulet of Force
sourceFields.str_version_22: The mystic Jewel of Might empowers this amulet, lending its supernatural strength to the wearer and giving them a little extra oomph when they want to break stuff!

sourceFields.name: Glove of the Giants
sourceFields.str_version_22: A big glove demands a big owner, but this glove takes it a step further - it'll MAKE you bigger! Slip the glove on and send the might of the giants coursing through your veins. You'll be towering over your friends and squashing your problems like bugs in no time!

sourceFields.name: Summer Blaster Shirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: Rock the season with the new Summer Blaster style! This shirt doesn't just say you're cool - it also says you're hot! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...

sourceFields.name: Ultra Summer Blaster Shirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: Rock the season in ULTRA Summer Blaster style! This shirt doesn't just say you're ULTRA COOL - it also says you're ULTRA HOT! Try to find another line of clothing that can do both, and in such an ultra way! Go on, I'll wait...

sourceFields.name: Summer Blaster Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: Rock the season with the new Summer Blaster style! These pants don't just say you're cool - they also say you're hot! Try to find another line of clothing that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...

sourceFields.name: Ultra Summer Blaster Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: Rock the season in ULTRA Summer Blaster style! These pants don't just say you're ULTRA COOL - they also say you're ULTRA HOT! Try to find another line of clothing that can do both, and in such an ultra way! Go on, I'll wait...

sourceFields.name: Flaming Aura
sourceFields.str_version_22: Strap on this awesome item and prepare to receive an aura of brilliant fire energy! Also, double-jump power. We're not sure how that part works.

sourceFields.name: Raptor Legs
sourceFields.str_version_22: Everybody do the dinosaur! Pop on these prehistoric legs and leap into the fray with all the speed of an angry raptor! Just be careful, or you might go out the same way - with a fiery meteor!

sourceFields.name: Smoog the Great Dragon
sourceFields.str_version_22: Ancient flames and armored scales await your command! Smoog is a proud and fearsome beast, but he's decided to allow you - yes, YOU - to have the honor of being his rider! Who needs horses or cars when you can sit astride a mighty DRAGON?

sourceFields.name: Dancemaster's Crown
sourceFields.str_version_22: Let's boogie! Nobody can resist the awesome beat of the DANCEMASTER - and when you wear this gleaming helm, that's you! Use its funky power to get everybody's groove on and start a dance party at the drop of a hat! This hat, specifically.

sourceFields.name: Summer Blaster Glasses
sourceFields.str_version_22: Rock the season with the new Summer Blaster style! These glasses don't just say you're cool - they also say you're hot! Try to find another kind of eyewear that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...

sourceFields.name: Ultra Summer Blaster Glasses
sourceFields.str_version_22: Rock the season in ULTRA Summer Blaster style! These glasses don't just say you're ULTRA COOL - they also say you're ULTRA HOT! Try to find another kind of eyewear that can do both, and in such an ultra way! Go on, I'll wait...

sourceFields.name: Beach Ball
sourceFields.str_version_22: Inflated with extra summer fun! Bounce this onto the beach and relax in the sun and sand!

sourceFields.name: Watermelon Slice
sourceFields.str_version_22: Juicy and sweet, but definitely NOT seedless! Take a bite and get ready to blast the world with weaponized watermelon!

sourceFields.name: Phoenix Sword
sourceFields.str_version_22: Swirling flame and eternal glory are yours, for you possess the blade of emperors: The Phoenix Sword! Astonishingly rare, incredibly powerful, and explosively sharp, this weapon will proclaim its wielder as a force to be reckoned with! Wield it well, for you are worthy. There are only 500 of them in existence, in all of Growtopia!

sourceFields.name: Firefin Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: This blazing fish is out of the water and at your side, happy to light your way with glowing gills and searing scales!

sourceFields.name: Flaming Floaties
sourceFields.str_version_22: Not a strong swimmer? Toss these fire-themed floaties on and keep your arms dry! At least they'll be okay! Not sure about the rest of you, though...

sourceFields.name: Danieldd's Chimera Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Forged from bladed feathers of flame and fury, these wings will let you tear through the skies with the might of the chimera! Sponsored by Danieldd!

sourceFields.name: Mighty Tiger
sourceFields.str_version_22: The terror of dark jungles and rustling fields has been tamed! This awesome beast comes to you from distant lands, willing to lend its primal might - and incredible stride - to your efforts! Rise up to the challenge of your rivals with your new feline friend!

sourceFields.name: Startopian Empire - Uniform Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: Are you ready to travel the stars? To explore strange new worlds and fight for the glory of Startopia? Then you'll need to look the part! These pants are vacuum-pressed and ready for space - get the rest of your uniform together and enlist today!

sourceFields.name: Startopian Empire - Uniform Mini-Skirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: Are you ready to travel the stars? To explore strange new worlds and fight for the glory of Startopia? Then you'll need to look the part! This mini-skirt is expertly tailored and ready for space - get the rest of your uniform together and enlist today!

sourceFields.name: Startopian Empire - Command Class Uniform
sourceFields.str_version_22: Show everyone you're a ranked officer of Startopia! Those who bear the Command Class uniform have excellent leadership and political abilities. Wearing this also provides a slight boost to your ship rating for all Reputation-based skill checks!

sourceFields.name: Startopian Empire - Engineer Class Uniform
sourceFields.str_version_22: Show everyone you're a ranked officer of Startopia! Those who bear the Engineer Class uniform have excellent maintenance and systems abilities. Wearing this also provides a slight boost to your ship rating for all Ship Health-based skill checks!

sourceFields.name: Startopian Empire - Medic Class Uniform
sourceFields.str_version_22: Show everyone you're a ranked officer of Startopia! Those who bear the Medic Class uniform have excellent personnel and healing abilities. Wearing this also provides a slight boost to your ship rating for all Crew-based skill checks!

sourceFields.name: Startopian Empire - Phase Blaster
sourceFields.str_version_22: Cut down vile Xenoid raiders, defend yourself against Greezak hunters, and make pirates shake in their stolen boots with a blast of hot plasma from a Startopian blaster! For the Empire! Made on Proxima Centauri II. All space rights reserved.

6352.name: Startopian Empire - Combat Troop Mk.II Helmet

sourceFields.name: Startopian Empire - Combat Troop Mk.II Helmet
sourceFields.str_version_22: This helm will keep your noggin safe from all kinds of extraterrestrial threats, like the brain-sucking mosquitorrasques of Vreebin VII! Show everyone you're a loyal soldier of Startopia with the official Mk.II Combat Troop outfit!

6354.name: Startopian Empire - Combat Troop Mk.II Body Armor

sourceFields.name: Startopian Empire - Combat Troop Mk.II Body Armor
sourceFields.str_version_22: This body armor will keep your torso safe from all kinds of extraterrestrial threats, like the heart-stealing shadowfiends of Xarhoom IX! Show everyone you're a loyal soldier of Startopia with the official Mk.II Combat Troop outfit!

6356.name: Startopian Empire - Combat Troop Mk.II Leg Armor

sourceFields.name: Startopian Empire - Combat Troop Mk.II Leg Armor
sourceFields.str_version_22: These plated pants will keep your legs safe from all kinds of extraterrestrial threats, like the bone-melting lava worms of Multak VIII! Show everyone you're a loyal soldier of Startopia with the official Mk.II Combat Troop outfit!

sourceFields.name: Startopian Empire - Combat Rifle
sourceFields.str_version_22: This combat rifle will mow down alien hordes and toast a mean marshmallow, but only when fired in the name of the Emperor! All hail Startopia! Made on Gliese III. Firing upon giraffes will void warranty.

sourceFields.name: Greezak Horde - Warrior Helmet
sourceFields.str_version_22: The fearsome warriors of the Greezak Horde welcome you to the hunt! This helmet is styled in the traditional manner of the Greezak, with plenty of breathing room and a pocket for snacks.

sourceFields.name: Greezak Horde - Warrior Armor
sourceFields.str_version_22: The fearsome warriors of the Greezak Horde welcome you to the hunt! This armor has been retailored to fit your Growtopian body, as the Greezak have a few extra limbs. All the better to catch their prey, you see.

sourceFields.name: Greezak Horde - Warrior Leg Armor
sourceFields.str_version_22: The fearsome warriors of the Greezak Horde welcome you to the hunt! These leg plates are aerodynamic and whisper-quiet, perfect for a hunting party (or a late-night snack run).

sourceFields.name: Greezak Horde - Skull Necklace
sourceFields.str_version_22: The fearsome warriors of the Greezak Horde welcome you to the hunt! This necklace of trophies was taken from a veteran Greezak, and chronicles the results of his many successful (and delicious) hunts.

sourceFields.name: Greezak Horde - Shoulder Cannon
sourceFields.str_version_22: Lock onto your prey and fire! This incredibly deadly shoulder cannon is designed to leave a Greezak warrior's hands free so he can fight and fire at the same time! The plasma bolts it shoots are low-energy, so they don't ruin animal pelts.

sourceFields.name: LordStar Environment Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: The mask of a daring outlaw king! Raid ancient alien treasures and splash your name across the cosmos from behind this fantastic mask! All will (probably) remember you!

sourceFields.name: Space Thruster Boost Boots
sourceFields.str_version_22: Zip through space and hover like a champ with these high-tech boost boots! Thanks to a HyperTech dynamo core, these can keep you off the ground forever, meaning you'll never have dirty shoes again! Now THAT'S progress!

sourceFields.name: Alien Mind Protector
sourceFields.str_version_22: Alien in your brain! Alien in your brain! Thankfully, this is one of the few times that's actually a good thing, because you're fortunate enough to have a Mind Protector along for the ride! This clever controller will keep your gray matter safe from those who might try to mess with your thoughts!

sourceFields.name: MagTron LightCycle
sourceFields.str_version_22: Flaring with HyperTech superluminal banding and an everlasting reactor, this bike is unstoppably cool AND eco-friendly. It'll never run out of juice, and as long as you're riding it, you'll never be out of style.

sourceFields.name: Ferungi Ears
sourceFields.str_version_22: A race of a galactic merchants and business dealers, the Ferungi love to chat. That's why their ears are so huge - they never want to miss a conversation (or a potential trade secret)!

sourceFields.name: Volcanix Ears
sourceFields.str_version_22: Very pointy! And the pointier the ears, the wiser the Volcanix, as they say. The founding race of the Stellarix Union, the Volcanix are a deeply pragmatic and calculating people with long lifespans. These factors have led them to become distant, even detached from galactic affairs, which is why it's up to the Startopian Empire to keep the peace!

6382.name: Startopian Empire - Force Shield & Phase Blaster

sourceFields.name: Startopian Empire - Force Shield & Phase Blaster
sourceFields.str_version_22: The most advanced personal combat gear ever designed for Startopian Special Forces, this blaster/shield combination uses re-engineered HyperTech repulsors to deflect attacks and keep their wielder safe even as they unleash blazing lances of plasma on their foes! When activated, grants immunity to thrown consumables for 5 seconds (starts as soon as you get hit), followed by a 30-minute cooldown.

sourceFields.name: Robot Legs
sourceFields.str_version_22: Tired of using your boring human legs like a sucker? Well, fear not, because the advanced surgical teams of the Stellarix Union have crafted these incredible robot legs to take you to and fro without having to waste a single calorie! Powered by Stellithium X9 battery nodes and guaranteed to work for 2 billion steps or your buckazoids back, these legs will keep on walking long after you drop!

sourceFields.name: World Cup Cleats
sourceFields.str_version_22: Tap the ball into the goal and bask in the adoration of your fans with these eye-catching cleats!

sourceFields.name: Ref's Jersey
sourceFields.str_version_22: Foul! Make the call with this jersey - you have to be right, because you're striped!

sourceFields.name: World Cup Winner's Jersey 2018
sourceFields.str_version_22: To make this jersey, we had to steal a sports almanac from the distant future and used it to find the winners of this year's World Cup! Allez Les Bleus!

sourceFields.name: Super Utility Helmet - Red
sourceFields.str_version_22: Start seeing red with this superheroic helm!

sourceFields.name: Super Utility Shirt - Red
sourceFields.str_version_22: Stop crime and look great! It's a super shirt for a super Growtopian!

sourceFields.name: Super Utility Tights - Red
sourceFields.str_version_22: Toss on these tights for a beautiful - yet breathable - superhero style!

sourceFields.name: Super Utility Belt
sourceFields.str_version_22: Keep all your superheroing gadgets close at hand and well-organized with this helpful utility belt! Oh, and keep your pants up, too. That's important for fighting crime.

sourceFields.name: Super Utility Boots - Red
sourceFields.str_version_22: Give evil the boot with our newest line of fighting footwear! Now in rebellious red!

sourceFields.name: Super Utility Helmet - Yellow
sourceFields.str_version_22: Hide your identity with this yellow helmet - but not your might!

sourceFields.name: Super Utility Shirt - Yellow
sourceFields.str_version_22: It may be yellow, but you certainly aren't - show the world you care about looking great while fighting crime!

sourceFields.name: Super Utility Tights - Yellow
sourceFields.str_version_22: Your legs will look wonderful - and yellow - with these sparkling new tights!

sourceFields.name: Super Utility Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: All-purpose utility wings to carry you onto the heads of your villainous foes from on high!

sourceFields.name: Super Utility Boots - Yellow
sourceFields.str_version_22: Give evil the boot with our newest line of fighting footwear! Now in youthful yellow!

sourceFields.name: Summer Blaster Mohawk
sourceFields.str_version_22: Rock the season with the new Summer Blaster style! This mohawk doesn't just say you're cool - it also says you're hot! Try to find another kind of hairstyle that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...

sourceFields.name: Ultra Summer Blaster Mohawk
sourceFields.str_version_22: Rock the season in ULTRA Summer Blaster Style! This mohawk don't just say you're ULTRA COOL - it also says you're ULTRA HOT! Try to find another kind of hairstyle that can do both, and in such an ultra way! Go on, i'll wait...

sourceFields.name: Squirrel King
sourceFields.str_version_22: All shall kneel before the nuttiest ruler of all: YOU! Wield the twitchy might of the squirrel empire with this wondrous tail. Acorns are your ammunition, the trees are your home, and the world is your kingdom. Go forth and chitter with pride!

sourceFields.name: Scepter of the Honor Guard
sourceFields.str_version_22: Guards! Guards! Assemble the troops with a wave of this lordly scepter! Your foes will run in terror before you and your gang of guardians!

sourceFields.name: Cloak of Hoveration
sourceFields.str_version_22: Say hello to the friendliest threads around! This cape will take you to and fro with style, and happily yank you high into the air whenever you desire! It's like a very loyal blanket, but with a touch of magic to make your day extra lofty!

sourceFields.name: Rara Skirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: You'll be a "rara" beauty when you don this skirt! Who can resist those colors?

sourceFields.name: Little Red Hoodie
sourceFields.str_version_22: My, what fine fashion you have! This hoodie will keep you warm and, more importantly, looking great in all kinds of weather!

sourceFields.name: Big Bad Blue Hoodie
sourceFields.str_version_22: Time to huff, puff, and blue your hood down! This hoodie will keep you warm and, more importantly, looking great in all kinds of weather!

sourceFields.name: Punk Purple Hoodie
sourceFields.str_version_22: Break out of the routine and set your own style (as long as it's purple)! This hoodie will keep you warm and, more importantly, looking great in all kinds of weather!
