sourceFields.name: Dabstep Low Top Sneakers
sourceFields.str_version_22: Light up every footfall and move to a better beat with these dabulous shoes! When you're wearing these, the world is your dance floor!

sourceFields.name: Horns of Infinity
sourceFields.str_version_22: Ripped from the endless gulf between the stars, these twisted horns still carry a touch of hyperspace! They'll accelerate you into the great beyond, but just remember - when you stare into the void... the void stares back!

sourceFields.name: Rhinestone Evening Dress
sourceFields.str_version_22: All eyes will be on you when you stride into the ballroom in this vintage dress! It sparkles and shines like a constellation, setting you among the stars!

sourceFields.name: Plaid Skirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: Perfectly plaid for the budding lady lumberjack in you!

sourceFields.name: Peplum Top
sourceFields.str_version_22: A cute color for an even cuter Growtopian!

sourceFields.name: Stripy Jumpsuit
sourceFields.str_version_22: They say stripes are slimming, but nobody ever mentioned how good they look on you!

sourceFields.name: French Maid's Dress
sourceFields.str_version_22: Ooh la la! Grab your feather duster and put on your best French accent, because this dress is made to impress! Oui, mademoiselle!

sourceFields.name: Twintail Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: When one tail o' hair just won't do, try doubling up with these twins! Your locks never looked so good!

sourceFields.name: Braided Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: As bright, fresh, and braided as a fine pastry, this hair doesn't just look stylish - it also looks DELICIOUS.

sourceFields.name: Growmoji Face Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: When you're tired of using all those crazy facial muscles, this mask is here to help! Hide your tired human face with this reliable, totally-not-creepy one instead!

sourceFields.name: Pet Rock
sourceFields.str_version_22: Brought to you by popular demand, meet the most playful, incredibly popular, and astonishingly amazing friend for all Growtopians... A ROCK! All sales final.

sourceFields.name: Bubble Gun
sourceFields.str_version_22: Pop! Pop! Bring a boatload of bubbles to any occasion with this poppin' fresh firearm!

sourceFields.name: Oink-Oink Nose
sourceFields.str_version_22: Got a nose for food? Or is it truffles? Either way, for those who need to show the world their piggy powers, this nose knows best!

sourceFields.name: Bubblicious Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: Dying for that fresh-out-of-the-bubble-bath look? Well, die no more! Top your melon with these bodacious bubbles and LIVE! Whoever snagged this hairdo had to be quick so the bubbles wouldn't pop and super-chilly so they'd stay in place, all to bring it to you!

sourceFields.name: Fire Punk Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: Are you fed up with the status quo? Want to burn the system and start anew? Then start with your hair! This sizzling style will show you're not just a thorn in the system - you're making anarchy look GOOD. Whoever snagged this hairdo had to be quick so the flames wouldn't go out and super-hot so they'd stay bright, all to bring it to you!

sourceFields.name: Nightwings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Wrap yourself in harrowing darkness and take to the skies! These wings are spun from midnight shadows, harvested from those with a touch of the starry void in their souls - dare you wear them?

sourceFields.name: Crystal Shard Necklace
sourceFields.str_version_22: Shimmering crystals and gems to adorn only the fanciest of necks! Strangely magnetic, these crystals must amplify the personal pull of those who wear them! Careful, though - these shards are sharp!

sourceFields.name: Anomalizing Reliable Trowel
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected blocks, and guaranteed to never break!

sourceFields.name: Anomalizing Pristine Trowel
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected blocks! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break! Use with care!

sourceFields.name: Exquisite Trowel
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected blocks!

sourceFields.name: Anomalizing Reliable Cultivator
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected splices, and guaranteed to never break!

sourceFields.name: Anomalizing Pristine Cultivator
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected splices! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break! Use with care!

sourceFields.name: Exquisite Cultivator
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected splices!

sourceFields.name: Dreamcatcher Staff
sourceFields.str_version_22: Empowered by bountiful spirits from the Other Side, this delicate dreamcatcher will grant its wielder clear skies... and 2% chance of getting extra blocks from harvesting trees!

sourceFields.name: Raven Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: CAW! Feathers dropped by a dark valkyrie have been collected and reforged to make these gorgeous wings. Richly dark with velvet tips, they'll cut through the skies and tickle your hands!

sourceFields.name: Amber Necklace
sourceFields.str_version_22: The ancient magic of this necklace calls back to the creatures of a long-lost age, bringing them closer to your world! Gives you a 5% chance of getting double fossils when smashing Fossil Rocks!

sourceFields.name: Ring of Nature
sourceFields.str_version_22: The call of the wild... in the palm of your hand! Wear this ring and enjoy a special bond with all things that grow! Reduces the grow time of seeds by 2% when planting or splicing!

sourceFields.name: Luminous Eyes
sourceFields.str_version_22: My, what crazy eyes you have! Besides looking amazing, these pristine peepers give you a bonus 2.5% chance of finding crystals using a Geiger Counter!

sourceFields.name: Raw Gauntlet of Elements
sourceFields.str_version_22: This incredibly strong gauntlet was designed for a single purpose: To hold the six Elemental Stones. While each stone is very powerful individually, combining their might in this gauntlet will grant the wearer the ability to manipulate the very building blocks of reality! Be warned, however, for adding a stone to this gauntlet requires the sacrifice of a soul in similar form. Doing so will bind the Elemental Stone to the guantlet and focus its power!

sourceFields.name: Gauntlet of Elements - Tier I
sourceFields.str_version_22: This incredibly strong gauntlet was designed for a single purpose: To hold the six Elemental Stones. It currently holds the Earth Stone and can move any block with Earth Chi. This is only the beginning, though - there are more stones to be found! Be warned, however, for adding a stone to this gauntlet requires the sacrifice of a soul in similar form. Doing so will bind the Elemental Stone to the guantlet and focus its power!

sourceFields.name: Gauntlet of Elements - Tier II
sourceFields.str_version_22: This incredibly strong gauntlet was designed for a single purpose: To hold the six Elemental Stones. It currently holds the Earth and Wind Stones and can move any block with Earth or Wind Chi. This is only the beginning, though - there are more stones to be found! Be warned, however, for adding a stone to this gauntlet requires the sacrifice of a soul in similar form. Doing so will bind the Elemental Stone to the guantlet and focus its power!

sourceFields.name: Gauntlet of Elements - Tier III
sourceFields.str_version_22: This incredibly strong gauntlet was designed for a single purpose: To hold the six Elemental Stones. It currently holds the Earth, Wind, and Fire Stones and can move any block with Earth, Wind, or Fire Chi. Now we're getting somewhere! More stones await, however, and don't forget: Adding a stone to this gauntlet requires the sacrifice of a soul in similar form. Doing so will bind the Elemental Stone to the guantlet and focus its power!

sourceFields.name: Gauntlet of Elements - Tier IV
sourceFields.str_version_22: This incredibly strong gauntlet was designed for a single purpose: To hold the six Elemental Stones. It currently holds the Earth, Wind, Fire, and Death Stones and can move any block with Earth, Wind, or Fire Chi. It also now seals its bearer's fate, snatching them away from the mortal plane upon their demise! Now we're getting somewhere! More stones await, however, and don't forget: Adding a stone to this gauntlet requires the sacrifice of a soul in similar form. Doing so will bind the Elemental Stone to the guantlet and focus its power!

sourceFields.name: Gauntlet of Elements - Tier V
sourceFields.str_version_22: This incredibly strong gauntlet was designed for a single purpose: To hold the six Elemental Stones. It currently holds the Earth, Wind, Fire, Water, and Death Stones and can now move nearly any block! It also now seals its bearer's fate, snatching them away from the mortal plane upon their demise! It's nearly complete now! Only a single stone awaits, and don't forget: Adding a stone to this gauntlet requires the sacrifice of a soul in similar form. Doing so will bind the Elemental Stone to the guantlet and focus its power!

sourceFields.name: Exquisite Gauntlet of Elements
sourceFields.str_version_22: Behold: The completed Gauntlet of Elements! Empowered by the might of the Earth, Wind, Fire, Water, Life, and Death Stones, it allows its wielder to move nearly any block, seals their fate upon their demise, and with the Life Stone, brings them back through a resurrection rift! A truly awe-inspiring relic, this must have taken tremendous effort to create. Any who possess it are mighty, indeed. All hail!

sourceFields.name: Sorcerer's Tunic of Mystery
sourceFields.str_version_22: Capable of reflecting the true colors of the world around it, this rare tunic is made of captured starlight and aether. If you think knitting with thread is hard, just try doing it with moonbeams and magic! The result is worth it though, as these clothes won't just make you look amazing - you'll be able to channel their inherent power into blasts of cosmic energy!

sourceFields.name: Yellow Hardhat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Show off your builder bona fides and keep your noggin safe with this bright and beautiful hat!

sourceFields.name: Munchin' Straw
sourceFields.str_version_22: Show off your farmer flair and enjoy a long-lasting snack with this tasty wheat!

sourceFields.name: EMT Jumpsuit
sourceFields.str_version_22: Show off your surgery skills and dress for the next big emergency with this hypoallergenic coverall!

sourceFields.name: Fishing Wader Boots
sourceFields.str_version_22: Show off your fishing finesse and keep your toes nice and dry with these water-proof waders!

sourceFields.name: Star Captain's Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Show off your starship strengths and command the respect of your crew with this dashing cap!

sourceFields.name: Anomalizing Elegant Hammer
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected blocks! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break (with less of a chance than a Pristine version)! Use with care!

sourceFields.name: Anomalizing Elegant Scythe
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected trees! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break (with less of a chance than a Pristine version)! Use with care!

sourceFields.name: Anomalizing Elegant Bone Saw
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected patients! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break (with less of a chance than a Pristine version)! Use with care!

sourceFields.name: Elegant Anomarod
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected fish! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break (with less of a chance than a Pristine version)! Use with care!

sourceFields.name: Anomalizing Elegant Trowel
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected blocks! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break (with less of a chance than a Pristine version)! Use with care!

sourceFields.name: Anomalizing Elegant Cultivator
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected seeds! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break (with less of a chance than a Pristine version)! Use with care!

sourceFields.name: Anomalizing Reliable Scanner
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies discovered on Star Missions, and guaranteed to never break!

sourceFields.name: Anomalizing Pristine Scanner
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies discovered on Star Missions! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break! Use with care!

sourceFields.name: Exquisite Scanner
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies discovered on Star Missions!

sourceFields.name: Anomalizing Elegant Scanner
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies discovered on Star Missions! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break (though with less of a chance than a Pristine version)! Use with care!

sourceFields.name: Riding Bull
sourceFields.str_version_22: YEEHAW! Saddle up this bucking bull and charge its horns for maximum fury! This beastly bovine is none too happy to have a rider, so make sure you take its fury out on your foes, instead!

sourceFields.name: Wheelchair Speedster
sourceFields.str_version_22: Tear up the streets with triple-wheeled power! This chair isn't just incredibly comfortable and supportive - it also features GrowTech-powered wheels to propel you wherever you need to go! Take a seat and get ready to roll!

sourceFields.name: Fishing Dinghy
sourceFields.str_version_22: A lovely personal watercraft, just for you! Perfect for a quiet day on the water, listening to waves lap gently against its hull as you wait for a nibble on your fishing line!

sourceFields.name: Cupcake Apron
sourceFields.str_version_22: Show off your cooking cleverness and keep your clothes stain-free with this cute and comfortable apron!

sourceFields.name: Mengu Koi Samurai Facial Armor
sourceFields.str_version_22: A traditional facemask obtained from an even more traditional fish! You can't help looking great (and traditional) while you're wearing this!

sourceFields.name: Geta
sourceFields.str_version_22: Geta pair of these traditional wooden slippers and you'll soon be standing head and shoulders above your style-impaired companions!

sourceFields.name: Pink Kimono
sourceFields.str_version_22: Sleeve your arms (and the rest of yourself) in shimmering silk. Dyed a passionate pink and hand-stitched by crafty artisans, it's the perfect look for your next tea ceremony or historical reenactment!

sourceFields.name: Blue Kimono
sourceFields.str_version_22: Sleeve your arms (and the rest of yourself) in shimmering silk. Dyed a beautiful blue and hand-stitched by crafty artisans, it's the perfect look for your next tea ceremony or historical reenactment!

sourceFields.name: Orange Kimono
sourceFields.str_version_22: Sleeve your arms (and the rest of yourself) in shimmering silk. Dyed an adorable orange and hand-stitched by crafty artisans, it's the perfect look for your next tea ceremony or historical reenactment!

sourceFields.name: Ornamental Hair Fan & Chopsticks
sourceFields.str_version_22: Style yourself with the perfect hair, and then keep it in place with these lovely lacquered chopsticks at no additional charge! Two-for-one deals are very traditional, you know.

sourceFields.name: Oil-paper Umbrella
sourceFields.str_version_22: Cut the scary part out of falls and look good while you're doing it with this delicate - yet supportive - paper umbrella. May not be the best in a storm, but it'll definitely keep gravity at bay!

sourceFields.name: Geisha Makeup
sourceFields.str_version_22: Applied with exacting precision and exquisite materials, this makeup is a statement to the world that its bearer is poised, beautiful, and probably displeased with shenanigans. ANY shenanigans.

sourceFields.name: Panda Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Aww, it's adorable! Don this mask (with associated suit) and you'll instantly look like the second-cutest type of panda (after red pandas) and second-most monochromatic bear (after polar bears) in the world! Just goes to show that you can be second-place in looks... and first in our hearts.

sourceFields.name: Panda Suit
sourceFields.str_version_22: Aww, it's adorable! Don this suit (with associated mask) and you'll instantly look like the second-cutest type of panda (after red pandas) and second-most monochromatic bear (after polar bears) in the world! Just goes to show that you can be second-place in looks... and first in our hearts.

sourceFields.name: Master Sensei's White Eyebrows
sourceFields.str_version_22: You! Your eyebrows are weak! SMALL! UNWISE! They are unworthy, and should be replaced by THESE eyebrows, which are the true mark of ancient arts and knowledge. Put these perfectly-sized, immaculately-groomed eyebrows on and become the font of skill and understanding you know in your heart you should be.

sourceFields.name: Jade Crescent Axe
sourceFields.str_version_22: Honed over centuries by very bored monks and layered with precious stones and runed filigrees, this axe is a masterwork of ancient magic and EVEN MORE ANCIENT weaponsmithing. Wield it and you'll tear through foes, blocks, and butter like... um... even softer butter!

sourceFields.name: Koi Fish Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: The classiest of all fish (by at least 86%) has decided to join you on land! Now its classiness will follow you wherever you go! Thanks, classy koi.

sourceFields.name: Ezio's Hood
sourceFields.str_version_22: Conceal your features from the watchful eyes of the Templars with this iconic hood.

sourceFields.name: Ezio's Vest
sourceFields.str_version_22: Comes with hidden pockets for blades, potions, explosives, and snacks.

sourceFields.name: Ezio's Cape
sourceFields.str_version_22: Weighted just right to catch the winds, this cape will help you stick a death-defying landing and look cool the whole time.

sourceFields.name: Ezio's Trousers
sourceFields.str_version_22: Just loaded with knives. Like, there are more weapons in an Assassin's pants than fabric.

sourceFields.name: Ezio's Armguards
sourceFields.str_version_22: Complete with deadly Hidden Blades, these armguards will help you unleash swift justice on all who side with the Templars.

sourceFields.name: Ezio's Beard
sourceFields.str_version_22: Exactly the right amount of grizzled and wise.

sourceFields.name: Ezio's Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: Full of all the roguish charm you need to make the ladies of the Renaissance swoon - even the Templar ones.

sourceFields.name: Ezio's Boots
sourceFields.str_version_22: Ready to climb the Leaning Tower of Pisa, leap from the parapets of the Vatican, and knock cruel Templars from their seats of power.

sourceFields.name: Apocalypse Scythe
sourceFields.str_version_22: Stolen from one of the four riders of the Apocalypse, this deadly blade is able to slice open the veil between life and death.

sourceFields.name: Famine's Steed
sourceFields.str_version_22: The undead steed of one of the four riders of the Apocalypse, FAMINE. This dark steed withers all that it passes.

sourceFields.name: Conquest's Helm
sourceFields.str_version_22: BEHOLD! The conqueror approaches. All who view this helm shall flee in terror before its bearer, and those who remain will find naught but ruin.

sourceFields.name: Dark Aurora Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: The majesty of the skies has been corrupted by the dark powers of Growganoth! Once a symbol of beauty and grace, there is nothing left in these wings but wickedness and terror...

sourceFields.name: Cat Eyes
sourceFields.str_version_22: Wow, pawesome! These new eyes are the cat's meow, and the purrfect addition to any style.

sourceFields.name: Knife Head
sourceFields.str_version_22: A truly splitting headache.

sourceFields.name: Evil Grin
sourceFields.str_version_22: Makes you look way, WAY too happy...

sourceFields.name: Vampiress Dress
sourceFields.str_version_22: Perfect for a Bloodsucker's Ball!

sourceFields.name: Nightmare Vampiress Dress
sourceFields.str_version_22: The chosen garb for a dark baroness of the crypts, this coldly beautiful dress is made of the finest lace and all set for a night of revelry and ruin!

sourceFields.name: Riding Skeletal Shark
sourceFields.str_version_22: Deaaaaaadly SHARK doo doo, doo doo doo doo! Deadly shark doo doo, doo doo doo doo!

sourceFields.name: Angler Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Makes even the most beautiful Growtopians into terrifying creatures of the depths! Great if you want to skip out on a blind date or scare small children!

sourceFields.name: Demon Plague Doctor Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: As if normal Plague Doctor formal wear wasn't terrifying enough, someone's imbued this mask with haunting spirits of darkness and evil! Was that even necessary?!

sourceFields.name: Vampire Hunter Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Stake your claim on the night and show the legions of the undead who's boss with this extra-sharp hat. Remember, only the pointiest of headgear for the most skilled vampire hunters.

sourceFields.name: Tragicomic Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Celebrating happiness, sadness, and all the little moments in between! This mask will show the world you believe the true drama and splendor of life is not in stability, but in its highs and lows!

sourceFields.name: Creepy Baby Head Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Tired of people treating you like a little kid? Toss this bad boy on and send THEM crying home to momma!

sourceFields.name: Demon Angler Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: This is a demonic fish, not a fish that angles for demons. If you're ever unsure about which it is, just check for the gruesome teeth and eyes! Luckily, this particular specimen seems happy to join you on your adventures. Don't get your fingers near those chompers, though - even if it's loyal, it's still a demon!

sourceFields.name: Skeletal Shark Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: This is what happens when you don't feed your fish, then bury it in unhallowed ground! Even worse, it looks like some foul magic has brought it back to float by your side once more!

sourceFields.name: Ethereal Rainbow Dragon
sourceFields.str_version_22: Fae energies from beyond the veil of life and space have flitted into our worlds! Sparkling with the prismatic glory of a light beyond mortal reckoning, this creature of mist and mystery will empower you with its knowledge of the realms beyond! Also, it'll look pretty.

sourceFields.name: Heroic Tights of Prevention
sourceFields.str_version_22: Amazing prismatic pants for a true hero of Growtopia! These glorious tights will keep you safe from villains AND prevent you from picking up floating items in the world! Nothing sticks to you, for you have the power of heroes!

sourceFields.name: Tamed Looming Triffid
sourceFields.str_version_22: Those terrifying tentacles have merged to create... a pet! It looks like this twitching monster is just grateful to be moving around on its own, and doesn't even want to eat your brains! Let's just hope it doesn't get any bigger!

sourceFields.name: Magic Carpet
sourceFields.str_version_22: More than just a rug! Step on and enter a whole new world! ...well, if you consider hovering slightly above the ground a "new world," that is.

sourceFields.name: Mountain Dire Wolf
sourceFields.str_version_22: AWOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO! Arctic lands shake with the terrifying howl of the monstrous dire wolf! If you find a way to ride this beast, its unnatural speed and deadly claws will be yours to command!

sourceFields.name: Super Logo - Fist
sourceFields.str_version_22: Emblazon this logo on your super costume to fight crime as... Knuckle Sandwich? Meat Hook? Mr. Fisticuffs? It's up to you!

sourceFields.name: Stone Gargoyle Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: You wouldn't think stone wings could soar, but thanks to a thousand-year-old spell, these have the power to take you to the skies!

sourceFields.name: Plasma Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: Set your hair afire with the energies of space and time! Inspired by HyperTech and made possible thanks to the mad science of Growtopia's test kitchens, this hair isn't just an electrifying fashion statement - it's also edible! WARNING: DO NOT EAT.

sourceFields.name: Ancestral Orb of Time
sourceFields.str_version_22: Incredible forces of immortality and history have been combined with the building blocks of creation to forge this orb. Equip it and mastery of the fourth dimension will be yours...

sourceFields.name: Ancestral Orb of Time : Level 2
sourceFields.str_version_22: Incredible forces of immortality and history have been combined with the building blocks of creation to forge this orb. Equip it and mastery of the fourth dimension will be yours... Gives you an improved time reduction on all of your providers!

sourceFields.name: Ancestral Orb of Time : Level 3
sourceFields.str_version_22: Incredible forces of immortality and history have been combined with the building blocks of creation to forge this orb. Equip it and mastery of the fourth dimension will be yours... Gives you an uncommonly-improved time reduction on all of your providers!

sourceFields.name: Ancestral Orb of Time : Level 4
sourceFields.str_version_22: Incredible forces of immortality and history have been combined with the building blocks of creation to forge this orb. Equip it and mastery of the fourth dimension will be yours... Gives you an extra-improved time reduction on all of your providers!

sourceFields.name: Ancestral Orb of Time : Level 5
sourceFields.str_version_22: Incredible forces of immortality and history have been combined with the building blocks of creation to forge this orb. Equip it and mastery of the fourth dimension will be yours... Gives you a super-improved time reduction on all of your providers!

sourceFields.name: Shadow Spirit of the Underworld
sourceFields.str_version_22: A demon of the Shadow Plane, this dangerous creature obeys only you, its master, and lives to shred all others! Nobody knows how it came to be in your service, and it's probably best not to ask. For those who long for a darker world, this is definitely your spirit animal!

sourceFields.name: Monarch Butterfly Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: These wings have the honor of being named after royalty! With a luscious color scheme, a wingspan of up to 10cm, these majestic wings offer action packed jumping capabilities.

sourceFields.name: Winter Freezer Hood
sourceFields.str_version_22: Celebrate the season with the new Winter Freezer style! This hood doesn't just keep you warm - it also makes you cool! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...

sourceFields.name: Ultra Winter Freezer Hood
sourceFields.str_version_22: Celebrate the season in ULTRA Winter Freezer style! This hood don't just keep you ULTRA WARM - it also makes you ULTRA COOL! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both, and in such an ultra way! Go on, I'll wait...

sourceFields.name: Supplier's Cape
sourceFields.str_version_22: The best Suppliers bring a wide assortment of goods for trade, and what better way to show them off than with this multicolored, ever-shifting cape? Don this garment and enjoy bonus points for any Supplier - that's Farmer, Surgeon, Fisher, and Star Captain, at the moment - Role quest you undertake!

7206.name: The Great Chameleon: Master of Disguise

sourceFields.name: The Great Chameleon: Master of Disguise
sourceFields.str_version_22: The hidden wonder of Growtopia has joined your side! Glekki, the Great Chameleon, has emerged from his hidden sanctuary and chosen YOU as his new apprentice. Keep him close at hand, and he'll teach you the ways of the chameleon, allowing you to blend in with ANY SURFACE as long as you stay verrrrry still. What an honor!

sourceFields.name: Winter Freezer Robe
sourceFields.str_version_22: Celebrate the season with the new Winter Freezer style! This robe doesn't just keep you warm - it also makes you cool! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...

sourceFields.name: Ultra Winter Freezer Robe
sourceFields.str_version_22: Celebrate the season in ULTRA Winter Freezer style! This robe don't just keep you ULTRA WARM - it also makes you ULTRA COOL! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both, and in such an ultra way! Go on, I'll wait...

sourceFields.name: Crafter's Cape
sourceFields.str_version_22: Loaded with all kinds of useful tools to make any construction project a breeze, this many-pocketed cape is a Crafter's best friend! Don this garment and enjoy bonus points for any Crafter - that's Builder and Cook, at the moment - Role quest you undertake!

sourceFields.name: Mad Hatter
sourceFields.str_version_22: Hats! Hats for all! AHAHAHAAA! Don the tallest, wobbliest, most majestic tower of hats Growtopia has ever seen and become one with madness! Hats for me! Hats for you! Hats for EVERYONE! WOOHOO!

sourceFields.name: Lyre
sourceFields.str_version_22: Perfect for a Renaissance Faire or your average medieval-themed garage band. Note that you can't punch when holding this lovely instrument, as we'll be too busy entertaining royalty! Punch anywhere to play music; if you punch to your left or right, you can bend the note higher or lower. Punch in your own column to play the same notes that Sheet Music: Lyre Note plays.

sourceFields.name: Jack's Shoes
sourceFields.str_version_22: The boots of a very skilled road warrior! Collect Jack's full outfit and you'll be able to draw on his incredibly varied experiences to improve your performance in all kinds of Roles!

sourceFields.name: Jack's Jeans
sourceFields.str_version_22: The jeans of a very skilled road warrior! Collect Jack's full outfit and you'll be able to draw on his incredibly varied experiences to improve your performance in all kinds of Roles!

sourceFields.name: Jack's Vest
sourceFields.str_version_22: The vest of a very skilled road warrior! Collect Jack's full outfit and you'll be able to draw on his incredibly varied experiences to improve your performance in all kinds of Roles!

sourceFields.name: Jack's Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: The hat of a very skilled road warrior! Collect Jack's full outfit and you'll be able to draw on his incredibly varied experiences to improve your performance in all kinds of Roles!

sourceFields.name: Future Perfect Chip
sourceFields.str_version_22: A model 101 super-processor, the FPC will attach directly to your neural cortex and, from there, extend a web of nanofibers throughout your skin, transforming you into a cybernetic powerhouse!

sourceFields.name: Swirling Rainbow Eyes
sourceFields.str_version_22: Whoosh! See the world in a new light with these kaleidoscopic eyes! Their fantastic, ever-spiraling beauty will set a smile on the faces of all who greet you!

sourceFields.name: Knight's Chainmail - Sun
sourceFields.str_version_22: Turn aside the blades of your enemies and show your fealty to the illuminating power of the sun with this hand-tooled chainmail!

sourceFields.name: Knight's Chainmail - Lion
sourceFields.str_version_22: Turn aside the blades of your enemies and show your fealty to the inspiring courage of the lion with this hand-tooled chainmail!

sourceFields.name: Knight's Chainmail - Crown
sourceFields.str_version_22: Turn aside the blades of your enemies and show your fealty to the deep-rooted honor of the crown with this hand-tooled chainmail!

sourceFields.name: Knight's Great Helm - Golden
sourceFields.str_version_22: Show everyone you abide by the Code of Chivalry while keeping the sun - and any pesky arrows - out of your eyes at the same time! Now in glorious golden plate!

sourceFields.name: Knight's Helm - Crusader
sourceFields.str_version_22: Show everyone you abide by the Code of Chivalry while keeping the sun - and any pesky arrows - out of your eyes at the same time! Now in courageous crusader colors!

sourceFields.name: Knight's Helm - Antlers
sourceFields.str_version_22: Show everyone you abide by the Code of Chivalry while keeping the sun - and any pesky arrows - out of your eyes at the same time! Now with amazing antlered accents!

sourceFields.name: Scavenger Wheels
sourceFields.str_version_22: A rumbling engine beneath you, choking soot behind, and post-apocalyptic adventures ahead. The world may have ended, but the roads... they go on forever!

sourceFields.name: Scavenger Lord's Wheels
sourceFields.str_version_22: Shiny and chrome! Rule the wastelands from atop this diesel-powered monster! The scavengers and warriors of the apocalypse will bow when they see you tearing past on this mad machine!

sourceFields.name: 2-Face
sourceFields.str_version_22: Seems like there's two sides to everything - and with this face, that includes you! What will you show to the world?

sourceFields.name: Golden Midas Masterpants
sourceFields.str_version_22: Wrap yourself in glittering, gleaming GLORY! Don this, and every inch of skin, every nerve and fiber, everything will transform into that most malleable and marvelous of metals... GOLD!

sourceFields.name: Tiger Spirit
sourceFields.str_version_22: You are one with your spirit animal! The awesome guidance of the Tiger Spirit has given you the gift of double jump! Ever see a tiger leap and take down unsuspecting prey? Well, now you can too! Just don't get distracted by laser pointers - tigers might be big, but they're still kitties at heart!

sourceFields.name: Anomalizing Reliable Rolling Pin
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected food items, and guaranteed to never break!

sourceFields.name: Anomalizing Pristine Rolling Pin
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected food items! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break! Use with care!

sourceFields.name: Exquisite Rolling Pin
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected food items!

sourceFields.name: Anomalizing Elegant Rolling Pin
sourceFields.str_version_22: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected food items! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break (though with less of a chance than a Pristine version)! Use with care!

sourceFields.name: Riding Turkey
sourceFields.str_version_22: Gobble gobble! He's off the dinner table and on the road! This adventurous turkey wants to see the world, and he's happy to take you along for the ride! Saddle up and get gobbling!

sourceFields.name: Turkey Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Don't let anyone tell you turkeys are lame! They are FANTASTIC flyers, and with their wings behind you, the skies are yours! Now go forth and gobble!

sourceFields.name: Pilgrim's Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: There are all kinds of things to be thankful for during the holidays, but maybe one of the most important is just how dang awesome those pilgrims looked! Top your ensemble with this traditional hat and join the fun!

sourceFields.name: Pilgrim's Coat
sourceFields.str_version_22: There are all kinds of things to be thankful for during the holidays, but maybe one of the most important is just how dang awesome those pilgrims looked! Cover your ensemble with this traditional coat and join the fun!

sourceFields.name: Pilgrim's Shoes
sourceFields.str_version_22: There are all kinds of things to be thankful for during the holidays, but maybe one of the most important is just how dang awesome those pilgrims looked! Complete your ensemble with these traditional shoes and join the fun!

sourceFields.name: Pilgrim's Bonnet
sourceFields.str_version_22: There are all kinds of things to be thankful for during the holidays, but maybe one of the most important is just how dang awesome those pilgrims looked! Top your ensemble with this traditional bonnet and join the fun!

sourceFields.name: Pilgrim's Dress
sourceFields.str_version_22: There are all kinds of things to be thankful for during the holidays, but maybe one of the most important is just how dang awesome those pilgrims looked! Elevate your ensemble with this traditional dress and join the fun!

sourceFields.name: Go-Go-Growformer!
sourceFields.str_version_22: Zip through the streets on squealing wheels of steel, then transform and smash through walls and villains with the power of the Growformers! This incredible automaton has a mind of his own, but he's happy to be your wheels and shield as you tear through the many worlds of Growtopia! Push the pedal to the metal and you'll be saying 'GG!' in 0.5 seconds!

sourceFields.name: Ultra Winter Freezer Teddy Suit
sourceFields.str_version_22: Celebrate the season with the new ULTRA Winter Freezer style! This suit doesn't just turn you into an ULTRA warm and adorable teddy bear - it also turns you into an ULTRA cool one! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both, and in such an ultra way! Go on, I'll wait...

sourceFields.name: Winter Freezer Teddy Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Celebrate the season with the new Winter Freezer style! This mask doesn't just turn you into a warm and adorable teddy bear - it also turns you into a cool one! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...

sourceFields.name: Crown of Duplication
sourceFields.str_version_22: What's better than one pet? Why, TWO, of course! With the strange powers of this ancient relic, any pet that chooses to follow you will be joined by its own time-tossed duplicate from another reality! What strange adventures does this doppel-pet have while it's away? Probably best not to ask - what if it's from a better world than yours? You might get jealous!

sourceFields.name: Mage's Orb
sourceFields.str_version_22: Long before they built totally responsible and not-at-all dangerous techno-marvels, GrowTech used to be known as MagiGrow, and they turned out all kinds of crazy inventions like this ancient Mage's Orb! We're not sure how or where this relic was found, but it's still supercharged with mystic might! Ouch! Wield this and you'll find zapping things easier than ever! MagiGrow: Puttin' the "harm" in thaumaturgy since 740AD!

sourceFields.name: Snowflake Eyes
sourceFields.str_version_22: Forget those fools with stars in their eyes! This holiday season, it's snowflakes or nothin'! Show off your winter wizardry with these icy-cool eyes! You'll never lose a staring contest again!

sourceFields.name: Rugged Winter Beard
sourceFields.str_version_22: Beautiful and burly, just like you! This beard has been through snow, mud, rain, cougars, and falling trees, and only gotten mightier for it! Can you live up to its brawny power?

sourceFields.name: Ice Queen Winter Makeup
sourceFields.str_version_22: Crisp and cool, just like you! This makeup has been applied by frosty faeries using all-ice ingredients for a look that's fit for only the most wintry of royalty. Can you live up to its snowy majesty?

7402.name: Snowflake Eyes with Rugged Winter Beard

sourceFields.name: Snowflake Eyes with Rugged Winter Beard
sourceFields.str_version_22: Cement yourself as a king of winter with this one-two knockout combo of frosty eyes and burly beardery! Nobody will question your devotion to the season again!

7404.name: Snowflake Eyes with Ice Queen Winter Makeup

sourceFields.name: Snowflake Eyes with Ice Queen Winter Makeup
sourceFields.str_version_22: Cement yourself as a queen of winter with this one-two stunner of icy-cool eyes and pristine snow-dappled makeup! Nobody will question your devotion to the season again!

sourceFields.name: Super Snowball Launcher
sourceFields.str_version_22: Using advanced frost-gauss technology, this launcher accelerates snowballs to dangerous velocities! Tired of being unable to pelt your friends in neighboring cities? Aim this baby at the sky and make it a white Christmas for them in seconds!

sourceFields.name: Abominable Snowman Suit
sourceFields.str_version_22: Rar! The body of a horrible, terrifying beast of the arctic wastes! All who see you will know your abominableness... but is that truly who you are on the inside? And who are they to judge, anyway?!

sourceFields.name: Abominable Snowman Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Rar! The mask of a horrible, terrifying beast of the arctic wastes! All who see you will know your abominableness... but is that truly who you are on the inside? And who are they to judge, anyway?!

sourceFields.name: Snowflake Wings of Winter
sourceFields.str_version_22: Through the magic of snow and icy auroras, these wings keep you aloft by making you as light as a snowflake, and twice as special!

sourceFields.name: Chipmunk
sourceFields.str_version_22: Chittering, chattering, and tons of fun, this chipmunk is tired of hoarding nuts for winter and wants to spend all his time playing with you!

sourceFields.name: Snow Leopard Tail
sourceFields.str_version_22: Swooshing through the artic terrain, the mighty snow leopard stalks his prey - and now you can, too! This tail grants perfect pouncing balance, so look out, mice and rabbits!

sourceFields.name: Snowfrost's Top Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: A cheery holiday hat to cap the costume of a most mischievous sprite! Snowfrost is here - and it's time to play!

sourceFields.name: Snowfrost's Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Get your warm face on with this frost-shielding mask! You may be a prince of winter, but you'll never be left in the cold with Snowfrost at your side!

sourceFields.name: Snowfrost's Suit
sourceFields.str_version_22: Threaded with frost, whorls of ice, and a hint of merriment, this suit feels surprisingly warm... and just a little bit mischievous!!

sourceFields.name: Snowfrost's Candy Cane Blade
sourceFields.str_version_22: Slice through those who'd dare to harm your holidays! ...or snack away to satisfy your sweet tooth! It's an all-in-one weaponized treat, hand-spun for you!

sourceFields.name: The Horrible Holiday Hoodie
sourceFields.str_version_22: And you thought the sweater was bad! This hoodie is sixteen flavors of terrible holiday glitz and glurge, all spun together by blind spiders with poor fashion sense. Spectacular!

sourceFields.name: Slime Green Hoodie
sourceFields.str_version_22: Hide your hair from snow and show your slimy side with this gloriously green hoodie!

sourceFields.name: Snow Husky
sourceFields.str_version_22: Arf! Even if you're not running a race across the ice, this husky is the perfect winter pet! He's warm, fuzzy, and happiest when he's helping you spread holiday cheer!

sourceFields.name: Snow Husky Sledge
sourceFields.str_version_22: Dashing through the snow, barking as we go, this sledge is pulled by dogs, and anything but slow!

sourceFields.name: Poseidon's Digger's Trident
sourceFields.str_version_22: Don't let the king of the deep know you've got this! He's been trying to cultivate the perfect coral garden, and he's going to be SO MAD when he finds out we stole his trident for you! This watery trident is very specifically designed for one purpose: to prick deep sand and ocean rock. It is pretty useless at digging anywhere else, but dang if it doesn't rip deep sand and ocean rock apart.

sourceFields.name: Mr. Narwhal Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: The majestic narwhal, unicorn of the deep and expert poker of all things aquatic, has made the leap from the deep and landed at your side! Take him for a spin, but watch out for that horn!

sourceFields.name: Narwhal Tusk Staff
sourceFields.str_version_22: Perfect for summoning the powers of the seas as well as poking slow people in front of you at the store! Narwhals HATE waiting in line almost as much as they love the water, so they'd appreciate it you took the time to do both!

sourceFields.name: SLaminator's Boomerang
sourceFields.str_version_22: Show the sound barrier who's boss with this slammin' slapper of a boomerang! Thanks to its supporter, it travels extra-far and crazy-fast! If you ever see it coming back, though, watch out! It's not easy to catch something this unpredictable and keep all your fingers! Sponsored by JIRISTAR, ChiggaLam and SLaminator.

sourceFields.name: Nutcracker Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Extra tall for hiding a winter's worth of nuts! Just don't let any squirrels know - it's near-impossible to clear out a squirrel infestation without ruining the fabric.

sourceFields.name: Nutcracker Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Complete your seasonal fantasy look with the stoic face of elite nutcracker royalty! Warning: Do not try to crack nuts with your teeth just because you're wearing this - it WILL hurt!

sourceFields.name: Nutcracker Coat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Warm and cozy! This coat is perfect for keeping away the chill of any mystical winter-time journeys, as well as the claws of the evil Mouse King!

sourceFields.name: Nutcracker Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: Well-sized for your average Growtopian (and nutcracker Lieutenant), these are made from GrowTech's patented nut-wicking material to ensure you won't have any stray almonds or walnuts sticking to your sides!

sourceFields.name: Nutcracker Boots
sourceFields.str_version_22: Polished so well you can see yourself in them, and carefully swept free of nut shells and dust!

sourceFields.name: Nutcracker Saber
sourceFields.str_version_22: Slash and parry at villainous mice (and particularly tough nuts) with this crackin' good blade!

sourceFields.name: OVEROLL's Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Hit the heights with these wicked-cool wings! Thanks to their sponsor, you won't just be doing barrel rolls - you'll be doing OVEROLLS! Sponsored by OVEROLL

sourceFields.name: Super Squirt Rifle 500
sourceFields.str_version_22: The terror of summer battlefields is now in your hands! Portable soaking technology has come a long way, so not only can you use this to douse your friends (and foes), but it'll go further than ever and even put out fires!

sourceFields.name: Men's Board Shorts - Ocean Wave
sourceFields.str_version_22: Hang ten in this bodacious beachwear! These are blue and cool, through and through. You'll be secure in your good looks on land and at sea with these waterproof and style-assured shorts!

sourceFields.name: Men's Board Shorts - Checkered
sourceFields.str_version_22: Hang ten in this bodacious beachwear! These are lined and fine, through and through. You'll be secure in your good looks on land and at sea with these waterproof and style-assured shorts!

sourceFields.name: Women's Swimsuit - Deep Ocean Blue
sourceFields.str_version_22: Look great in sun and surf alike! With a helpful UV lining, these smart-fabric swimsuits will not only make you look amazing, but they'll also protect you from harmful sunburns! Looking good never felt so safe!

sourceFields.name: Women's Swimsuit - Coral Pink
sourceFields.str_version_22: Look great in sun and surf alike! With a helpful UV lining, these smart-fabric swimsuits will not only make you look amazing, but they'll also protect you from harmful sunburns! Looking good never felt so safe!

sourceFields.name: Wet Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: The sea was kind to you! Tide-tossed and kissed by the sun, this hair is perfectly wet and wild! Just don't go looking for a towel to dry off! It's amazing exactly the way it is - just like you.

sourceFields.name: Unicorn Floatie
sourceFields.str_version_22: Tired of having to choose between hanging out with a majestic creature of mystery and myth or an awesome pool accessory? Well, worry no more - now you can have both!

sourceFields.name: Jet Ski
sourceFields.str_version_22: Swimming is for suckers! In fact, traveling anywhere without a jet engine is for suckers, but nowhere is that more true than on open water! Crank this baby into overdrive and make friends with salt spray and the horizon, because you're king of the sea now! Vroom!

sourceFields.name: Golden Jet Ski
sourceFields.str_version_22: Strapping a jet engine to your feet and flying across the water is already a great idea, but you know what it's missing? SOLID GOLD JET POWER, BABY! What could go wrong?

sourceFields.name: Balloon-Frosting War Glove
sourceFields.str_version_22: Brr! This dangerous glove adds a thickened shell of frost to every balloon its wearer throws, tripling its points on a successful hit! Just be careful - its GrowTech freezing circuits are prone to failure and may break! Use with care!

sourceFields.name: Plunger
sourceFields.str_version_22: From the weird and wacky world of some crazy critters! Fixes toilets and makes a stylish fashion statement!

sourceFields.name: The Brother Hood
sourceFields.str_version_22: Conceal your features from the watchful eyes of the Templars with this iconic hood.

sourceFields.name: Unicorn
sourceFields.str_version_22: Once ridden by the legendary ninja kitty, this unicorn has stopped stabbing people and only wants to snuzzle you! Man, you're so much luckier than its previous 426 owners...

sourceFields.name: Glowing Shirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: This shirt was fished out of a pool of radioactive chemicals, giving it unnatural brightness (but no spider powers, unfortunately). Wearing it will turn every room around you into the hottest club in town!

sourceFields.name: Foppy 4.0
sourceFields.str_version_22: Forged in honor of the finest kitty in at least twenty worlds, this mask combines their stylish color scheme with even MORE stylish robotic technology! You might be cool, but are you robo-kitty cool? Wear this mask and find out! -- This is the subscriber item for February 2019, and was chosen by DanyRed.

sourceFields.name: Hovernator Drone - White
sourceFields.str_version_22: Gliding silently through the skies on carbon fiber blades, this drone is packed with dangerous GrowTech attack systems and an advanced logic engine preloaded with Amethyst-Generation AI! Luckily, it has to obey the holder of its remote - and that's you! Just don't, like, lose that thing. We've had to put down about eighty drone uprisings already...

sourceFields.name: Hovernator Drone - Black
sourceFields.str_version_22: Gliding silently through the skies on carbon fiber blades, this drone is packed with dangerous GrowTech attack systems and an advanced logic engine preloaded with Amethyst-Generation AI! Luckily, it has to obey the holder of its remote - and that's you! Just don't, like, lose that thing. We've had to put down about eighty drone uprisings already...

sourceFields.name: Hovernator Drone - Red
sourceFields.str_version_22: Gliding silently through the skies on carbon fiber blades, this drone is packed with dangerous GrowTech attack systems and an advanced logic engine preloaded with Amethyst-Generation AI! Luckily, it has to obey the holder of its remote - and that's you! Just don't, like, lose that thing. We've had to put down about eighty drone uprisings already...

sourceFields.name: Hovernator Drone - Golden
sourceFields.str_version_22: Gliding silently through the skies on carbon fiber blades, this drone is packed with dangerous GrowTech attack systems and an advanced logic engine preloaded with Amethyst-Generation AI! Luckily, it has to obey the holder of its remote - and that's you! Just don't, like, lose that thing. We've had to put down about eighty drone uprisings already...

sourceFields.name: Winter Freezer Cuddly Fox Scarf
sourceFields.str_version_22: Celebrate the season with a foxy new addition to the Winter Freezer style! This super-cuddly scarf doesn't just keep you warm - it also makes you cool! Try to find another adorable animal that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...!

7578.name: Ultra Winter Freezer Cuddly Fox Scarf

sourceFields.name: Ultra Winter Freezer Cuddly Fox Scarf
sourceFields.str_version_22: Celebrate the season with an ULTRA-FOXY new addition to the Winter Freezer style! This super-cuddly scarf doesn't just keep you ULTRA WARM - it also makes you ULTRA COOL! Try to find another adorable animal that can do both, and in such an ultra way! Go on, I'll wait...!

sourceFields.name: Robotic MK.IV Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: After a great deal of experimentation and only, like, ten major accidents, GrowTech's engineers have worked out all the kinks and produced these fantastically fancy, almost certainly safe wings! Just... don't ask about Wings MK.I-III. They had... problems.

sourceFields.name: Sprite's Robe
sourceFields.str_version_22: Don this beautiful robe to summon the power of a playful sprite! Every jump will transform you into a Sprite for a time and take you bounding above the world!

sourceFields.name: Sonic Buster Sword
sourceFields.str_version_22: Smash the limits with this intensely powerful weapon! Oversized might for oversized heroics, this weapon swirls with spirit energy - a devastating weapon in the right hands, and a gorgeous conversation piece in just about any!

sourceFields.name: Treasure Map
sourceFields.str_version_22: This map is covered in strange designs and shifting letters! They get a little easier to see when you're moving faster, though...

sourceFields.name: Treasure Map
sourceFields.str_version_22: This map is covered in strange designs and shifting letters! They're hard to make out in the light of day, though...

sourceFields.name: Treasure Map
sourceFields.str_version_22: This map is covered in strange designs and shifting letters! The paper seems incredibly dry, though...

sourceFields.name: Treasure Map
sourceFields.str_version_22: This map is covered in strange designs and shifting letters! The paper seems quite damp, though...

sourceFields.name: Treasure Map
sourceFields.str_version_22: This map is covered in strange designs and shifting letters! The language isn't like anything you've heard of on Earth, though...

sourceFields.name: Treasure Map
sourceFields.str_version_22: This map is covered in strange designs and shifting letters! The runes have a dangerous sheen of gold, though...

sourceFields.name: Map of Tyr
sourceFields.str_version_22: This map's letters are hard to see in the light of day, and even those you CAN make out seem to change from moment to moment...

sourceFields.name: Map of Odin
sourceFields.str_version_22: This map's letters are hard to see in the light of day, and even those you CAN make out seem to change from moment to moment...

sourceFields.name: Map of Thor
sourceFields.str_version_22: This map's letters are hard to see in the light of day, and even those you CAN make out seem to change from moment to moment...

sourceFields.name: Map of Frigg
sourceFields.str_version_22: This map's letters are hard to see in the light of day, and even those you CAN make out seem to change from moment to moment...

sourceFields.name: Legendary Map - Untouched
sourceFields.str_version_22: Ooh! This is one heck of a map! Looks like there's a lot of scrambled text and hidden messages here - you'd need a powerful algorithm to make sense of it all...

sourceFields.name: Legendary Map - Scanned
sourceFields.str_version_22: This map is covered in strange designs and shifting letters! They seem to change from moment to moment, and never in a form you can decipher!

sourceFields.name: Legendary Map - Magnified
sourceFields.str_version_22: This map is covered in strange designs and shifting letters! They seem to change from moment to moment, and never in a form you can decipher!

sourceFields.name: Legendary Map - Deciphered
sourceFields.str_version_22: The runes of the frozen cliffs match certain ones all over your map! When you put them together, a final message becomes clear, but the letters seem strangely faded to you, as if your eyes just aren't quite evolved - or mutated - enough to make them out...

sourceFields.name: Round Shield
sourceFields.str_version_22: Circles are the superior defense setup! This baby deflects 7.8% more blows than all other shield shapes! Invest now!

sourceFields.name: Frigg's Belt
sourceFields.str_version_22: Spun from the finest gold and made with craftsmanship of such surpassing grace, the Aesir themselves will applaud its bearer. Good thing that's you, eh?

sourceFields.name: Battle Boar
sourceFields.str_version_22: Supercharged with porcine fury, its terrible oinks will be the last thing your foes ever hear!

sourceFields.name: Golden Battle Boar
sourceFields.str_version_22: Gleaming in the light of war, this gorgeous boar is the most beautiful - and deadly - of its kind!

sourceFields.name: Tyr's Spear
sourceFields.str_version_22: Justice and duty resonate in the heart of this godly weapon, propelling it far beyond its wielder's reach and into the very heart of evil!

sourceFields.name: Huginn and Muninn - Odin's Ravens
sourceFields.str_version_22: Thought and Memory, perfectly perched on each shoulder to whisper the world's secrets into your ears! Just make sure to feed them, or they might take a chunk out of you in return!

sourceFields.name: Mjolnir
sourceFields.str_version_22: The hammer of the gods! Wreathed in myth and forged with a core of living lightning, this legendary artifact was once lost in the gulf between the stars! Will you succeed on its former owner's cosmic quest? Are you... worthy?

sourceFields.name: Eir's Healing Rune
sourceFields.str_version_22: Infused with the medical might of Eir, a healing goddess, this rune will grant swift recovery and aid to any who hold it! Also grants minty fresh breath, which is an especially nice benefit when you consider the standard Viking diet.

sourceFields.name: Thor's Chariot
sourceFields.str_version_22: Looks like Thor misplaced his wheels! Fortunately, his feisty goats, Tanngrisnir and Tanngnjostr, have taken a liking to you and decided to forgo the standard BITE BITE BITE greeting they tend to use on new owners. Let's ride!

sourceFields.name: Super Party Launcher
sourceFields.str_version_22: Those other ravers laughed at you. They thought you didn't have the moves to dance with them. They thought your game was weak and your accessories were weaker. Well, joke's on them, because now you're ready to party the night away with the ultimate in confetti domination! Who's laughing NOW, foolish ravers?! Kinda hard to make fun of someone when you've got paper confetti and maybe a Mach 5 firework in your face, isn't it??

sourceFields.name: Air Horn
sourceFields.str_version_22: Little-known fact: All Growtopia air horns are actually the sound of a very angry camel screaming.

sourceFields.name: Floating Speakers
sourceFields.str_version_22: These aren't for pool parties - they're for you! Hit the air on waves of sound with these thumpin' good boomboxes!

sourceFields.name: Goat Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: The leash to one of two very famous goats! Let's see... this particularly bitey boy is either named "Teeth-Barer" or "Teeth Grinder". I'm not sure how to find out which without getting bitten, however, so your guess is as good as mine!

sourceFields.name: Dragon Warrior's Shield - Crimson
sourceFields.str_version_22: An unyielding defense against claws, fangs, spiky tails, and the blazing breath of even the mightiest drakes! Comes in a variety of colors, all related to ancient customs and knightly orders! Looks like this one is red, for the Crimson Court!

sourceFields.name: Dragon Warrior's Shield - Purple
sourceFields.str_version_22: An unyielding defense against claws, fangs, spiky tails, and the blazing breath of even the mightiest drakes! Comes in a variety of colors, all related to ancient customs and knightly orders! Looks like this one is purple, for the Noble Bastion!

sourceFields.name: Dragon Warrior's Shield - Silver
sourceFields.str_version_22: An unyielding defense against claws, fangs, spiky tails, and the blazing breath of even the mightiest drakes! Comes in a variety of colors, all related to ancient customs and knightly orders! Looks like this one is silver, for the Silver Spire!

sourceFields.name: Dragon Warrior's Shield - Diamond
sourceFields.str_version_22: An unyielding defense against claws, fangs, spiky tails, and the blazing breath of even the mightiest drakes! Comes in a variety of colors, all related to ancient customs and knightly orders! Looks like this one is diamond, for the rarest of all: The Radiant Souls!

sourceFields.name: Draconic Rocket Parasol
sourceFields.str_version_22: To the heavens! In honor of the original creators of fireworks, this parasol has been loaded up with a dragon's worth! Use them to blast your way into the heavens, and then float gently down to Earth when you're done! There are only 1200 in existence!

sourceFields.name: Toasted Villager Shirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: Toasty! This top took a quick blast of flame from a dragon, and it shows!

sourceFields.name: Toasted Villager Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Toasty! Whoever wore this was pretty unlucky when a dragon came to town, though better this hat than its bearer's head, I suppose...

sourceFields.name: Toasted Villager Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: Toasty! It's unclear whether these pants were present during a dragon's attack, or their owner simply told a TON of lies...

sourceFields.name: Toasted Villager Shoes
sourceFields.str_version_22: Toasty! Talk about a hotfoot! For a very brief run, these must've felt like the worst case of athelete's foot in history!

sourceFields.name: Toasted Face Smudges
sourceFields.str_version_22: Toasty! Just gotten blitzed by a firedrake with nothing to show for it? Not true! These toasty smudges are proof that you've faced the flame... and survived!

sourceFields.name: Dragon Knight's Helm
sourceFields.str_version_22: Forged in a master blacksmith's furnace and stamped with runes of protection, a Dragon Knight's suit of armor is their last and best line of defense against the horrid flames and claws of their scaly foes! This helm is but one link of many in that chain of defense, a perfect way to keep your noggin safe! Also doubles as a really cool motorcycle helmet.

sourceFields.name: Dragon Knight's Chestplate
sourceFields.str_version_22: Forged in a master blacksmith's furnace and stamped with runes of protection, a Dragon Knight's suit of armor is their last and best line of defense against the horrid flames and claws of their scaly foes! This chestplate is but one link of many in that chain of defense, a perfect way to keep your body safe! And hey, it's got great resale value - even if a dragon burns you out of it, this armor will still be left behind for the next intrepid knight!

sourceFields.name: Dragon Knight's Greaves
sourceFields.str_version_22: Forged in a master blacksmith's furnace and stamped with runes of protection, a Dragon Knight's suit of armor is their last and best line of defense against the horrid flames and claws of their scaly foes! These greaves are but one link of many in that chain of defense, a perfect way to keep your legs safe! Trust me, when you're dealing with dragons, preserving your ability to run away is critical.

sourceFields.name: Dragon Knight's Sabatons
sourceFields.str_version_22: Forged in a master blacksmith's furnace and stamped with runes of protection, a Dragon Knight's suit of armor is their last and best line of defense against the horrid flames and claws of their scaly foes! These shoes are but one link of many in that chain of defense, a perfect way to keep your feet safe! Keep these in mind the next time you want to try walking on coals at a luau, too - I mean, who would do that in bare feet??

sourceFields.name: Legendary Dragon Knight's Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Bestowed upon only the bravest, most prestigious, most skilled Dragon Knights, these wings are so rare that in all the centuries since the first Dragon Knights arose, barely a handful have been awarded. Will you be the next to bear their illustrious might? To take to the skies and soar like the very dragons you hunt? If you possess these wings, there's little question you've proven your worth - and dedication.

sourceFields.name: Dragon Knight's Spear
sourceFields.str_version_22: Capable of subduing the mightiest drake! Of course, you need to actually GET the pointy tip of the spear TO the drake, but that's where all the Dragon Knight armor comes in handy!

sourceFields.name: Dragon Turtle Charm
sourceFields.str_version_22: A snapping beast of the crushing deep! It's said that the oldest dragon turtles can grow so large, whole islands can grow on their backs! Fortunately, this one's still small and feisty, and seems happy to follow you on your adventures!

sourceFields.name: Super-Dragon Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Look! Up in the sky! It's a bird! It's a plane! It's... SUPER DRA- AIIEEE! RUN! THERE'S FIRE EVERYWHERE!

sourceFields.name: Ghost Dragon Charm
sourceFields.str_version_22: A dragon pulled from the Other Side! Top Dragonologists have been debating whether this creature is actually the ghost of a single dragon or a conjoined ectoplasmic hive composed of many smaller ghosts working together, but all of them can agree that it keeps eating anyone who asks about it, so it's best not to worry.

sourceFields.name: Gourmet Dragon Claw
sourceFields.str_version_22: A dragon who appreciates the finer things in life - as long as you can eat them.

sourceFields.name: Emergency Dragon Claw
sourceFields.str_version_22: Not all dragons are here to stomp and burn! Sure, this dragon still causes emergencies, but it also helps to patch people up afterward!

sourceFields.name: Jormungandr
sourceFields.str_version_22: A spiraling serpent of the fathomless deep, this colossal beast once circled all of Midgard with coils the size of warships! Now it's taking a break from causing maelstroms to join you in your adventures!

sourceFields.name: Prehistoric Dragon Claw
sourceFields.str_version_22: A dragon from a bygone time, what it lacks in modern refinements it more than makes up for in ancient biting power and unintelligible grunts!

sourceFields.name: Star Dragon Claw
sourceFields.str_version_22: A living constellation, this beautiful dragon was born in the heart of a brilliant nebula. It's come down to your world to explore, and it's very happy to have you as its guide!

sourceFields.name: Chaos Dragon
sourceFields.str_version_22: Don't look at it. Don't think about it. Don't. Even. Move. This... THING isn't a dragon. I don't know what it is - only that it's deadly dangerous and forged from the void itself. Beware, dear Growtopian, because I think it's noticed you...

sourceFields.name: Heartking's Crown
sourceFields.str_version_22: Love rules, and who better to embody that than the grandest nobility in all the Heartlands: the King and Queen of Heart! This crown is part of the King's personal wardrobe, and his warmth and affection for his subjects practically spill from it!

sourceFields.name: Heartking's Robes
sourceFields.str_version_22: Love rules, and who better to embody that than the grandest nobility in all the Heartlands: the King and Queen of Hearts! These robes are part of the King's personal wardrobe, and his warmth and affection for his subjects practically spill from them!

sourceFields.name: Heartqueen's Crown
sourceFields.str_version_22: Love rules, and who better to embody that than the grandest nobility in all the Heartlands: the King and Queen of Hearts! This crown is part of the Queen's personal wardrobe, and her delight and care for her subjects practically explode from it!

sourceFields.name: Heartqueen's Robes
sourceFields.str_version_22: Love rules, and who better to embody that than the grandest nobility in all the Heartlands: the King and Queen of Hearts! These robes are part of the Queen's personal wardrobe, and her delight and care for her subjects practically explode from them!

sourceFields.name: Heartstaff
sourceFields.str_version_22: Taken from the personal armory of the King and Queen of Heart, this staff is capable of batting away all but the saddest thoughts and mending even the most melancholy of hearts!

sourceFields.name: Golden Heartstaff
sourceFields.str_version_22: Infused with the golden light of romance, this heartstaff has been enhanced beyond its already-impressive start as a weapon of the heart to become a shining example of the power of love! Careful, though - for love can sometimes hit far harder than any edge!

sourceFields.name: Heartsword
sourceFields.str_version_22: Taken from the personal armory of the King and Queen of Heart, this sword is capable of slicing through all but the saddest thoughts and bringing joy to even the most melancholy of hearts!

sourceFields.name: Golden Heartsword
sourceFields.str_version_22: Infused with the golden light of romance, this heartsword has been enhanced beyond its already-impressive start as a weapon of the heart to become a shining example of the power of love! Careful, though - for love can sometimes cut far deeper than any blade!

sourceFields.name: Stained Glass Heartwings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Shining, radiant, wondrous. These wings aren't powered by magic or science or anything so mundane - they're infused with purest love, capable of uplifting all who wear them into the skies! Touch the heavens and smile, for by wearing these beauties, you have proclaimed yourself a true champions of the heart!

sourceFields.name: Morty the Gray Elephant
sourceFields.str_version_22: Have you ever forgotten how amazing you look? How cool your style is? Well an elephant NEVER forgets, so take a tour in Morty's fashionable gray ears and remember your awesomeness for all time! Wait - what's that? Your friends don't think it's all that great? Well, maybe a HAIL OF PEANUTS will make them reconsider! GET 'EM, MORTY!

sourceFields.name: Morty the Orange Elephant
sourceFields.str_version_22: Have you ever forgotten how amazing you look? How cool your style is? Well an elephant NEVER forgets, so take a tour in Morty's fashionable orange ears and remember your awesomeness for all time! Wait - what's that? Your friends don't think it's all that great? Well, maybe a HAIL OF PEANUTS will make them reconsider! GET 'EM, MORTY!

sourceFields.name: Morty the Pink Elephant
sourceFields.str_version_22: Have you ever forgotten how amazing you look? How cool your style is? Well an elephant NEVER forgets, so take a tour in Morty's fashionable pink ears and remember your awesomeness for all time! Wait - what's that? Your friends don't think it's all that great? Well, maybe a HAIL OF PEANUTS will make them reconsider! GET 'EM, MORTY!

sourceFields.name: Morty the Diamond Elephant
sourceFields.str_version_22: Have you ever forgotten how amazing you look? How cool your style is? Well an elephant NEVER forgets, so take a tour in Morty's incredibly rare and glorious diamond ears and remember your awesomeness for all time! Wait - what's that? Your friends don't think it's all that great? Well, maybe a HAIL OF PEANUTS will make them reconsider! GET 'EM, MORTY!

sourceFields.name: Garden Shears
sourceFields.str_version_22: Keep those unruly hedges in check with a dainty snip-snip from these shears!

sourceFields.name: Country Tweed Waistcoat & Tie
sourceFields.str_version_22: Cor! Part of a smashing new line of country-inspired clothes. With this fine waistcoat/tie combo, you'll be the last word in rural nobility!

sourceFields.name: Country Tweed Open Jacket
sourceFields.str_version_22: Cor! Part of a smashing new line of country-inspired clothes. This jacket will make you seem anything but closed - after all, a friend in tweed is a friend indeed!

sourceFields.name: Country Tweed Trousers
sourceFields.str_version_22: Cor! Part of a smashing new line of country-inspired clothes! These trousers are perfect for a stroll through your gardens or perhaps a vigorous game of croquet!

sourceFields.name: Country Tweed Flat Cap
sourceFields.str_version_22: Cor! Part of a smashing new line of country-inspired clothes! This cap will keep the sun out of your eyes as you walk your manor's grounds and make you look extra-jaunty as you tip it to your neighbors!

sourceFields.name: Country Tweed Jacket & Yellow Tie
sourceFields.str_version_22: Cor! Part of a smashing new line of country-inspired clothes! The touch of yellow in this jacket/tie combo would go marvelously with a spring festival - perhaps in your new manor's gardens?

sourceFields.name: Country Riding Breeches
sourceFields.str_version_22: Cor! Part of a smashing new line of country-inspired clothes! These bonzer breeches will keep you on horseback long after lesser riders have gone home! Try on a pair today - there's nothing wrong with being comfortable AND fashionable, after all.

sourceFields.name: Country Riding Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Cor! Part of a smashing new line of country-inspired clothes! This fine hat doesn't make you a better rider, but it DOES make you a more dashing one, and honestly, isn't that what riding animals is all about?

sourceFields.name: Guild Show Horse
sourceFields.str_version_22: Bred and groomed for competition, this flawless horse will have the judges saying anything but 'neigh'!

sourceFields.name: Guild Noble's Carriage
sourceFields.str_version_22: Sure, carriages like this look amazing on the outside, but what their owners won't tell you is that the interior is tricked out with a full surround sound system, flatscreen TVs, the latest gaming consoles, and a well-organized selection of candy!

sourceFields.name: Eagle Spirit
sourceFields.str_version_22: You are one with your spirit animal! The awesome guidance of the Eagle Spirit has given you the gift of double jump! Now go forth and clasp some crags with crooked hands!

sourceFields.name: War Hammers of Darkness
sourceFields.str_version_22: Seething with dark powers and intended for even darker designs, these weapons are for only the most tortured, brooding souls. You'd better have a tragic backstory all lined up before you even THINK of touching one!

sourceFields.name: Condor Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Condors are some of the largest flying birds in the world, which makes these wings fit for only the biggest and baddest Growtopians! Will you take on the condor's mantle and soar, or are you more of a... chicken?

sourceFields.name: Airplane Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Zoom! You don't need a silly engine, propeller, or any of that other mechanical garbage - not when you have THESE wings! Take to the skies just like the airplanes of old! Note: You may need to drink one or two liters of oil per day to keep them properly flappy.

sourceFields.name: Sturdy Crackfire Fighter
sourceFields.str_version_22: Pkow! Pkow! Stake your claim on the skies and do battle with old-fashioned flair in this crackfire fighter! Just make sure you're home in time for tea and toast!

sourceFields.name: Cardboard Sky Starter
sourceFields.str_version_22: You don't need a roaring engine or a blazing gun to claim the skies - just a bit of cardboard and a strong imagination! This Sky Starter will get you going, but it's up to you to make it soar!

sourceFields.name: Aviator Scarf
sourceFields.str_version_22: There's no point in flying around heroically if you don't have a flappy scarf to keep yourself warm! Nobody trusts a shivering hero, after all.

sourceFields.name: Aviator Jacket
sourceFields.str_version_22: Keeps you warm as you dance with the clouds and comes with all kinds of cool patches to show off your many marvelous accomplishments!

sourceFields.name: Aviator Glasses
sourceFields.str_version_22: Carefully sculpted to shine with a heroic glint as you pilot your battered-but-victorious plane home from battle!

sourceFields.name: Aviator Fighter Pilot Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: No self-respecting hero of the skies would go out without a dashing hat! Keep your perfectly-slicked hair and brilliant brain warm in even the chilliest clouds with this!

sourceFields.name: Air Force Flight Suit
sourceFields.str_version_22: Time to show everyone you've got the right stuff! Commandeer the fastest jets and set the most dangerous records in this super-sleek flight suit!

sourceFields.name: Spring Flinger Frog Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Celebrate the season with the new Spring Flinger Style! This mask doesn't just give you the face of a swift and hoppy frog - it also gives you a new style that stays fresh on water AND land! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...

sourceFields.name: Ultra Spring Flinger Frog Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Celebrate the season with the new ULTRA Spring Flinger Style! This mask doesn't just give you the face of an ULTRA swift and hoppy frog - it also gives you a new style that stays ULTRA fresh on water AND land! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both, and in such an ultra way! Go on, I'll wait...

sourceFields.name: Paintball Power Popper
sourceFields.str_version_22: Got tons of paint on your hands but feeling tired of walking ALL THE WAY over to a wall, or friend, or inanimate object to cover them in it? Well, whine no more! This high-powered paintball popper will plaster your pals in premium paint without pause (phew)!

sourceFields.name: Flaming Boxing Gloves
sourceFields.str_version_22: These gloves aren't aflame with basic fire - they're alight with the burning heart of BATTLE! Furious ringside magic has been embedded in these gloves, wrapping them in an eternal halo of blazing punch-power! And no, they are very definitely NOT regulation...

sourceFields.name: Spring Flinger Frog Suit
sourceFields.str_version_22: Celebrate the season with the new Spring Flinger Style! This suit doesn't just turn you into a swift and hoppy frog - it also turns you into an amphibiously cool one! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...

sourceFields.name: Ultra Spring Flinger Frog Suit
sourceFields.str_version_22: Celebrate the season with the new ULTRA Spring Flinger Style! This suit doesn't just turn you into an ULTRA swift and hoppy frog - it also gives you a new style that stays ULTRA fresh on water AND land!
