Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both, and in such an ultra way! Go on, I'll wait...

sourceFields.name: Forged Iron Skin
sourceFields.str_version_22: A gift of the gods, shaped by magic and fused by cosmic heat, this skin makes for the perfect armor. You'll never tire, never fall, never take one step back! ...though you may have to deal with a spot of rust now and then.

sourceFields.name: Ionic Pulse Cannon Tank
sourceFields.str_version_22: The titanium treads, super-heavy armor, and GrowTech hyperfusion reactor alone would make this the most expensive tank in history, and that's before you add an Ionic Pulse Devastator 7777 turret on top! Truly a tank for the most powerful nations - or richest collectors - in all the realms!

sourceFields.name: Burnished Sword
sourceFields.str_version_22: Shining with the help of GrowTech's extra-strength Sword Wax ("Wax on, slice off!"), this burnished blade is ready to chop your foes! Chosen by GusBhas, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for July, 2019!

sourceFields.name: Kairos' Apollo
sourceFields.str_version_22: In loving memory of Apollo. Kairos' loyal, loving companion. A special creature that will always be by her side and in her heart.

sourceFields.name: Kelpie
sourceFields.str_version_22: A shape-shifting water spirit, this creature normally hangs out in the lochs of Scotland, but it's decided to make an exception to adventure with you! Only found in Blarney 2 and 3.

sourceFields.name: Bagpipes
sourceFields.str_version_22: Ahh, the most calming and gentle of musical instruments. Just listen... *FREEOOOOOOOWWWWWWW HEORRRRRRNNNNNN EEEEEEEEEEEEE HOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!*

sourceFields.name: Fairy
sourceFields.str_version_22: A mighty magical sprite! You might think it's odd that it took over six years for an actual fairy to show up in Growtopia, but just remember, Fairy Wings were the VERY FIRST wing to be added to the game, and it took the Fairy Union a long time to get over it! Only found in Blarney 1 and 4.

sourceFields.name: Lucky Broach
sourceFields.str_version_22: Absolutely guaranteed to be maybe sorta kinda luckier than the average broach! ...possibly. A little. ... ... ...okay, not really.

sourceFields.name: Money Gun
sourceFields.str_version_22: Ka-ching! This doesn't just make it rain - it's an instant MONEY FLOOD! WOOHOO!

sourceFields.name: Hellfire Horns - Black
sourceFields.str_version_22: Searing bright with the infernal black blaze of the Underworld, these horns are stronger than tempered growmantium, sharper than a honed growlecular sabre, and more stylish than even the greatest GrowTech tailors could imagine!

sourceFields.name: Hellfire Horns - Blue
sourceFields.str_version_22: Searing bright with the infernal blue blaze of the Underworld, these horns are stronger than tempered growmantium, sharper than a honed growlecular sabre, and more stylish than even the greatest GrowTech tailors could imagine!

sourceFields.name: Hellfire Horns - Orange
sourceFields.str_version_22: Searing bright with the infernal orange blaze of the Underworld, these horns are stronger than tempered growmantium, sharper than a honed growlecular sabre, and more stylish than even the greatest GrowTech tailors could imagine!

sourceFields.name: Hellfire Horns - Ruby
sourceFields.str_version_22: Searing bright with the infernal ruby blaze of the Underworld, these horns are stronger than tempered growmantium, sharper than a honed growlecular sabre, and more stylish than even the greatest GrowTech tailors could imagine!

sourceFields.name: Spring Flinger Shoes
sourceFields.str_version_22: Celebrate the season with the new Spring Flinger Style! These shoes won't just put a smile on your face and a spring in your step - they'll also give you a new style that works wonders in both boring boardrooms AND beautiful beaches! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...

sourceFields.name: Ultra Spring Flinger Shoes
sourceFields.str_version_22: Celebrate the season with the new ULTRA Spring Flinger Style! These shoes won't just put an ULTRA-happy smile on your face and an ULTRA-swift spring in your step - they'll also give you a new style that works wonders in both boring boardrooms AND beautiful beaches! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both, and in such an ultra way! Go on, I'll wait...

sourceFields.name: S.P.I.D.E.R. Legs
sourceFields.str_version_22: At last! The Speedy Palpating Incredibly Deadly Electronic Roamers are the perfect replacement for those pesky human legs everyone seems to have. Seriously, have you noticed how many people have those weak, totally non-metallic and uninteresting NORMAL legs? Why would you want something so... overdone? Use the S.P.I.D.E.R., and get going in wonderfully horrible style!

sourceFields.name: Junk Cannon
sourceFields.str_version_22: No block stays awesome forever, even if you're firing it out of a recoilless GrowTech-certified gauss chamber with 1.21 growgajoules of force... which is why the Junk Cannon is leagues ahead of all other block-blasting battlegear! What CAN'T it fire? Where does it get all those blocks from? How can it never run out of ammunition? Sorry, the answers to those questions can only be provided if you have GrowTech Security Clearance Level Indigo or higher, but hey - you can still shoot the gun as much as you want! Woohoo!

sourceFields.name: Purple Aura
sourceFields.str_version_22: You are burning with magical, octarine energies!

sourceFields.name: Green Aura
sourceFields.str_version_22: You are burning with earthly, verdant energies!

sourceFields.name: NekoRei's Fluffy Micio
sourceFields.str_version_22: So twitchy!

sourceFields.name: NekoRei's Fluffy Tail
sourceFields.str_version_22: So swishy!

sourceFields.name: Balloon Bunny
sourceFields.str_version_22: Bunny bunny bunny balloon balloon balloon bunny balloon bunny balloon bunny bunny balloon balloon.

sourceFields.name: Pet Egg
sourceFields.str_version_22: This creature is so friendly, it hasn't even hatched and it already wants to be your friend!

sourceFields.name: Big Goofy Teeth
sourceFields.str_version_22: Do you ever feel like you can never show enough teeth? Well, toss these on and give yourself a grin that'll rival even the rarest rabbits!

sourceFields.name: Claws of Barko
sourceFields.str_version_22: Honed in lightless caves where only the most devious rabbits dare to hop, these claws are used for far deadlier things than digging cute bunny burrows!

sourceFields.name: Bowler Bunny Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Perfect for when you need to attend a very stylish event that happens to be hosted by rabbits.

sourceFields.name: Drabbit's Foot
sourceFields.str_version_22: Once upon a time, a dragon and a rabbit loved each other very much. Even the wisest sages aren't sure how this happened, and nobody likes to think about how it worked, but the wondrous drabbit was the result, and now with this talisman, a touch of its provider-enhancing wisdom can be yours!

sourceFields.name: Psychotic Bunny Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Styled after Hannibun Lopter, the notorious psycho-rabbit!

sourceFields.name: Riding Bunny
sourceFields.str_version_22: Takes you to and fro with little hops and a lot of love! There's no cuter way to travel - just look at that cute bunny face and twitchy nose!

sourceFields.name: Easter Egg Cannon
sourceFields.str_version_22: Powered by a Fuel Pack on your back, this gun can launch free easter egg blocks at your fellow Growtopians! Don't waste shots at anything else, though, because they still burn fuel!

sourceFields.name: Mah-Kah-Ron Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: The subscriber item for March 2019, chosen by EloraFaline! So good-looking, you'd swear it's a deliciously crispy treat instead of a lovely hat - but don't eat it, because then you wouldn't have a hat, and you'd also have eaten a bunch of fabric, which would probably be bad.

sourceFields.name: Holy Jeans
sourceFields.str_version_22: Jam-packed with so much holy might, they're, uh... wait, are these just jeans with lots of holes in them? But... how'd they get so dang POWERFUL, then?

sourceFields.name: Buddy's Block Head
sourceFields.str_version_22: The nicest block around - it's not just your friend... it's your buddy! Equip it and watch your hoard grow... Gives you a chance of dropping an additional block when breaking blocks!

sourceFields.name: Glowy Cape
sourceFields.str_version_22: Bringing light to even the darkest places and dimmest worlds, this cape will surround its bearer with an astonishingly pure light!

sourceFields.name: Da Vinci Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Da Vinci actually thought he could fly with these. He was totally wrong - they only let you double jump and glide.

sourceFields.name: Genie's Lamp - Green
sourceFields.str_version_22: Who needs wishes when you can GRANT them? This lamp will transform you into a glorious green genie of magic and mirth. Phenomenal cosmic power awaits!

sourceFields.name: Genie's Lamp - Yellow
sourceFields.str_version_22: Who needs wishes when you can GRANT them? This lamp will transform you into a youthful yellow genie of magic and mirth. Phenomenal cosmic power awaits!

sourceFields.name: Genie's Lamp - Red
sourceFields.str_version_22: Who needs wishes when you can GRANT them? This lamp will transform you into a resplendent red genie of magic and mirth. Phenomenal cosmic power awaits!

sourceFields.name: Genie's Lamp - Blue
sourceFields.str_version_22: Who needs wishes when you can GRANT them? This lamp will transform you into a brilliant blue genie of magic and mirth. Phenomenal cosmic power awaits!

sourceFields.name: Spring Flinger Squirrel Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Celebrate the season with the new Spring Flinger Style! This mask doesn't just give you the face of a cheeky squirrel - it also helps you stay twitchy on land AND tree alike! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...!

sourceFields.name: Ultra Spring Flinger Squirrel Suit
sourceFields.str_version_22: Celebrate the season with the new ULTRA Spring Flinger Style! This suit doesn't just turn you into an ULTRA cheeky squirrel - it also gives you a new style that stays ULTRA twitchy on land AND tree alike! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both, and in such an ULTRA way! Go on, I'll wait...!

sourceFields.name: Steampunk Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Clattering gears and finely-tuned cogs whir and whiz as you don these brass and copper beauties! Thanks to the meticulous magic of steam and jewel precision of luxury mechanists, these wings are at home in the soot-streaked skies of any steampunk world!

sourceFields.name: Magic Magnet
sourceFields.str_version_22: Tired of wading through clouds of items and loading up your inventory with random junk when all you want is a single thing? Just tune this magnet to the proper frequencies and it'll nab exactly what you're missing as you move past!

sourceFields.name: Legendary Comet Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: The Night of the Comet is alive... in your HAIR! Roiling with color, every follicle of this otherworldly hair was chipped out of the cosmos, flowing and bubbling with all the energy of the great beyond!

sourceFields.name: Reg4shi's Archangel Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: He has intervened for the sake of Growtopians time and again, for he sees the potential for heroism, creativity and selflessness in each of us. He has even sacrificed his weekends to fight on our behalf. For that alone, we always have and always will believe in him.

sourceFields.name: Coati Scarf
sourceFields.str_version_22: This little South American raccoon is full of mischief and curiosity, but right now, he needs a soft place to snuzzle up! Will you let him hop onto your shoulders and share some adorable warmth?

sourceFields.name: Fiesta Coati Scarf
sourceFields.str_version_22: This little guy knows how to party! Full of spicy style and fearsome curiosity, there's nothing more rambunctious than a coati out on the town - and around your neck!

sourceFields.name: Riding Llama
sourceFields.str_version_22: Careful! They may look fluffy and weird, but these guys spit. And bite. And talk about you behind your back. Llamas, right?

sourceFields.name: Scarfy-Scarf
sourceFields.str_version_22: Whether you're rocketing down city streets on an apocalyptic adventure or simply trying to keep warm while looking good, this scarf won't let you down! Chosen by TraxyGT, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for April, 2019!

sourceFields.name: Hairy Legs
sourceFields.str_version_22: Who needs pants when you have all-natural heating for your legs?

sourceFields.name: Eyes on Stalks
sourceFields.str_version_22: Alien eyes for your alien face, with alien lasers to destroy the human race!

sourceFields.name: Riding Poop
sourceFields.str_version_22: Yes, it's real, and it moves just as quickly as you do after one too many fast food meals!

8358.name: The Beast with a Thousand Eyes Mask

sourceFields.name: The Beast with a Thousand Eyes Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Keep your eye on the prize - literally every prize - with this horrific headful of staring alien eyeballs!

sourceFields.name: Puggly
sourceFields.str_version_22: This dogbomination eats everything when your back is turned, and then horks it right back up when it has your attention! How cute! Wait, did I say cute? I meant BLEARGHGHGHGH!

sourceFields.name: The Fly
sourceFields.str_version_22: A buzzing beast, engorged by science and merged with your poor head! How will you ever date again?

sourceFields.name: Horrid Snotty Face
sourceFields.str_version_22: Just dripping with happiness, this is truly a face only a mother could love!

sourceFields.name: Extra Undead Arms
sourceFields.str_version_22: Since when was two arms enough for you to get anything done? Let's stack on a few more and get this party started!

sourceFields.name: Riding 'roach
sourceFields.str_version_22: Just a friendly cockroach you decided to befriend instead of squish! It'll take you wherever you like, provided there's some delicious rotting food for it to snack on along the way!

sourceFields.name: Undead Slippers
sourceFields.str_version_22: Technically, all your shoes are dead. These just happen to be particularly obvious about it.

sourceFields.name: Giant Eye Head
sourceFields.str_version_22: Give your friends an eyeful with this baleful, beady-eyed orb! As an added bonus, you can probably win every last staring contest now!

sourceFields.name: Bob The Gross Blob
sourceFields.str_version_22: Not to be confused with Bob the Handsome Blob!

sourceFields.name: Webbed Hand
sourceFields.str_version_22: A webbed hand for Fish-Squished!

sourceFields.name: Blob of Goop
sourceFields.str_version_22: A blob of goop for Spaced-Faced!

sourceFields.name: Inflamed Nose
sourceFields.str_version_22: Don't get too excited by the name - this nose doesn't shoot fire, unfortunately. It's just the sign of a sick Growtopian!

sourceFields.name: Dirt Grass Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: Wow, your hair looks like the grass on top of dirt!

sourceFields.name: Galactic Destructor - Green
sourceFields.str_version_22: Stolen from an Imperial shipment and bearing Galactic Danger Code THX1136, this super-weapon has but one purpose: Total destruction! A galactic menace in giga-green, this monster of a weapon will take all of your strength to lift, and all of your courage to fire.

sourceFields.name: Galactic Destructor - Purple
sourceFields.str_version_22: Stolen from an Imperial shipment and bearing Galactic Danger Code THX1136, this super-weapon has but one purpose: Total destruction! A galactic menace in pew-pew-purple, this monster of a weapon will take all of your strength to lift, and all of your courage to fire.

sourceFields.name: Galactic Destructor - Red
sourceFields.str_version_22: Stolen from an Imperial shipment and bearing Galactic Danger Code THX1136, this super-weapon has but one purpose: Total destruction! A galactic menace in red-alert-red, this monster of a weapon will take all of your strength to lift, and all of your courage to fire.

sourceFields.name: Galactic Destructor - Blue
sourceFields.str_version_22: Stolen from an Imperial shipment and bearing Galactic Danger Code THX1136, this super-weapon has but one purpose: Total destruction! A galactic menace in blaster-blue, this monster of a weapon will take all of your strength to lift, and all of your courage to fire.

sourceFields.name: Doctor's Blingin' Cross
sourceFields.str_version_22: Gleaming gold to mark its bearer as the finest - and most stylish - doctor in all the worlds! It's said that those who wear the Cross of Bling will experience dramatically shorter lives, but they'll be full of adventure, right up to the end!

sourceFields.name: Doctor's Blingin' Cap
sourceFields.str_version_22: Gleaming gold to mark its bearer as the finest - and most stylish - doctor in all the worlds! The Cap of Bling is a treasured hallmark of doctorhood, as it protects patients from seeing your mussy bedhead and dandruff! They'll never know!

sourceFields.name: Doctor's Blingin' Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Gleaming gold to mark its bearer as the finest - and most stylish - doctor in all the worlds! Because doctors encounter all manner of diseases, it's imperative that they keep from infecting their patients. The Mask of Bling is said to reduce the chances of contagion by 110%! Nobody is sure how that's mathematically possible, but they won't question it, either!

sourceFields.name: Doctor's Blingin' Top
sourceFields.str_version_22: Gleaming gold to mark its bearer as the finest - and most stylish - doctor in all the worlds! The Top of Bling is specially-woven to protect its bearer from the slices and dices of errant scalpels and thrashing patients! You can never be too careful when battling the slow creep of entropy!

sourceFields.name: Doctor's Blingin' Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: Gleaming gold to mark its bearer as the finest - and most stylish - doctor in all the worlds! Fun fact: At least 83% of all infections start from dirty knees! Wearing pants as well-made and sterile as these drops that rate down to NOTHING, which just goes to show that you can be professional and look amazing at the same time.

sourceFields.name: Hands of the Void
sourceFields.str_version_22: Deadly claws of chaos and rage, spun from the essence of haunted realms beyond the stars. Sometimes the void touches you, but with these, yours will be the touch of that strange darkness.

sourceFields.name: Feet of the Void
sourceFields.str_version_22: Dire darkness wraps your feet, turning every step into a footfall of doom. Flowers wither in your wake, small animals run screeching, and your shoes very definitely will not fit anymore.

sourceFields.name: Gut Buster
sourceFields.str_version_22: Looks terrifying, but this mess of guts is actually just the results of a stolen medical Train-E, some creative arts and crafts, and a whole lot of duct tape to stick it to your torso!

sourceFields.name: Stitchlips
sourceFields.str_version_22: Tired of all that talking? Take matters into your own hands and slap some stitches on those loquacious lips! You'll be silenced in seconds!

sourceFields.name: Clockwork Fish Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: This well-oiled fish has decided its grumpy days are behind it - it's decided to follow you around in all its clankering, over-geared beauty!

sourceFields.name: Clockwork Eyes
sourceFields.str_version_22: Gear yourself up for success and stare down your rivals with these superb spinners! The only downside? They need a lot of oil to keep spinning!

sourceFields.name: Howly Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Awooo! Tired or turning your head to the skies to howl at the moon on your own? Now this hat will do all your howling for you! Think of all the time you'll save!

sourceFields.name: Cupcake Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Show everyone your love of baked delights by topping yourself with a giant treat of your very own! Looks good enough to eat!

sourceFields.name: Big Belly
sourceFields.str_version_22: Looks like all that fine food has gotten the best of you! You should try to cut down on the caloric blocks and start punching more of them for exercise, but until then, this big 'ol belly is a sign of your sins.

sourceFields.name: Gem Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: Hair spun from twinkling crystals and concentrated gems! Its worth? Incalculable. Its beauty? Inconceivable. Your look? Incredible.

sourceFields.name: Chicken Feet
sourceFields.str_version_22: Ba-kaw! You've been afflicted by the infectious chickenfoot virus! Fortunately, the only real symptoms are having sweet chicken feet and an occasional taste for bugs.

sourceFields.name: Terrifying Toothface
sourceFields.str_version_22: Yikes! This toothy maw has one too many chompers! Can you imagine the dentist bills? And all the toothpaste? Sheesh, this thing is scary in more ways than one!

sourceFields.name: Loving Halo
sourceFields.str_version_22: A sign of a truly gracious and adoring soul. This halo marks you with love and adoration, healing you quickly with the power of the heart! Aww!

sourceFields.name: Chaos Corruption
sourceFields.str_version_22: Racing lines of chaos have consumed your blood, filling you with fiendish energy. While the corruption feeds on your spirit, you'll be faster, but at what cost?

sourceFields.name: Wormtouch
sourceFields.str_version_22: Wiggly worms are the best diggers, so it makes perfect sense that replacing your arms with GIANT WORMS would give you impressive digging skills. 100% perfect, unquestionable sense...

sourceFields.name: Snakewolf
sourceFields.str_version_22: Slithering with serpent speed, howling at the moon, and looking like a million world locks, this mythical snakewolf is your newest friend! Notes for care: Snakewolf likes rare steaks, lots of head scratches, and destroying your enemies.

sourceFields.name: Ghostking's Glory
sourceFields.str_version_22: All ghosts flock to the holder of the Ghostking's crown. Stolen from his empty throne on the Other Side, this spectral crown proclaims you the true ruler of all ghostkind! Unfortunately, that means you're about to make a lot of booful buddies! At least... until the Ghostking finds you...

sourceFields.name: The Fattenator
sourceFields.str_version_22: Dang, you are HUGE. With thickness like this, nobody's going to have much luck pushing YOU around.

sourceFields.name: Darkening Hood
sourceFields.str_version_22: Shrouding its bearer in stylish shadows, this hood is the perfect way to stay awesomely anonymous! Chosen by Placental, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for May, 2019!

sourceFields.name: Grumpy Pet Pineapple
sourceFields.str_version_22: This tiny terror hates feeling like the runt of the pineapple litter. He'll follow you around, but don't make jokes about his size! He's very upset about... well... everything!

sourceFields.name: Slippery Pineapple Squishers
sourceFields.str_version_22: As everyone knows, pineapples are the fastest of the fruits. Now, thanks to advanced GrowTech Squishscience, we've managed to imbue the speedy juice of the pineapple into these hyper-advanced shoes. What? You say they're just hollowed-out pineapples? Don't be silly - if that were true, how could they make you move so quickly?

sourceFields.name: Pineapple Skin Shirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: A tough skin for a tough Growtopian, both hiding a sweet, wonderful interior!

sourceFields.name: Howling Pineapple Crown
sourceFields.str_version_22: YEAAAAAAAAAAAAH! This pineapple is down to terrorize the town! Perched on your head, it will scream its fruity head off at anyone who comes near! Why, you ask? What, do pineapples suddenly need REASONS to start yelling at people?

sourceFields.name: Dangerous Pineapple Juice Backpack
sourceFields.str_version_22: This backpack is filled with swirling, deadly dangerous juice from only the most malicious of pineapples! With such feisty energy, you could certainly power something huge... like a Harvester!

sourceFields.name: UV Vaccine
sourceFields.str_version_22: This wonder of modern medicine is the Universal Vicious Vaccine, and your only hope against the most dangerous of maladies! Hold onto this as you operate, and be careful, because it'll get used whether you're successful or not!

sourceFields.name: Doctor's Blingin' Booties
sourceFields.str_version_22: Gleaming gold to mark its bearer as the finest - and most stylish - doctor in all the worlds! Set with nonslip treads of solid gold, these blingtastic booties will help you keep your footing in even the most slippery of surgical scenarios!

sourceFields.name: Angel of Mercy's Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: You bear the wings of a true savior, a surgeon without peer who has saved countless lives in their pursuit of the greater good. All who can hear the beat of these magnificently medicinal wings will know that their salvation has arrived.

sourceFields.name: Caduceaxe
sourceFields.str_version_22: Capable of extracting pure medical might from blocks, this caduceaxe is your ticket to vaccination victory! There's a chance it may break on vaccine extraction, but hey - it also has a chance of getting you more than a few fragments!

sourceFields.name: Dangerous Pineapple Fan Shirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: Who doesn't pineapple GT even when it's dangerous to do so?

sourceFields.name: Nightking's Cape - Dark Red
sourceFields.str_version_22: To defend the streets of a dark city, you'll need more than wits and skill - criminals need a symbol to fear, a sign of justice and vengeance alike, and without a righteously red cape like this, even the most amazing hero can't look the part. That, and its spring-loaded fabrics provide double-jump, because there's no harm in being practical while building your image!

sourceFields.name: Nightking's Cape - Dark Purple
sourceFields.str_version_22: To defend the streets of a dark city, you'll need more than wits and skill - criminals need a symbol to fear, a sign of justice and vengeance alike, and without a powerfully purple cape like this, even the most amazing hero can't look the part. That, and its spring-loaded fabrics provide double-jump, because there's no harm in being practical while building your image!

sourceFields.name: Nightking's Cape - Black
sourceFields.str_version_22: To defend the streets of a dark city, you'll need more than wits and skill - criminals need a symbol to fear, a sign of justice and vengeance alike, and without a brooding black cape like this, even the most amazing hero can't look the part. That, and its spring-loaded fabrics provide double-jump, because there's no harm in being practical while building your image!

sourceFields.name: Nightking's Cape - Midnight Blue
sourceFields.str_version_22: To defend the streets of a dark city, you'll need more than wits and skill - criminals need a symbol to fear, a sign of justice and vengeance alike, and without a beautifully blue cape like this, even the most amazing hero can't look the part. That, and its spring-loaded fabrics provide double-jump, because there's no harm in being practical while building your image!

sourceFields.name: Executioner's Axe
sourceFields.str_version_22: Finely honed for the perfect chop! Its blade might not go snicker-snack, but all the same, heads will roll! Chosen by rsrssh, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for June, 2019!

sourceFields.name: EzCookOven's Robotic Tentacles
sourceFields.str_version_22: Robotic allies to launch you to and fro! These high-tech tentacles were first developed to handle hazardous GrowTech waste, but their engineers discovered it was WAY more fun to use them to jump around instead (they can also play a mean game of chess, but most owners are too busy jumping to try)! Sponsored by EzCookOven for completing all epic quests!

sourceFields.name: Phoenix Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: Infused with the powers of the Emperor Phoenix, this staggeringly rare hair will astonish all who view it as it takes you to the skies! There are many beautiful hairs in the worlds of Growtopia, but none are quite so impressively enflamed!

sourceFields.name: Pet Toucan
sourceFields.str_version_22: Caw! This adorable avian ally likes tropical fruits, crunchy nuts, and keeping its beautiful beak sharp!

sourceFields.name: Polo Shirt - Blue
sourceFields.str_version_22: It's summer time, so toss on a shirt that helps you beat the heat while looking neat and fit! Now in burning sky blue!

sourceFields.name: Polo Shirt - Pink
sourceFields.str_version_22: It's summer time, so toss on a shirt that helps you beat the heat while looking neat and fit! Now in poppin' iced drink pink!

sourceFields.name: Aloha Floral Shirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: A Hawaiian style shirt straight out of the tropics to keep you cool and fantastically floral!

sourceFields.name: Aloha Floral Blouse
sourceFields.str_version_22: A Hawaiian style blouse designed with a tropical touch to keep you cool and fantastically floral!

sourceFields.name: Chinos - Pastel Orange
sourceFields.str_version_22: Summery pants that let you hit the streets with a breezy step and a touch of low-key class! Now in outrageous vacation orange!

sourceFields.name: Chinos - Pastel Blue
sourceFields.str_version_22: Summery pants that let you hit the streets with a breezy step and a touch of low-key class! Now in beautiful sunshine blue!

sourceFields.name: Crab Claw & Shield
sourceFields.str_version_22: Somewhere, there's a very sad, very unarmed crab out there. Don't feel bad, though - these were better off in your hands.

sourceFields.name: Dungeonist Crab Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: Once a many-limbed delver of dungeons, now a happy follower for you! Just... don't tell him how tasty he looks, okay? It makes him crabby.

sourceFields.name: Riding Flamingo
sourceFields.str_version_22: This pink pal got tired of standing around and decided to leg it over to you! Fancy a flamingotastic ride?

sourceFields.name: Straw Fedora
sourceFields.str_version_22: When you know you can rock a fedora like nobody's business but really want to hit the beach, it's time to embrace the ways of the straw hats!

sourceFields.name: Floppy Straw Sun Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Too much sun eating away at your beachtime fun? Flop on a hat like this and you'll not only be cool and shady, but look good doing it!

sourceFields.name: Pet Turtle
sourceFields.str_version_22: Are you turtley enough to join the Turtle Club? Maybe not, but with this guy at your side, they'll probably let you in anyway. It's all about who you know!

sourceFields.name: Shark Suit
sourceFields.str_version_22: Ace any job interview in seconds with this swimmingly sharp ensemble! If I were hiring, I know I'd appreciate any candidates to come dressed in their sharky best!

sourceFields.name: Shark Head
sourceFields.str_version_22: This piece of clothing really bites! But, like, in a good way. It's complicated. But also a shark, which is the more important part, really.

sourceFields.name: Muninn's Unity Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: A raven's resplendent wings for a resplendently regal individual! The skies are yours, wise one.

sourceFields.name: Porcelain Doll's Head
sourceFields.str_version_22: So pristine and perfect, it's practically an antique! For proper use, make sure to stockpile several hundred of these in identical rows and then leave them in your attic for guests to find years later. They'll love it.

sourceFields.name: Bamboo Pipe
sourceFields.str_version_22: Maybe not so fancy as those hoity-toity hardwoods, but bamboo has a kind of class all its own, wouldn't you say?

sourceFields.name: Flower Headband
sourceFields.str_version_22: Flowers brighten up more than just rooms - they also look great in your hair. YOUR hair, specifically, I mean. They look like garbage in everyone else's.

sourceFields.name: Lattice Dress
sourceFields.str_version_22: Think of how long the tireless seamstresses of GrowTech's fabric division had to spend sewing this dress! No wonder it looks so chic!

sourceFields.name: Serpent Headdress
sourceFields.str_version_22: Feeling envious of Medusa? Top yourself with this headdress and get at least a little closer to her hissy hair!

sourceFields.name: Monk's Hood
sourceFields.str_version_22: Pie Jesu Domine, dona eis requiem.

sourceFields.name: Bamboo Armor
sourceFields.str_version_22: You might think it's funny, seeing a warrior come at you in clattering bamboo plate, but you won't be laughing when you get whacked by a bamboo sword!

sourceFields.name: Bamboo Sword
sourceFields.str_version_22: Hollow, yet honed! Listen to the air howl as this blade whirls toward your foes!

sourceFields.name: Temple Robes
sourceFields.str_version_22: Look, if you're going keep attending temple in a frog outfit, nobody's going to want to sit next to you. At least wear these so you can look the part!

sourceFields.name: Obsidian Axe
sourceFields.str_version_22: Sure, obsidian is just volcanic glass, but cleave it just right, and you can get an edge that's sharper than any scalpel! Ouch!

sourceFields.name: Cute Bulb Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Aww! We're not sure what the heck this thing actually is, but it LOOKS adorable. I mean, at least until it starts firing lasers at you. Not sure how that works, either...

sourceFields.name: Riding Firefly
sourceFields.str_version_22: Zips around with a glorious glow! Note: Rides on this buddy bug should be free, so if he asks you to pay, it's probably a farefly!

sourceFields.name: Slithering Serpent Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: Everyone thinks it's GREAT to have hair made of snakes, but nobody ever thinks about how many mice you have to feed them...

sourceFields.name: Astro Shades - Red
sourceFields.str_version_22: Firing blasts of radical red light, these celestial-enhanced shades will light up your life, and like, anything else you look at with them! So try not to stare too long at valuable objects (or like, people)!

sourceFields.name: Astro Shades - Orange
sourceFields.str_version_22: Firing blasts of orangey orange light, these celestial-enhanced shades will light up your life, and like, anything else you look at with them! So try not to stare too long at valuable objects (or like, people)!

sourceFields.name: Astro Shades - Purple
sourceFields.str_version_22: Firing blasts of potent purple light, these celestial-enhanced shades will light up your life, and like, anything else you look at with them! So try not to stare too long at valuable objects (or like, people)!

sourceFields.name: Astro Shades - Green
sourceFields.str_version_22: Firing blasts of mean green light, these celestial-enhanced shades will light up your life, and like, anything else you look at with them! So try not to stare too long at valuable objects (or like, people)!

sourceFields.name: Black Shoes
sourceFields.str_version_22: From the most formal of occasions to the swankiest of clubs (on the darkest of nights, of course), everyone needs a pair of black shoes! These are extra-special, however, because they're YOURS.

sourceFields.name: TK69's Mystical Etherboard
sourceFields.str_version_22: Crush the skies between dimensions and surf the riptides of eternity with this mystical - and highly mobile - etherboard! Unfortunately, it looks like its GrowTech Time Circuits have shortcircuited (their warranty is only good for 5,000 years or parsecs, whichever comes first), so while this'll give you a boost of speed, it won't take you through time anymore... Sponsored by TK69 for completing all epic quests!

sourceFields.name: Rainbow Scarf
sourceFields.str_version_22: A wonderful mix of colors for a wonderful neck!

sourceFields.name: Black Cat Ears
sourceFields.str_version_22: They're so fuzzy! Top-tier scratchability and style, all in one double-pointed package.

sourceFields.name: Toucan's Bill
sourceFields.str_version_22: Ever see a bird with a colorful nut-crackin' beak and get jealous you don't have one? Well now, toucan play at that game!

sourceFields.name: Chic White Dress
sourceFields.str_version_22: Not just any white dress! If you couldn't already tell by how pretty this looks, we've carefully added the word 'chic' in the title to let everyone know the style here is off the charts!

sourceFields.name: Lace A-Line Dress
sourceFields.str_version_22: Absolutely stunning! Oh, and MUCH nicer than those B- and C-Line dresses! Don't even get me started on the D-Lines... sheesh!

sourceFields.name: White Tuxedo
sourceFields.str_version_22: When you want to stand out in a crowd of penguins (or investment bankers) without ruining the super-classy mood, try on this bright and beautiful tux!

sourceFields.name: Blue and Black Tuxedo
sourceFields.str_version_22: Class up the joint with the best kind of black-and-blue to get!

sourceFields.name: Samurai's Do Armor
sourceFields.str_version_22: Carefully-crafted overlapping pieces of protection for an honor-bound warrior. Do or Do not - there is no try.

sourceFields.name: Samurai's Kabuto
sourceFields.str_version_22: A stylized helm for an honor-bound warrior.

sourceFields.name: Samurai's Waraji
sourceFields.str_version_22: Flexible footwear for an honor-bound warrior.

sourceFields.name: Samurai's Suneate & Leggings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Protective leggings for an honor-bound warrior.

sourceFields.name: Valkyrie's Cuirass
sourceFields.str_version_22: A plate of unbreakable steel fit for the unbreakable will of the valkyrie!

sourceFields.name: Valkyrie's Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Flawless warrior wings for an unstoppable Chooser of the Slain!

sourceFields.name: Valkyrie's Helm
sourceFields.str_version_22: A helm of unbreakable steel fit for the unbreakable will (and beautiful face) of the valkyrie!

sourceFields.name: Valkyrie's Sandals
sourceFields.str_version_22: Nimble footwear for an agile Chooser of the Slain!

sourceFields.name: Map of Loki
sourceFields.str_version_22: This map's shifting letters seem to sizzle with doom and destruction, as if they're waiting for something - or somewhere - terrible...

sourceFields.name: Boy's School Uniform Shirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: A nicely-starched shirt! Clean, sharp, and ready for an education (or general misbehavior, depending on the day)!

sourceFields.name: Boy's School Uniform Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: Carefully-creased pants! Clean, sharp, and ready for an education (or general misbehavior, depending on the day)!

sourceFields.name: Girls's School Uniform Shirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: A nicely-starched shirt! Clean, sharp, and ready for an education (or general misbehavior, depending on the day)!

sourceFields.name: Girls's School Uniform Skirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: A freshly-laundered skirt! Clean, sharp, and ready for an education (or general misbehavior, depending on the day)!

sourceFields.name: Messy Braid
sourceFields.str_version_22: You didn't have time to put this braid together, but who cares? You've got blocks to break and economies to alter!

sourceFields.name: Messy Bun
sourceFields.str_version_22: You didn't have time to put this bun together, but who cares? You've got seeds to splice and economies to alter!

sourceFields.name: Long Full Bangs
sourceFields.str_version_22: Way better than those Short Empty Bangs offered by other, lesser hairstylists.

sourceFields.name: Hipster Beard
sourceFields.str_version_22: Embrace the hipster life! With this fancy facial hair, you won't be able to stop asking for artisanal coffee and single-origin beans!

sourceFields.name: Man Bun
sourceFields.str_version_22: A bun of hair, but with an extra swirl of testosterone to make it extra-manly!

sourceFields.name: Bed Head
sourceFields.str_version_22: WAKE UP! GET HARVESTING! START TRADING! What? NO, you don't have time to do your hair! Just GO GO GO! Growtopia waits for no-one, and certainly no hair!

sourceFields.name: Raccoon Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: Super-sneaky trash panda pet! Chitters and squeaks and loves treats (also, making a mess)!

sourceFields.name: Panda Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: A much more official panda than the raccoon, this stoic plant-muncher has just two requests: More bamboo, and MORE BAMBOO!

sourceFields.name: Riding World Lock - Green Light
sourceFields.str_version_22: Yahoo! Forget cars and dragons and sneakers and starships - when you want to see the worlds of Growtopia, only the world lock can take you anywhere! Hit the gas on this speedy security device and leave your friends in its glowing green wake!

sourceFields.name: Riding World Lock - Purple Light
sourceFields.str_version_22: Yahoo! Forget cars and dragons and sneakers and starships - when you want to see the worlds of Growtopia, only the world lock can take you anywhere! Hit the gas on this speedy security device and leave your friends in its pulsing purple wake!

sourceFields.name: Riding World Lock - White Light
sourceFields.str_version_22: Yahoo! Forget cars and dragons and sneakers and starships - when you want to see the worlds of Growtopia, only the world lock can take you anywhere! Hit the gas on this speedy security device and leave your friends in its blazing white wake!

sourceFields.name: Riding World Lock - Yellow Light
sourceFields.str_version_22: Yahoo! Forget cars and dragons and sneakers and starships - when you want to see the worlds of Growtopia, only the world lock can take you anywhere! Hit the gas on this speedy security device and leave your friends in its yummy yellow wake!

sourceFields.name: Masquerade Ball Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: With this decorative mask, even the most average growtopian can be the Belle of the Ball! Chosen by Ch4knuGT, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for August, 2019!

sourceFields.name: Tea Basket
sourceFields.str_version_22: Toss this on and any items you collect from a fully-grown tree will fall directly into your inventory! A little flimsy, so it's likely to break after you've collected a lot of stuff, but no less useful for it!

sourceFields.name: Leaf Blower
sourceFields.str_version_22: Tired of dealing with people? Wish they'd all just leaf you alone? Well, fire up this blower's GrowTech turbine and a storm of wind and fallen foliage will blast them into next year!

sourceFields.name: Scarecrow Pet
sourceFields.str_version_22: This little guy's tired of frightening birds (that time a flock of ravens stole his hat was the last straw), so he's decided to join up with you and see if your adventures are his kind of field!

sourceFields.name: Mosquito King's Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: On one hand, these wings will make you royalty and you'll constantly be surrounded by your adoring subjects. On the other, those subjects will be mosquitoes, and mosquitoes are the worst.

sourceFields.name: Ladakh Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Part of a cultural celebration of life, this mask isn't just a good-looking potential piece of your outfit! It's also used in a major dance festival in the Indian region of - you guessed it - Ladakh!

sourceFields.name: Ladakh Shirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: Part of a cultural celebration of life, this shirt isn't just a good-looking potential piece of your outfit! It's also used in a major dance festival in the Indian region of - you guessed it - Ladakh!

sourceFields.name: Ladakh Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: Part of a cultural celebration of life, these pants aren't just a good-looking potential piece of your outfit! They're also used in a major dance festival in the Indian region of - you guessed it - Ladakh!

sourceFields.name: Ladakh Shoes
sourceFields.str_version_22: Part of a cultural celebration of life, these shoes aren't just a good-looking potential piece of your outfit! They're also used in a major dance festival in the Indian region of - you guessed it - Ladakh!

sourceFields.name: Harvest Moon Charm
sourceFields.str_version_22: Mystic moonlight seeps from this charm, tipping your fields toward balance. As a result, while you wear it, your crops will be blessed with a higher chance of dropping Balance Mooncakes during the harvest!

sourceFields.name: Dual Crescent Blade
sourceFields.str_version_22: Forged in swirling desert sands, these ancient blades carry a hint of the siroccos in which they were made!

sourceFields.name: Sun Blade
sourceFields.str_version_22: Bane of vampires and mole people, the glorious Sun Blade casts a brilliant glow when held aloft! As a side bonus, it also provides its wielder with their daily recommended dose of Vitamin D.

sourceFields.name: Storm Breaker
sourceFields.str_version_22: As wielders of an ancient elemental power, those who hold this sky-shaking weapon will inspire awe in all who view them. Lo, the clouds shall part with a mighty crash of thunder, heralding your arrival!

sourceFields.name: Speeder
sourceFields.str_version_22: Perfect for zipping around an endless desert under the baleful glare of twin suns!

sourceFields.name: Sniper Rifle
sourceFields.str_version_22: Able to knock the wings off a fly at a thousand paces, this perfectly-calibrated rifle is an insect's greatest fear! Wait, you weren't planning on using it against anything else, were you??

sourceFields.name: Monster Truck
sourceFields.str_version_22: Full of fangs, fuel, and positraction, this beastly truck proves you don't need horsepower - not when you have MONSTERPOWER!

sourceFields.name: Healing Tome
sourceFields.str_version_22: A floating book filled with healthy tips and lost surgical arts! It'll follow you wherever you go, bringing good health to all. Well, except goats - it HATES goats (we think one tried to eat it).

sourceFields.name: Ghost Mobile
sourceFields.str_version_22: Haunted by the spirit of a legendary stunt driver, this car can go from zero to spectral in 0.6 seconds!

sourceFields.name: Ghost Rider Bike
sourceFields.str_version_22: Pulled from the underworld and wrapped in the flames of damnation, this bike is one scorchin' hot ride! Ow! Better wear some thicker pants!

sourceFields.name: Spring-Loaded Fists
sourceFields.str_version_22: Superb punching power - on springs! For those times when you REALLY want to punch someone and they're ALLL the way on the other side of the room!

sourceFields.name: Ring of Night
sourceFields.str_version_22: Binds its wielder to the darkness and makes them one with the night! You won't need the hated touch of light to illuminate the dark with this imposing artifact on your finger...

sourceFields.name: Steampunk Goggles
sourceFields.str_version_22: Fogged with the heat of your latest madcap mechanical monstrosity and lined in soot, these goggles have seen you through more than one unplanned explosion!

sourceFields.name: Colored Round Glasses
sourceFields.str_version_22: Viewing the past with colored glasses might not be a great idea, but the present? That just makes you look cool!

sourceFields.name: Anubis Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: The face of an AncieNt goD, forgottEn beneath tRackless desert sands, has fallEn into youR hands! Imagine what the eyes behind this strange mask Once saw...

sourceFields.name: Anubis Seal
sourceFields.str_version_22: Heavy plate to entomb the might of an Ancient god! How could This Have found its way across thE tRackless wastes to yOu? from what dark dangers did it protect its former owner...?

sourceFields.name: Anubis Mail
sourceFields.str_version_22: Overlapping plates and sunForged chain to proTect an ancient god! WHen did Anubis losE this? Or perhaps he Found something Even stronger...

sourceFields.name: Anubis Greaves
sourceFields.str_version_22: Scoured by the desert sands, like a Jewel, these greaves cUt through towering dunes in the Service of Their enIgmatiC ownEr!

sourceFields.name: Anubis Boots
sourceFields.str_version_22: Even strange And mystical godS of the ancient world Knew the benefit of good footwear. these boots can Help you defy the dEsert heat Without losing your cool!

sourceFields.name: Spirit of Anubis
sourceFields.str_version_22: Drawn back from the endless deserts of the afterlife, the power of Anubis flows through you! By combining his relics, you have summoned his spirit from across the gulf of time, and in thanks for freeing him from the embrace of the void, he has agreed to lend a portion of his might to you in your adventures!

sourceFields.name: Cursed Spirit Pendant - Red
sourceFields.str_version_22: Howling with repugnant red energy and generally bad vibes, this pendant was found locked in an iron trunk in the basement of a dark castle. THEN it was buried with its former owner (who died of mysterious causes) before being stolen by graverobbers. THEN it was sold to an evil general before being lost on a wartorn battlefield. AND THEN... it found its way to you. Quake in terror, mortal, for this is surely the most haunted object to be found in Growtopia... so far!

sourceFields.name: Cursed Spirit Pendant - Green
sourceFields.str_version_22: Howling with gruesome green energy and generally bad vibes, this pendant was found locked in an iron trunk in the basement of a dark castle. THEN it was buried with its former owner (who died of mysterious causes) before being stolen by graverobbers. THEN it was sold to an evil general before being lost on a wartorn battlefield. AND THEN... it found its way to you. Quake in terror, mortal, for this is surely the most haunted object to be found in Growtopia... so far!

sourceFields.name: Cursed Spirit Pendant - Purple
sourceFields.str_version_22: Howling with pulsing purple energy and generally bad vibes, this pendant was found locked in an iron trunk in the basement of a dark castle. THEN it was buried with its former owner (who died of mysterious causes) before being stolen by graverobbers. THEN it was sold to an evil general before being lost on a wartorn battlefield. AND THEN... it found its way to you. Quake in terror, mortal, for this is surely the most haunted object to be found in Growtopia... so far!

sourceFields.name: Cursed Spirit Pendant - Blue
sourceFields.str_version_22: Howling with blasted blue energy and generally bad vibes, this pendant was found locked in an iron trunk in the basement of a dark castle. THEN it was buried with its former owner (who died of mysterious causes) before being stolen by graverobbers. THEN it was sold to an evil general before being lost on a wartorn battlefield. AND THEN... it found its way to you. Quake in terror, mortal, for this is surely the most haunted object to be found in Growtopia... so far!

sourceFields.name: Superfly Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: The sweetest hat for the smoothest of Growtopians, this is what you should be slipping on when you want the coolest style possible! Chosen by FarmWizard, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for September, 2019!

sourceFields.name: Scythe of the Underworld
sourceFields.str_version_22: Dripping with dark magic, the blade of this horrific scythe is capable of cutting through the veil of life and death itself! Wrenched into the mortal plane by dire sorcery, it's now free to wreak havoc among the living!

sourceFields.name: Tarantula Legs
sourceFields.str_version_22: Skitter, skitter, goes the spider. Long legs and longer shadows reach out from their monstrous owner... you.

sourceFields.name: Horns of Growganoth
sourceFields.str_version_22: The Dark One walks among us! You have been cursed (or blessed, depending on your level of evil) with the dire sign of Growganoth itself! These horns are a sure sign you've taken one step too far across the line between good and ghastly! `2Buff:`` Bonus 250 XP for consuming a Dark Ticket for the Tomb of Growganoth!

sourceFields.name: Supernaturally Speedy Black High Heels
sourceFields.str_version_22: Super-fast and super-stylish, these heels will get you where you need to be in a flash! Only problem is that they're really, REALLY uncomfortable, especially once you hit Mach 2...

sourceFields.name: Dark Fairy Pendant
sourceFields.str_version_22: This fairy used to be full of goodness, gumdrops, and light, but a few bad decisions, one too many hits of pixie dust, and hanging around with the wrong crowd led her down the path to darkness!

sourceFields.name: Totally Harmless Doll Head
sourceFields.str_version_22: What's scarier? A totally harmless doll that stays in one place until you look away... or a Growtopian wearing its head?!

sourceFields.name: Totally Harmless Doll Shirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: What's scarier? A totally harmless doll that stays in one place until you look away... or a Growtopian wearing its shirt?!

sourceFields.name: Totally Harmless Doll Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: What's scarier? A totally harmless doll that stays in one place until you look away... or a Growtopian wearing its pants?!

sourceFields.name: Demon Night Stallion
sourceFields.str_version_22: Now THIS is a horse that'll make you say neigh! If you dare to ride it, make sure you have plenty of evil sugar cubes and cursed carrots to tempt it into not stomping you flat!

sourceFields.name: Cursed Katana
sourceFields.str_version_22: A once-honorable blade, this katana was renowned as a slayer of evil, but the void stares back, as they say, and centuries of carnage have twisted it to the ways of darkness! Beware this blade, for those who wield it... are forever cursed!

sourceFields.name: Hilarious Honker
sourceFields.str_version_22: Some people are scared of clowns, but who could be afraid of this cute little guy? Summoned by the whimsical toots of his magical horn, Binky is here to amuse and play!

sourceFields.name: Chimera's Call
sourceFields.str_version_22: A bizarre creature out of myth! The chimera may be a mash-up of many animals, but every last part is filled with an equal amount of friendship for you!

sourceFields.name: Rainbow Crystal Cloak
sourceFields.str_version_22: Rainbow cloth studded with shimmering crystals! The multicolored majesty of this cloak will carry you aloft, where all can gaze upon your prismatic wonder!

sourceFields.name: Claw Of Growganoth
sourceFields.str_version_22: A creeping being from the darkest depths of the void! Summoned by the fractured claw of its master, is this monstrous thing truly a creation of Growganoth... or something darker?

sourceFields.name: Nano Nurse Bot
sourceFields.str_version_22: Filled with helpful nanobots to improve your surgery successes (and maybe keep you from losing an item or two)!

sourceFields.name: Battle Boots
sourceFields.str_version_22: Stomp your foes... but not your wallet! These boots are made for victories, so put 'em on and get to winning!

sourceFields.name: Alpha's Shawl
sourceFields.str_version_22: For those who refuse to heed the call of the pack, this shawl will show everyone you'll never follow - only lead! AwooooOOOOOOoooo!

sourceFields.name: Mega-Hooky Vest
sourceFields.str_version_22: A big fish needs a bigger hook, and this vest has plenty to spare! Toss this on and cast off for a fishy victory!

sourceFields.name: Superb Chef's Super Spatula
sourceFields.str_version_22: Get your flip on! This spatula will flip any objects with a single slap! Use it on chairs, beds, and anything else you find facing the wrong way! Best of all, it's made of patented GrowTech spatulanium, guaranteed to stay firm even after a thousand slaps!

sourceFields.name: Slippery Chemical Coat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Coated in frictionless chemicals! This coat is utterly spattered with the most nonstick, inertia-preserving, super-lubricated slip-n'-slide mix, so if you're wearing it, make sure you're not near anything sharp!

sourceFields.name: Rocket-Powered Warhammer
sourceFields.str_version_22: Forget using your puny human muscles to swing this hammer! It's so big and bashy, it uses ROCKET POWER to crack the skies and shatter the earth! Look out!

sourceFields.name: Tainted Cheese
sourceFields.str_version_22: The rat summoned by this cheese is very friendly, but also very ill! Why would you want this plagued vermin for a pet? Well, getting a rare malady isn't always a bad thing, assuming you have a good doctor to help cure it!

sourceFields.name: Friendship Dragon Claw
sourceFields.str_version_22: There are many dragons out there - dragons of fire and disaster, dragons of home and hearth, and even dragons from beyond the stars - but NONE are so friendly as this one! Known as Hugalovensnugglor (Hugsy to his closest friends), this dragon is only too happy to shower the world (and you) with hearts!

sourceFields.name: Spectral Mantle
sourceFields.str_version_22: Writhing chains from the Other Side! These spirit-forged links are meant to capture the most terrible of ghosts, but since you're not, y'know, DEAD, they just look very cool (and maybe a little creepy).

sourceFields.name: Captain's Log
sourceFields.str_version_22: A high-tech diary to record your latest findings! The incredible efficiency possible through careful record-keeping may even give you a chance of not using up a Star Tool during a Star Mission! Wow!

sourceFields.name: Dark Doctor's Cloak
sourceFields.str_version_22: Not all doctors are concerned with their patients! For some, like those who bear this dire cloak, they only live for the challenge of the most vicious of diseases, and wearing this cloak will increase their odds of getting them from Vile Vials! Yikes!

sourceFields.name: Loot Detector
sourceFields.str_version_22: Perfect for treasure-seekers! This detector will increase your odds of finding maps and map fragments in Treasure Blasts, which is weird, considering they're not made of metal. Hey, how does this thing work, anyway?!

sourceFields.name: Ghostking's Command
sourceFields.str_version_22: A rod of command stripped from the forces of the Other Side! This spectral scepter won't necessarily make ghosts any happier to see you, but it WILL decrease the odds that a Spirit Storage Unit will detonate at lower, less-lucrative levels in worlds you own!

sourceFields.name: Guild Challenge Crown
sourceFields.str_version_22: Congratulations! Your guild was #1 in a Guild Daily Challenge! Show off your accomplishment with a shiny crown. Ooh, so shiny!

sourceFields.name: Nightmare Teeny Devil Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Now with extra nightmares to terrify you and everyone else! You wanna float?

sourceFields.name: Red Laser Scimitar
sourceFields.str_version_22: Carve the very air itself with energy-edged annihilation! Designed to exacting standards by GrowTech's Department of Slicing & Dicing, this blazing red blade will show your foes that when it comes to bleeding-edge weaponry, you can't beat an edge made of LASERS!

sourceFields.name: Green Laser Scimitar
sourceFields.str_version_22: Carve the very air itself with energy-edged annihilation! Designed to exacting standards by GrowTech's Department of Slicing & Dicing, this blazing green blade will show your foes that when it comes to bleeding-edge weaponry, you can't beat an edge made of LASERS!

sourceFields.name: Blue Laser Scimitar
sourceFields.str_version_22: Carve the very air itself with energy-edged annihilation! Designed to exacting standards by GrowTech's Department of Slicing & Dicing, this blazing blue blade will show your foes that when it comes to bleeding-edge weaponry, you can't beat an edge made of LASERS!

sourceFields.name: Purple Laser Scimitar
sourceFields.str_version_22: Carve the very air itself with energy-edged annihilation! Designed to exacting standards by GrowTech's Department of Slicing & Dicing, this blazing purple blade will show your foes that when it comes to bleeding-edge weaponry, you can't beat an edge made of LASERS!

sourceFields.name: Wolfy Tank Top
sourceFields.str_version_22: AwoooOOOOooo! Lovers of lupine layers, take note: your fashion icon has arrived! Chosen by RDK, this howlingly handsome tank top is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for October, 2019!

sourceFields.name: Turkey Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Very few turkeys make for good headgear, and even fewer are stronger enough to lift a full-grown Growtopian, so count yourself lucky you've found this mighty beast!

sourceFields.name: Riding Bell
sourceFields.str_version_22: We truly live in a future our ancestors could only have dreamed of, a vast land of possibility where bells aren't just for announcing dinner or generating ambience, but where they come with plush seats and 500 horsepower, capable of carrying us to and fro, all thanks to GrowTech!

sourceFields.name: Dueling Star Fighter - Rebel Raider
sourceFields.str_version_22: Splash your name across the stars in this high-flying, laser-firing, rebellion-building beauty of a star fighter! There's a cold and devious empire out there that needs toppling, and you're just the pilot to do it!

sourceFields.name: Dueling Star Fighter - Imperial Enforcer
sourceFields.str_version_22: Stand for the glory of the Emperor in this turbo-powered, rebel-crushing, empire-stabilizing stunner of a spacecraft! There's an ill-planned and dangerous rebellion out there that needs crushing, and you're just the pilot to do it!

sourceFields.name: Defiant Jester's Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Not all jesters are funny! This mask is for a court entertainer with deadly serious skills! Maybe they were a bodyguard for the King...? Chosen by inflames19, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for November, 2019!

sourceFields.name: Armored WinterBot - Back
sourceFields.str_version_22: One of five legendary pieces of the great WinterBot, guardian of the Winter Fortress. Turns out its great for relieving back pain.

sourceFields.name: Armored WinterBot - Feet
sourceFields.str_version_22: One of five legendary pieces of the great WinterBot, guardian of the Winter Fortress. You can't tell if you are running incredibly fast, or constantly sliding. Either way, these shoes make you faster.

sourceFields.name: Armored WinterBot - Fists
sourceFields.str_version_22: One of five legendary pieces of the great WinterBot, guardian of the Winter Fortress. Ice shards envelope your hand, punching with this might do some damage.

sourceFields.name: Armored WinterBot - Mail
sourceFields.str_version_22: One of five legendary pieces of the great WinterBot, guardian of the Winter Fortress. I hope you're used to the cold, its only getting colder from here. Perhaps this isn't the best thing to wear without a jacket.

sourceFields.name: Armored WinterBot - Greaves
sourceFields.str_version_22: One of five legendary pieces of the great WinterBot, guardian of the Winter Fortress. Gives you an icy stance, not sure if it's the resolve of guarding the fortress for eternity or just that you've lost all feeling in your legs.

sourceFields.name: Frosty Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: These Frosty Wings are made out of ice so they can't fly, but perhaps if you try hard enough... Nope, you can double jump.

sourceFields.name: Riding Eagle Owl
sourceFields.str_version_22: This strange little bird can't make up its mind if it's an eagle or an owl! Either way it can easily lift you into the air none the less.

sourceFields.name: Elf Hoodie
sourceFields.str_version_22: Just because you dress up like an elf doesn't mean you are one, but at least you shouldn't be getting any coal this year.

sourceFields.name: Cloak of Fire and Ice
sourceFields.str_version_22: We had to add ice to the cape, otherwise it would have back-fired.

sourceFields.name: Yeti Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: This terrifying little beast of the arctic wastes, just wants a hug. Maybe it thinks you're its mommy with those big feet!

sourceFields.name: Hammer Of Winter
sourceFields.str_version_22: It seems to be a stick with a huge ice block on the end. Whenever you swing this, the ice block flies off at incredible speeds. Bet it could do some serious damage.

sourceFields.name: Tacky Holiday Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: You infused your hair with so much 'spirit of giving', it became a Giving Tree!

sourceFields.name: Cute Riding Polar Bear
sourceFields.str_version_22: It's like a horse... except it's soft, fuzzy, large, and predatory. It possibly wants to eat you! It would never hurt you though, it's too adorable.

sourceFields.name: Winter Radiance Aura
sourceFields.str_version_22: Cold seems to radiate from you, swirling into careless snowflakes. Somehow this grants you the ability to double jump, don't ask how.

sourceFields.name: Ancestral Orb of Time : Level 6
sourceFields.str_version_22: Incredible forces of immortality and history have been combined with the building blocks of creation to forge this orb. Equip it and mastery of the fourth dimension will be yours... Gives you a super-duper-improved time reduction on all of your providers!

sourceFields.name: Ancient Shards
sourceFields.str_version_22: An artifact from a forgotten age, twinkling with strange energies! These shards will orbit their owner, infusing them with the power of a civilization long since passed from our worlds! Also, they'll glow with cool iridescent light, which happens to make for a really sweet fashion statement.

sourceFields.name: Flower Pot
sourceFields.str_version_22: This delicate little flower is just too precious to put down! Good thing it likes to be held by kind Growtopians like yourself! Chosen by DeusV, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for December, 2019!

sourceFields.name: Superstar Shades
sourceFields.str_version_22: They say wisdom comes with age, but they didn't say anything about style like this! These are the shades of superstardom, reserved for the greatest of Growtopians! With these equipped, YOU will become the very definition of cool. As for wisdom, well... that's up to you.

sourceFields.name: Confetti Rocket Shoes
sourceFields.str_version_22: Look, if sticking confetti-filled rockets to the bottom of shoes is crazy, then I don't want to be sane.

sourceFields.name: Euphoric Dragon
sourceFields.str_version_22: Of all the many dragons you could encounter, this is perhaps the most dangerous... if you don't like FUN! Utterly uncompromising in its quest for the biggest and best parties, this dragon is all about a good time, and it's utterly thrilled to be at your side as you adventure into the wilds of Growtopia!

sourceFields.name: Party Bubble Blaster
sourceFields.str_version_22: The ultimate in party contributions, this bubble blaster will turn any scene into a beautiful whirlwind of bubbly fun! Pop-pop!

sourceFields.name: Raver Hoodie
sourceFields.str_version_22: Express your taste for neon-drenched fun with this psychedelically-colorful raver hoodie.

sourceFields.name: Raver Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: Dang! Those are some bright n' colorful pants, sure to help you stand out in any scene! (Well, aside from the raver scene - you'll blend right in with them!)

sourceFields.name: Raver Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: Amp up the party with this amped-up hairdo! Everyone's sure to be impressed, and if they're not, well, they're probably deeply uncool, so who cares?

sourceFields.name: Draconic Claw
sourceFields.str_version_22: Used as a symbol of strength and power in parts of China, the Feilong dragon is so powerful it doesn't even need wings to fly. Way to flex on those other dragons, dude. There are only 1100 in existence!

sourceFields.name: Jin Chan Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: This mythical creature is said to appear in the presence of good news or great fortune. Lucky you! Now that you have tied it to your wrist you should ALWAYS have good fortune... right? Punching with this equipped allows you to launch a devastating fireball at your foes. Make it burn!

sourceFields.name: Huli Jing Scarf
sourceFields.str_version_22: According to legend, the Huli Jing can be a force of good or evil - and nothing in between. Let's hope you got the good one.

sourceFields.name: Year of the Rat Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: The rat is the first of the zodiac animals. According to myth, the Jade Emperor stated the order of the zodiac would be decided by a race. The rat was clever and tricked the Ox into giving him a ride, then, at the finish line the rat jumped down and landed in front, becoming first. Limited only to Year of the Rat!

sourceFields.name: Emperor's Jacket
sourceFields.str_version_22: One of traditions of Lunar New Year is to celebrate new beginnings and a clean slate. Start off the New Year right with this traditionally-styled jacket! Comes in one color, red, which also happens to be the best color.

sourceFields.name: Brutal Hand Fans
sourceFields.str_version_22: Conjure the force of a hurricane through these deceptively dangerous fans. With one devastating flap, they'll channel your inner chi and send out a stunning strike. You wouldn't want to be on the other end of this!

sourceFields.name: Love Lips
sourceFields.str_version_22: Wild smoochy colors for a wild smoochy face!

sourceFields.name: Charmer Smile
sourceFields.str_version_22: Nobody can resist a winning smile! It's even better when it's actually attached to someone's face, though, so put this on and start winning hearts!

sourceFields.name: Beefy Biceps
sourceFields.str_version_22: Swole as can be! These biceps are the sign of a true athlete, a dedicated fitness freak who keeps their body in tip-top shape! ...and now they're yours. Uh, where did you even get these?

sourceFields.name: Snuggly Kitty Scarf
sourceFields.str_version_22: Full of love and fuzzy affection, this superb scarfcat has only one wish: to spend its days draped around your neck and absorbing as many snuzzles as possible! Mew!

sourceFields.name: Cloud Nine Cape
sourceFields.str_version_22: Woven from the warmest, fluffiest clouds funneled down from the highest heights, this cape is light as can be, softer than you can imagine, and all set to take you up, up, and away!

sourceFields.name: Golden Sunset Cape
sourceFields.str_version_22: Practically glowing with the eye-popping colors of a perfect sunset, this once-cloudy cape has been transformed into a stunning piece of radiant cloth! Don this beauty, and everyone will treat you like a sky set ablaze with all the majesty of a setting sun - they won't be able to look away!

sourceFields.name: Heartthrob Helm
sourceFields.str_version_22: Armor for a valiant Knight of the Heart, this helm will keep your noggin safe from slashing steel and sorrowful heartbreak alike!

sourceFields.name: Golden Heartthrob Helm
sourceFields.str_version_22: Only the most elite Champions of Heart have worn a helm such as this! Polished to a brilliant shine, it's hard to tell if this helm is shimmering from the elegance of its design or the incredible heart of its bearer, but either way, all who look on it will be awed by its beauty.

sourceFields.name: Dating Dandy's Suit
sourceFields.str_version_22: Hit the dating scene in style with this charismatic suit!

sourceFields.name: Dating Dandy's Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: Hit the dating scene in style with this slick and stupendous hair!

sourceFields.name: Dating Vixen's Dress
sourceFields.str_version_22: Hit the dating scene in style with this irresistible dress!

sourceFields.name: Dating Vixen's Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: Hit the dating scene in style with this stunning hairstyle!

sourceFields.name: Datemaster's Rose
sourceFields.str_version_22: Perfect for making your affectionate intentions known, this rose will let everyone know you're a date-goin' Growtopian without peer! Toss one now and get your dating done right!

sourceFields.name: Datemaster's Bling
sourceFields.str_version_22: Forget putting a ring on it - toss a GIGANTIC ring AT it and they'll never forget you!

sourceFields.name: Datemaster's Heart Locket
sourceFields.str_version_22: All the secrets of the perfect date have been fused with the sparkling strength of a golden heart to create this nexus of affection! Be the quickest to anyone's heart when you don this delightful locket!

sourceFields.name: Medusa's Crown
sourceFields.str_version_22: Crafted by the Great Gorgon herself, this incredible crown of magic and malice will strike fear into the hearts of all who look upon it. With the power of its gaze, you'll be able to turn your enemies (and hey, even your friends!) to stone! Note: The Curse of the Gorgon only works in worlds that arn't punch jammed. Magic is weird like that.

sourceFields.name: Pink Teeny Angel Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Even as tiny as they are, these cute pink wings allow you to jump in mid-air!

sourceFields.name: Walking Cane
sourceFields.str_version_22: An exquisitely crafted walking cane made of the finest mahogany with gold trim. Great for peaceful walks in the garden or keeping you looking classy in your old age! Chosen by TBUO, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for January, 2020!

sourceFields.name: Magic Stones
sourceFields.str_version_22: Carrying these magical stones will light up even the darkest areas, although, the magic seems unstable. These magic stones burn out at unpredictable moments so make sure to carry several.

sourceFields.name: Armored Riding Troll
sourceFields.str_version_22: A tamed monstrosity of the deep caverns of the world. Throws dirt at your foes and moves with surprising speed for its size.

sourceFields.name: Dwarven Beard
sourceFields.str_version_22: The pride of all dwarves.

sourceFields.name: Dwarven Mining Helm
sourceFields.str_version_22: Tired of carrying your candle in your hand? Some clever dwarf discovered you can stick it to your helm to free up your hands for digging.

sourceFields.name: Shield of Mining
sourceFields.str_version_22: Protects from falling debris. Also quite handy in a fight.

sourceFields.name: Strange Eyes
sourceFields.str_version_22: Born from the inky black of the deep caves, these eyes look a little odd to anyone not familiar with the deep caverns.

sourceFields.name: Mining Pauldrons
sourceFields.str_version_22: Protects from falling debris. Arm yourself for the dangers that lie in the deep places of the world.

sourceFields.name: Mining Chestplate
sourceFields.str_version_22: Protects from falling debris. Arm yourself for the dangers that lie in the deep places of the world.

sourceFields.name: Mining Mech
sourceFields.str_version_22: Forged from the magic ore of the deep caverns, it's magic drill will break through deep caverns with ease.

sourceFields.name: Lightning Gauntlets

sourceFields.name: Balrog Wings

sourceFields.name: Balrog's Tail
