sourceFields.name: Galaxy Aura
sourceFields.str_version_22: A swirling galaxy engulfs you, pulling everything you touch towards you (well only growtopians!).

sourceFields.name: Radiant Doom Staff
sourceFields.str_version_22: A floating staff radiating with dark energy and deep dread! For some reason it seems to like you and will do what you say (for now). It'll follow you wherever you go, and strike fear in the hearts of your enemies. Best not to make it angry though.

sourceFields.name: Shamrock Shades
sourceFields.str_version_22: Rock some shamrock shades!

sourceFields.name: Irish Top Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: A lovely top of the morning top hat! Only found in Blarney 1 and 4.

sourceFields.name: Green Trenchcoat
sourceFields.str_version_22: It's Green... it's  a coat, its an awesome Green Trenchcoat! Note: this is a "chest item", like a necklace, so you can wear any shirts and back items you want underneath it.

sourceFields.name: Slithering Slippers
sourceFields.str_version_22: Slippers that slither with snakes!

sourceFields.name: Shamrock Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Shamrocks give you wings!

sourceFields.name: Giant Falling Shamrock
sourceFields.str_version_22: Shamrocks are lucky.... lucky it doesnt fall like a rock! Hold the jump button while falling to cushion your fall. Only found in Blarney 5, 7 and 9.

sourceFields.name: Dala Horsie
sourceFields.str_version_22: Get rocking and rolling on this speedy horse!

sourceFields.name: Money Aura
sourceFields.str_version_22: Money can't buy you everything but it sure looks cool swirling around you!

sourceFields.name: Pooka Hood
sourceFields.str_version_22: Look like a proper pooka with the pooka hood!

sourceFields.name: Mobility Scooter
sourceFields.str_version_22: Get around with the latest and greatest in Mobility Scooters. Chosen by Kulchvyach, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for February, 2020!

sourceFields.name: Chick Tricycle
sourceFields.str_version_22: Always wanted to be driven around? Now's your chance with the new Chick Tricycle! Hiring a chauffeur has never been this cheep! Although, you might want to chick its credentials.

sourceFields.name: Nest Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Some little chicks snooze in this nest hat. How they managed to form a nest on the top of your head is pretty impressive. The more you move, the more agitated they seem to get, better slow down and not upset your new friends.

sourceFields.name: Egg Champion Cape
sourceFields.str_version_22: First chauffeurs, now flying cape services? Is there anything these chicks can't do?

sourceFields.name: Egg Ammo Belt
sourceFields.str_version_22: FOOD FIGHT! Be ready for battle with the egg ammo belt, nothing is worse than getting splatted by a volley of eggs. Just don't hard boil any of them. That would cause some serious damage.

sourceFields.name: Hot Cross Bun Launcher
sourceFields.str_version_22: Served hot and fresh - straight to your face. Careful, flaming buns may cause burns, cool before eating!

sourceFields.name: Loafers
sourceFields.str_version_22: Keep your feet toasty all year round with these loafers, there is nothing butter than wearing bread on your feet!

sourceFields.name: Carrot on a Stick
sourceFields.str_version_22: Always hungry but never productive? Finally a solution for you! Get stuff done under the illusion of chasing food! Don't judge, it works for some people.

sourceFields.name: Boastful Brawler Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: A boastful hairstyle that's punching above its weight! Bleached platinum white for perfect preparation to apply hair dye and personalise to your heart's desire.

sourceFields.name: Powerful Ponytail Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: A powerful hairstyle that's punching above its weight! Bleached platinum white for perfect preparation to apply hair dye and personalise to your heart's desire.

sourceFields.name: Cooking Recipe - Chocolate Easter Bilby
sourceFields.str_version_22: Apparently many people can't seem to tell the difference between this cute little marsupial mouse and a rabbit so if you try to cook one without this recipe you will end up with a chocolate bunny instead. To cook this recipe you will need the following:<CR><CR>You must hold this recipe in your hand.<CR>Ingredients:<CR>   - Easter Egg - Growtopia<CR>   - Baking Chocolate<CR>   - Chocolate Sprinkles Block<CR>   - Marshmallow<CR><CR>Seasoning:<CR>   - Sugar<CR><CR>Process:<CR>Add Easter Egg - Growtopia to an oven on Low heat. While the Easter Egg - Growtopia is still cold, add Baking Chocolate. Add the seasonings and wait until cooked all the way through. Then add Chocolate Sprinkles Block and Marshmallow and remove from the oven when perfectly cooked.<CR><CR>Timings may vary so you will need to experiment.

sourceFields.name: Wacky Rocket Sled
sourceFields.str_version_22: Strap on because you're in for a wacky ride! A high octane rocket sled, it might not look safe but it's fun! Beep Beep!

sourceFields.name: Chilled Smile Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: When you're tired of using all those crazy facial muscles, this mask is here to help! Hide your tired growtopian face with this reliable, totally-not-creepy chilled smile instead!. Chosen by XMenkel, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for March, 2020!

sourceFields.name: Doomsday Warhammer
sourceFields.str_version_22: Wield the Warhammer of Doom and rain fiery death down on all around you! This warhammer is so hot it even tears the ground up as you lug its heavy weight behind you.

sourceFields.name: Chip-and-Dip
sourceFields.str_version_22: Keep your supply of hot salsa and cool guac close with you at all times with this hat. Its guacca be the best hat ever!

sourceFields.name: Mexican Hot Sauce Rocket Pack
sourceFields.str_version_22: This rocket pack will take the heat up to Scotch Bonnet level as you blast to the skies powered by Mexico's finest chilli sauce.

sourceFields.name: Mexican Pointy Boots
sourceFields.str_version_22: Pointy as a arrow, sharp as knife, speedy as a super speedy jumping bean being particulary speedy! Complete with your own gang of jumping beans to follow you around!

sourceFields.name: Bongo Drum
sourceFields.str_version_22: March to the beat of your own drum with the snazzy Mexican Bongo! Hot and Spicy beats for all!

sourceFields.name: Trumpet
sourceFields.str_version_22: Toot Toot Tootin' Mexican Trumpet! Some sweet chiily pepper trumpet vibes for all to hear!

sourceFields.name: Chichen-Itza Shirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: If you Myan over what to wear, choose this! Its Chichen what-cha want to wear.

sourceFields.name: Chichen-Itza Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: A temple to wear over your temples! Itza brilliant!

sourceFields.name: Rose Hairpin
sourceFields.str_version_22: A regal rose to brighten up your hair! Chosen by Bojoing, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for April, 2020!

sourceFields.name: Go Anywhere Surfboard
sourceFields.str_version_22: A Surfboard with your very own personal wave! Travel over land and sea in style, comfort and awesomeness!

sourceFields.name: Pineapple Plough
sourceFields.str_version_22: Ever wanted a plough made from a ravenous pineapple? Of course you have and here it is! This pineapple has a taste for trees and it's really hungry right now!

sourceFields.name: Pineapple Robes
sourceFields.str_version_22: Pineapple palm robes fit for a Pineapple Prince or Princess or for anyone wanting the cool breeze that comes with wearing leaves!

sourceFields.name: Pineapple Superhero
sourceFields.str_version_22: Is it a bird? Is it a plane? No! It's a cool flying pineapple shooting lasers! That's way cooler!

sourceFields.name: Pineapple Coronet
sourceFields.str_version_22: What does every wannabe Pineapple Prince or Princess need? A Pineapple Coronet of course! Prickly on the head but worth it!

sourceFields.name: Pineapple Headphones
sourceFields.str_version_22: Sweet beats for when you're scoffing pineapple treats! Dance along to some funky tunes looking totally awesome in these!

sourceFields.name: Pineapple Boardshorts
sourceFields.str_version_22: Whether you're surfing, chilling on the beach or kicking back eating a fresh pineapple, these shorts are just the perfect fit!

sourceFields.name: Pineapple Trooper Helmet
sourceFields.str_version_22: In space no one can hear you scream.... but they can see you coming a mile off in all your pineapple glory with this space helmet!

sourceFields.name: Exo Suit Helmet
sourceFields.str_version_22: Look like a total space boss with Exo Suit Helmet! Makes you look tough and stylish all at once!

sourceFields.name: Exo Suit Body
sourceFields.str_version_22: Look like a total space boss with Exo Suit Body! Makes you look tough and stylish all at once!

sourceFields.name: Exo Suit Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: Look like a total space boss with Exo Suit Pants! Makes you look tough and stylish all at once!

sourceFields.name: Arm Blaster
sourceFields.str_version_22: That Blaster is Mega! Fire a blinding red laser from your arm and live out all your 16bit dreams!

sourceFields.name: Escapee's Collar
sourceFields.str_version_22: Like a necklace but way more dangerous!! Show off your stealth escaping skills with this reminder of life in space jail!

sourceFields.name: Hikers Dressing Gown
sourceFields.str_version_22: If you're travelling around the galaxy without a spaceship, this dressing gown will look the part when hailing a ride from a stranger!

sourceFields.name: Space Opera Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Live out your own literal space opera with this Space Opera Mask! Maybe you could be the Phantom Menance of the Opera with it on!

sourceFields.name: Space Tattoo
sourceFields.str_version_22: Nothing says I live on an other planet and am part of a motley crew of space raiders than a facial tattoo! Tatooinely what you need to scare your Aunt and Uncle!

sourceFields.name: Crystal Aura
sourceFields.str_version_22: An enchanted crystal aura surrounds you, emitting light from the purest of crystal form! Don't look directly into it's light its too mesmerising.

sourceFields.name: My Pet Sputnik
sourceFields.str_version_22: A pet Sputnik for all your space adventuring needs! Careful though those radiowaves its emitting look deadly!

sourceFields.name: Crystal Infused Sword
sourceFields.str_version_22: A sword of true beauty and of true power! Each swing of it's blade is infused with the power of crystals forged eons ago by unknown hands!

sourceFields.name: Dark Watcher's Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Worn by the mysterious group that watch from the dark. Chosen by Armourfnafs, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for May, 2020!

sourceFields.name: Phoenix Scarf
sourceFields.str_version_22: The spirit of the Phoenix will rise above you and be with you always when you wear this scarf of extreme beauty and rarity! These are so rare you had better look after it! No more than 500 of these exist in Growtopia!

sourceFields.name: Greg, The Octopus
sourceFields.str_version_22: A friendly octopus buddy who clings to you wherever you go! With 8 legs and a bulbous head he's got an inky surprise for anyone who gets in your way!

sourceFields.name: Starfish Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: Did you wish upon a star...fish? Because you got a little pointy friend! They may look cute but don't get too close as they are also quite spikey to touch!

sourceFields.name: Floatie Crown
sourceFields.str_version_22: When is a crown not a crown? When it's also an inflatable duck! Give your attacks some much needed quack with this Floatie Crown!

sourceFields.name: Staff of the Deep
sourceFields.str_version_22: It's splishy! It's fishy! It's splashy! And it will send you into a fish frenzy! Be the master of land and sea with this most awesome staff!

sourceFields.name: Flamingo Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Majestically soar in the sky with these wings.... wait, that's not right! Flap wildly like a crazy Flamingo with these equipped!

sourceFields.name: Fruity Trousers
sourceFields.str_version_22: The perfect pear of trousers for a summer's day. Some say the fruit pattern is so realistic it even attracts wasps!

sourceFields.name: Clownfish Shirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: If you've ever wanted to dress like a Clownfish before, then your dreams have just come true! Perfect to wear when you're out finding other lost Clownfish!

sourceFields.name: Neptune's Trident

sourceFields.name: Pegasus Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: With these wings, you can soar with eagles and other flying horses! They grant you the ability to double jump with a majestic burst of feathers and magic!

sourceFields.name: Cow Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Something about this mask is udderly hilarious. Chosen by CowCrash, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for June, 2020!

sourceFields.name: Troll Mask

sourceFields.name: Axolotl Scarf
sourceFields.str_version_22: Nothing keeps you both warm and stylish like a living breathing Axolotl scarf! So cute, so warm, which is weird as Axolotl's are actually cold blooded!

sourceFields.name: Axolotl Hood

sourceFields.name: Axolotl Onesie

sourceFields.name: Tactical Stealth Espionage Device

sourceFields.name: Really Dangerous Pet Llama
sourceFields.str_version_22: This Llama is ready for anything Growtopia throws at it! Armed with a silo of Growtech Missiles, experimental Growtech hardened steel armor and a rather snazzy helmet (Llama's own) this Llama is Dangerous with a capital D!

sourceFields.name: Eldritch Crossbow
sourceFields.str_version_22: A mysterious Eldritch flame binds itself to each and every arrow loaded into this crossbow. Some say the flame will burn forever, some claim it's actually powered by AA batteries but who really knows!

sourceFields.name: Zodiac Wings

sourceFields.name: Capuchin Leash
sourceFields.str_version_22: An adorable pet Capuchin armed to the back teeth with enough bananas to feed an entire planet of apes! Remember what to say if they try to steal your coffee... Capuchin-no!

sourceFields.name: Riding Gorilla

sourceFields.name: Pet Sock

sourceFields.name: Big Chin

sourceFields.name: Puppy Dog Eyes
sourceFields.str_version_22: No one will be able to resist these puppy dog eyes! The perfect balance between sad and OMG CUTE!!

sourceFields.name: Rosy Cheeks
sourceFields.str_version_22: A healthy, rosy glow for your Growtopian. Add a little colour to your face with these.

sourceFields.name: Walrus Mustache
sourceFields.str_version_22: A mustache that doesn't really look like a Walrus but would probably look great on one... as well as yourself!

sourceFields.name: Showman's Mustache
sourceFields.str_version_22: Roll Up! Roll Up! Come and see the greatest facial hair on the planet! Never knowingly undersold, this mustache is for the showman in all of us!

sourceFields.name: Golden Cuff Beard
sourceFields.str_version_22: Pharaoh's style beard complete with a golden cuff to give that air of greatness that anyone with this sort of beard deserves!

sourceFields.name: Omegalul

sourceFields.name: Mechanical Butler
sourceFields.str_version_22: The Teabot 3000 Mechanical Butler is perfect for all your buttling needs! This ever faithful companion is always on hand for when you need a refreshing cup of tea or wish to throw said refreshing cup of tea over a friend... or foe!

sourceFields.name: Sun Shooter Bow
sourceFields.str_version_22: This bow is too hot to handle! Each arrow is propelled forward with the force of a 1000 suns guiding them to their destiny! A truly carbon neutral energy source for a weapon!

sourceFields.name: Yin Yang Pendant
sourceFields.str_version_22: A pendant that Yin's just as much as it Yang's! Wearing this will keep you in perfect balance with nature, while making you run so fast you'll be missing most of it!

sourceFields.name: Peace Mooncake Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: What better to wear when hunting for Mooncakes than a Mooncake hat! There's one for each Mooncake type so keep a look out for all of them.

sourceFields.str_version_22: New Balance Mooncake shoes! Good on all terrain, hard wearing and also yummy! Seriously, don't eat them! Who knows what you have stepped in!

Whenever a Balance Mooncake is found it has a chance of multiplying the quantity but also breaking. However it repels Peace, Harmony, Prosperity and Longevity Mooncakes making them less likely to be found when harvesting trees.

sourceFields.name: Owl Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Get suited and "hooted" and dress like an owl! Feathery finery for the discerning owl-ficionado!

sourceFields.name: Owl Suit
sourceFields.str_version_22: Get suited and "hooted" and dress like an owl! Feathery finery for the discerning owl-ficionado!

sourceFields.name: Ancestor Mooncake Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: What better to wear when hunting for Mooncakes than a Mooncake hat! There's one for each Mooncake type so keep a look out for all of them.

sourceFields.name: Haunted Jack O' Lantern
sourceFields.str_version_22: Some spooky Growtopia magic is at play here! When equipped, your head is totally transformed into a floating, flaming, haunted pumpkin! Thankfully, it follows you wherever you go! Perfect for the spooky season!

sourceFields.name: Bling Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: A pair of blingingly awesome wings! The glitz and glamor of these are exemplified by a trail of gems... these are not real gems by the way, that would be just silly! To avoid refund fraud, this item has been made untradeable until February 7th, 2021.

sourceFields.name: Aqua Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Cause a splash with these Aqua Wings! They are so realistic, even a few fish have managed to sneak into them... they are flying fish now!

sourceFields.name: Neon Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Light up the town in style! Don't question how neon lights make you fly, just go with the glow and touch the sky!

sourceFields.name: Raccoon Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: There's something good to be said about a furry Raccoon for your head! Chosen by NVISIBLE, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for August, 2020!

sourceFields.name: Growtopia Fried Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Wings to make your tummy rumble! These deep fried wings are literally straight from the oven! Covered in a golden breadcrumb made with a secret mix of Growtopia herbs and spices, cooked to create the perfect balance between flavor and aerodynamics!

sourceFields.name: Party Plume Wings

sourceFields.name: Musical Wings

sourceFields.name: Dark Sunset Cape
sourceFields.str_version_22: A cape made from threads of a million dying suns! I bet you didn't know that suns were made of thread did you!

sourceFields.name: Darkest Skull Parasol
sourceFields.str_version_22: A Parasol for those with only the darkest of souls! A dark combination of rocket powered skulls to thrust you high into the chilly night air!

sourceFields.name: Ghoulish Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Get your Ghoul on! A mystery gas surrounds you and elevates you skyward... not sure where this gas comes from?!

sourceFields.name: Shady Sales Shades
sourceFields.str_version_22: Super Pumpkin Party ready shades! Perfect for any Halloween party or any other occasion actually!

sourceFields.name: Creepy Baby Suit
sourceFields.str_version_22: If you ever need to dress as a creepy baby then you're in luck! This item is perfect for all occasion's.

sourceFields.name: Demogorgon Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Perfect Spelunking while looking a bit scary at the same time! Light up the darkest in spooky style.

sourceFields.name: Cloak of Equilibrium
sourceFields.str_version_22: A perfectly balanced cloak! Half infused with power by the sun and half by the moon!

sourceFields.name: Infested Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: Eugh! Time to buy some new shampoo! Infested and probably rather also rather smelly... perfect for Halloween!

sourceFields.name: Lost Startopian Helmet
sourceFields.str_version_22: Perfect for celebrating the spooky season while also commanding a spaceship!

sourceFields.name: Frankenstein's Monster Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Scare the villagers away with this perfectly spooky mask! Slightly reduces items required for Farmer Role quests!

sourceFields.name: Druid's Crown
sourceFields.str_version_22: A dark, dark crown for a dark, dark Druid! For when you are in one of those, "leave me alone" moods!

sourceFields.name: Druid's Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: A dark, dark mask for a dark, dark Druid! For when you are in one of those, "leave me alone" moods!

sourceFields.name: Druid's Robes
sourceFields.str_version_22: A dark, dark robe for a dark, dark Druid! For when you are in one of those, "leave me alone" moods!

sourceFields.name: Cyber Punk Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: A futuristic Cyber Punk mask, perfect for wearing everyday! Chosen by macmacxd22, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for September, 2020!

sourceFields.name: Reanimated Howly Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Awooo! The mad scientists at Growtech have reanimated this beast! It's pretty angry what with having to be carried around on your head all day long!

sourceFields.name: Zombie Horse
sourceFields.str_version_22: A zombified flaming horse to terrorize the town with! With hooves of flame, this fiery steed is perfect for the spooky season!

sourceFields.name: Celestial Dragon Charm
sourceFields.str_version_22: An ancient and valuable charm, passed between Dragons and their masters for as long as time remembers. Wearing it will invoke the spirit and power of the revered Celestial Dragon! A Dragon of legend who had the power to control the sun, the moon and the stars!

sourceFields.name: Riding RV
sourceFields.str_version_22: A rapid, revving, recreation vehicle! Sit atop this automotive icon and cruise from coast to coast in comfort and style!

sourceFields.name: Ultra Sportsball Bat
sourceFields.str_version_22: A bat with some serious power! Imagine the scene... it's the last ball of the game. A Growtopian steps up to bat... what's that? It's an enormous floating shiny metal bat! He hits a HOME RUN and sends the ball into ORBIT and wins the game!

sourceFields.name: American Sports Ball Jersey
sourceFields.str_version_22: Call the plays, be the Quarterback, get involved in some serious contact sport with this Jersey! Earn some Quarterback's money with this equipped. You are the MVP, maybe even the GOAT... but not the Llama!

sourceFields.name: Presidential Beard
sourceFields.str_version_22: A truly presidential piece of facial hair! This beard has passed more bills than someone passing by the world's largest gathering of people named William!

sourceFields.name: All You Can Eat Bib
sourceFields.str_version_22: Did somebody say FOOD FIGHT?! It's an "all you can eat" and also an "all you can throw" bib! It automatically cleans itself too. So, it's very eco-friendly!

sourceFields.name: Thanksgiving Dinner Fishing Rod
sourceFields.str_version_22: A rod of such great finery!

sourceFields.name: Crown of Enlightenment
sourceFields.str_version_22: A copper crown, turned green with time! Symbolizes liberty and enlightenment... also looks awesome! Feels like it's part of a set somehow?

sourceFields.name: Dress of Enlightenment
sourceFields.str_version_22: A copper dress turned green with time! Symbolizes liberty and enlightenment... doesn't look like it would be too easy to move about in! Feels like it's part of a set somehow?

sourceFields.name: Torch of Enlightenment
sourceFields.str_version_22: A copper torch turned green with time! Symbolizes liberty and enlightenment... also, basically, a cool flame thrower! Feels like it's part of a set somehow?

sourceFields.name: Presidential Wig
sourceFields.str_version_22: Very much a wig for big wigs! Imagine running a county wearing this? I think the people would laugh and make lots of jokes on the internet about you!

sourceFields.name: Burger Suit
sourceFields.str_version_22: If you've ever had the burning desire to dress as a juicy, flamed grilled burger, dripping in the perfect combination of ketchup, mustard, crispy lettuce and a lightly toasted bun... then this is for you! Now I'm hungry!

sourceFields.name: JackBowe's Koala
sourceFields.str_version_22: They are very cute until they get angry! This little furry guy stands as tribute to all of those who lost their lives in Australian Wild Fires. They will always be remembered. Sponsored by JackBowe for completing all epic quests!

sourceFields.name: Growch Bod
sourceFields.str_version_22: A perfect replica of Growch's beautiful Bod!

sourceFields.name: Turkey Sucker
sourceFields.str_version_22: Growtech's latest innovation in Turkey capture, containment and cooking! Use the suction beam to collect and cook Turkeys. `4WARNING:`` This item is still experimental, so, it can break. Although, when it does, sometimes you get something special.

sourceFields.name: Neon Oni Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Keep safe with this stylish face mask. Chosen by AppleJuz, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for October, 2020!

sourceFields.name: Shadow Crown
sourceFields.str_version_22: A Black Friday exclusive Crown! Some kind of evil dark spirit must have infested this crown... on the upside, it does look awesome and it gives you some special powers.

sourceFields.name: Matrix Aura
sourceFields.str_version_22: A Black Friday exclusive aura! Numbers falling, time collapsing into itself, just another day in Growtopia then!

sourceFields.name: Black Balrog's Tail
sourceFields.str_version_22: A sword forged from the tail of a mighty demon... only this version is a Black Friday exclusive!

sourceFields.name: Black Burning Eyes
sourceFields.str_version_22: Need some eyedrops for those? This is a Black Friday exclusive version!

sourceFields.name: Black Egg Champion Cape
sourceFields.str_version_22: First chauffeurs, now flying cape services? Is there anything these chicks can't do? This is a Black Friday exclusive version.

sourceFields.name: Tie Dye Hoodie
sourceFields.str_version_22: A Black Friday exclusive hoodie! Looks really comfortable, perfect for lounging around and grabbing a bargain in the sales.

sourceFields.name: Black Neon Hightops
sourceFields.str_version_22: A Black Friday exclusive pair of hightops! Black and neon is pretty much the perfect combo isn't it?

sourceFields.name: Vortex Shirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: A Black Friday exclusive shirt! If you've ever wanted a shirt with a sort of vortex effect on it, then you're in luck!

sourceFields.name: Slouch Beanie
sourceFields.str_version_22: A Black Friday exclusive beanie! It's like a regular beanie but too big, so it slouches at the back... or maybe that's how you wanted it?

sourceFields.name: Gradient Trenchcoat
sourceFields.str_version_22: A Black Friday exclusive trenchcoat! A couture trench coat, perfect for the catwalk or walking a cat! Look stylish all the time, everytime!

sourceFields.name: Swordfish Sword
sourceFields.str_version_22: If you're angling for a sharp pointy fish to use as a sword, then, this is the one for you! The only thing mightier is the Penfish!

sourceFields.name: Jet Ski Chariot
sourceFields.str_version_22: For when you really want to show off! Skim across land and sea, performing tricks and stunts to amaze onlookers!

sourceFields.name: Water Gun Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Two water pistols mounted to each side of this hat, will provide more than enough water power to cool off anyone or anything!

sourceFields.name: Christmas Tree Sword
sourceFields.str_version_22: Oh Christmas tree, oh Christmas tree, how deadly are thy branches!

sourceFields.name: Sledding Penguin
sourceFields.str_version_22: The ultimate in giant Penguin transportation!

sourceFields.name: Staff of Deepest Winter
sourceFields.str_version_22: Wow this staff is cold! Made of the deepest, most wintry snow, and sprinkled with a little Winter magic.

sourceFields.name: Krampus Crampons
sourceFields.str_version_22: Some Crampons which are so cold they even freeze acid... a bit!

sourceFields.name: Diamond Dust
sourceFields.str_version_22: This locket filled with Diamond dust has the power to transform all who wear it! Tradable since April 25th, 2021.

sourceFields.name: Sleepy Santa Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: An olden days hat for sleeping, because, for some reason you wore a hat to bed back then!

sourceFields.name: Light Up Antlers
sourceFields.str_version_22: Rudolph the red nosed reindeer might have had a very shiny nose, but you've got light up antlers... so you win!

sourceFields.name: Growch's Nose
sourceFields.str_version_22: A perfect replica of Growch's nose! Well, it would be a bit mean if it was his real one, wouldn't it!

sourceFields.name: Light Up Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: Party Pants! These flash, flashing, pants are perfect for a Winterfest party!

sourceFields.name: Nick's Belly
sourceFields.str_version_22: Someone's been eating all the mince pies! Who? You!

sourceFields.name: Rift Cape
sourceFields.str_version_22: Rip a hole in the fabric of reality with this amazing Cape! Create two unique looks and use a rift in time and space to change between them. Wrench yourself to customise the Cape. This item is available to buy for 2 days only and then will become available from a new Winterfest system afterwards. To avoid refund fraud, this item has been made untradeable until May 1st, 2021.

sourceFields.name: Mystic Snow Fox
sourceFields.str_version_22: There are many tales about this many tailed fox! Wearing the tail allows you to change your form into that of the mystic fox of legend itself!

sourceFields.name: Water Balloon Bandolier
sourceFields.str_version_22: Wear your balloons with pride! Show your fellow Growtopians your love of Balloon Warz and, indeed, water balloons!

sourceFields.name: Team Tied Jersey - Punch
sourceFields.str_version_22: Wear your team colors proudly with this snazzy Jersey.

sourceFields.name: Team Tied Jersey - Grow
sourceFields.str_version_22: Wear your team colors proudly with this snazzy Jersey.

sourceFields.name: Team Tied Jersey - Build
sourceFields.str_version_22: Wear your team colors proudly with this snazzy Jersey.

sourceFields.name: Dungarees
sourceFields.str_version_22: I'm sure you'll agree that these are a wonderful pair of Dungarees. Chosen by Nabsplays, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for November, 2020.

sourceFields.name: Snow Leopard Shawl
sourceFields.str_version_22: Made of the finest Faux Snow Leopard Fur. This Shawl is infused with the spirit of a mighty Snow Leopard!

sourceFields.name: Winter Swept Hair
sourceFields.str_version_22: Wherever you go, you'll always be rocking the windswept look!

sourceFields.name: Winter Light Launcher
sourceFields.str_version_22: Get ready to spread some winter cheer! You'll be spreading cheer and lights with some vigor with this launcher equipped! Perfect for last minute decorations!

sourceFields.name: Diamond Dog
sourceFields.str_version_22: This is one luxury Pooch! Although not overly fluffy, it more than makes up for it with its diamond shine!

sourceFields.name: Radical Rollers
sourceFields.str_version_22: Get radical! These light up roller skates put the party in every step you take and add the disco to every move you make! Great for a /dance.

sourceFields.name: Walktopian
sourceFields.str_version_22: Listen to some banging tunes while you walk... man!

sourceFields.name: Crown of the Cosmos
sourceFields.str_version_22: This crown allows you to harness the power of the Cosmos! Putting you right at the center of everything!

sourceFields.name: Candy Cane Scythe
sourceFields.str_version_22: Probably the deadliest Candy Cane ever made! Fling some festive cheer and razor sharp candy... what better way to celebrate the Holidays!

sourceFields.name: Snow Aura
sourceFields.str_version_22: Your very own personal snow cloud! Take Winter with you, wherever you go. If you wait long enough, you might even see a snowman.

sourceFields.name: Neon Tree Aura
sourceFields.str_version_22: Get the Winterfest Party started with the Neon Tree Aura! Perfect for a night out on the frozen tiles.

sourceFields.name: Zamgrowni
sourceFields.str_version_22: To be Frank, this ice resurfacing machine has a cool name! Although, this one doesn't resurface ice, it does harvest trees!

sourceFields.name: Spruce Goose
sourceFields.str_version_22: Nothing like a spruce green goose to get you in the holiday mood! Honk! Honk!

sourceFields.name: Gingerbread Sweater
sourceFields.str_version_22: Kind of ugly. Kind of cool. Made of gingerbread... and wool.

sourceFields.name: Gingerbread Man Onesie
sourceFields.str_version_22: A one stop shop for looking a bit like a Gingerbread Man... if that's what you want!

sourceFields.name: Gingerbread Man Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Weird, creepy and slightly sinister! It's perfect to wear with a Gingerbread Man Onesie!

sourceFields.name: Winter Colonel Beard
sourceFields.str_version_22: Perfect for wearing when creating a secret mix of winter herbs and spices!

sourceFields.name: Electric Guitar
sourceFields.str_version_22: You can't punch when holding this, you're too busy ROCKING OUT! Punch anywhere to play music. If you punch to your left or right, you can bend the note higher or lower. Punch in your own column to play the same notes that Sheet Music: Piano Note plays.

sourceFields.name: Confetti Jump Pack
sourceFields.str_version_22: This retro jump pack will propel you to euphoric heights!

sourceFields.name: Playful Pitchfork
sourceFields.str_version_22: Be careful who you poke with it! Chosen by ReddMA, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for December, 2020.

sourceFields.name: Retro Jacket
sourceFields.str_version_22: Retro chic goodness. Denim will never go out of fashion!

sourceFields.name: Retro Leg Warmers
sourceFields.str_version_22: Good for partying and keeping your legs warm at the same time!

sourceFields.name: Rainbow Tutu
sourceFields.str_version_22: Choo Choo! With this Tutu you can board to party train to Disco Town! Calling at Party Central, Dancefloor Downs and Diva District!

sourceFields.name: White Suit Jacket
sourceFields.str_version_22: Strut your stuff in this 1980's inspired look. The perfect day/night combination!

sourceFields.name: Tetra T-Shirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: The most stylish and disco-like of fish make for the perfect T-shirt!

sourceFields.name: Rave Safe Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Rave long, rave hard, rave safe!

sourceFields.name: Draconic Soul Aura
sourceFields.str_version_22: The flames of a Draconic presence imbue you with power! The flames burn into your very soul, you are starting to become one with the Draconic kind! There are only 1000 in existence!

sourceFields.name: Mystic Battle Lance
sourceFields.str_version_22: A traditional and ancient weapon. Cast of molten steel, this fiery lance, from a fiery furnace, wreaks fiery fury with every attack! There are only 500 in existence!

sourceFields.name: Year of the Ox Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: The ox is the second of the zodiac animals. Limited only to the year of the ox! Myth has it, that order of the Zodiac animals, was determined by a race. The mighty ox, adept on land and water, was leading until a sneaky rat jumped from its back as they crossed the line, unfairly, winning the race!

sourceFields.name: Oxen Battle Helm
sourceFields.str_version_22: Strong, hardy and reliable! This item has all the attributes of those who are born under the sign of the Zodiac Ox!

sourceFields.name: Oxen Battle Shirt
sourceFields.str_version_22: Strong, hardy and reliable! This item has all the attributes of those who are born under the sign of the Zodiac Ox!

sourceFields.name: Oxen Battle Pants
sourceFields.str_version_22: Strong, hardy and reliable! This item has all the attributes of those who are born under the sign of the Zodiac Ox!

sourceFields.name: Oxen Battle Boots
sourceFields.str_version_22: Strong, hardy and reliable! This item has all the attributes of those who are born under the sign of the Zodiac Ox!

sourceFields.name: Golden Ox Pendant
sourceFields.str_version_22: A mystic golden charm. Both ancient and ageless, this is said to instill the work ethic of the Ox in whoever should wear it!

sourceFields.name: 2014 - Zodiac Year of the Horse
sourceFields.str_version_22: A very special year was the Year of the Horse! Growtopians born in this year as said to be warm-hearted, enthusiastic, and positive. The horse can be seen as the symbol of independence and freedom! Harvesting Fortune Cookie & Lucky Fortune Cookie trees with this item equipped gives a chance of twice the yield.

sourceFields.name: 2015 - Zodiac Year of the Goat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Growtopians born in the Year of the Goat are be believed to be gentle, mild-mannered, shy, stable, sympathetic and amicable. They are said to have delicate thoughts, strong creativity, and perseverance! Harvesting Fortune Cookie & Lucky Fortune Cookie trees with this item equipped gives a chance of twice the yield.

sourceFields.name: 2016 - Zodiac Year of the Monkey
sourceFields.str_version_22: Growtopians born in the Year of the Monkey have magnetic personalities and are witty and intelligent! They can also be mischievous and are masters of the practical joke! Cheeky Monkey! Harvesting Fortune Cookie & Lucky Fortune Cookie trees with this item equipped gives a chance of twice the yield.

sourceFields.name: 2017 - Zodiac Year of the Rooster
sourceFields.str_version_22: Growtopians born in the Year of the Rooster are observant and hardworking. They are resourceful, courageous, and talented. Harvesting Fortune Cookie & Lucky Fortune Cookie trees with this item equipped gives a chance of twice the yield.

sourceFields.name: 2018 - Zodiac Year of the Dog
sourceFields.str_version_22: Growtopians born in the Year of the Dog are loyal and honest, amiable and kind, cautious and prudent. They have a strong sense of loyalty and sincerity. Harvesting Fortune Cookie & Lucky Fortune Cookie trees with this item equipped gives a chance of twice the yield.

sourceFields.name: 2019 - Zodiac Year of the Pig
sourceFields.str_version_22: Growtopians born in the Year of the Pig are diligent, compassionate, and realistic! They devote energy to achieving goals and like to see things through to completion. Harvesting Fortune Cookie & Lucky Fortune Cookie trees with this item equipped gives a chance of twice the yield.

sourceFields.name: 2020 - Zodiac Year of the Rat
sourceFields.str_version_22: Growtopians born in the Year of the Rat are clever and quick thinkers! They can be strong-willed, and ambitious as well. Harvesting Fortune Cookie & Lucky Fortune Cookie trees with this item equipped gives a chance of twice the yield.

sourceFields.name: 2021 - Zodiac Year of the Ox
sourceFields.str_version_22: Growtopians born in the Year of the Ox are strong, reliable, fair and conscientious, inspiring confidence in others. They believe in themselves and can be stubborn... as an ox! Harvesting Fortune Cookie & Lucky Fortune Cookie trees with this item equipped gives a chance of twice the yield.

sourceFields.name: Perilous Pirate Ship
sourceFields.str_version_22: Set forth on your buccaneering adventures on this, most magnificent of vessels, The Flying Growtopian! Your personal pirate ship will accompany you everywhere. Some kind of unknown marauding magic allows it to transform in size and shape as you command! Pretty nifty if you ask me!

sourceFields.name: Stylish Draped Trench Coat
sourceFields.str_version_22: The most sylish way to wear your trench coat... To not actually wear it but instead, drape it over your shoulder like you're a coat rack. Chosen by Dispersing, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for January, 2021!

sourceFields.name: King of Hearts
sourceFields.str_version_22: They're going to lose their heads, for painting the roses red...

sourceFields.name: Rose Rifle
sourceFields.str_version_22: A shot straight to the heart.

sourceFields.name: Silk Scarf
sourceFields.str_version_22: The finest silk was once weaved for a great goddess but now it adorns your shoulders.

sourceFields.name: Golden Silk Scarf
sourceFields.str_version_22: The finest silk was once weaved for a great goddess but now it adorns your shoulders. Imbued with the goddess' power, this scarf will lift you through the air and make your feet glide lightly wherever they fall.

sourceFields.name: Love Eyes
sourceFields.str_version_22: All you can see is love, love, love...

sourceFields.name: Heart Antennae Headband
sourceFields.str_version_22: My loving senses are tingling... there must be someone nearby that needs some loving. Better go give them a hug! Can be transformed into a hat by combining 1 Heart Antennae Headband, 1 Transmog Crystal, and 10 Candy Hearts in a Chemical Combiner.

sourceFields.name: Golden Heart Aura
sourceFields.str_version_22: This aura marks you with love and adoration, healing you quickly with the power of the heart and propelling you through the air!

sourceFields.name: Pink Teddy Suit
sourceFields.str_version_22: Cuddly Pink Teddy Suit.

sourceFields.name: Pink Teddy Mask
sourceFields.str_version_22: Cuddly Pink Teddy Mask.

sourceFields.name: Love Charged Hands
sourceFields.str_version_22: That's the power of love!

sourceFields.name: Tattooed Muscles
sourceFields.str_version_22: Ripped muscles with tattoos.

sourceFields.name: Grow Air Balloon
sourceFields.str_version_22: Go anywhere the wind takes you with your very own hot air balloon! The balloon style changes when you equip it. So, may you find the balloon that's just right for you!

sourceFields.name: Bow of the Rainbow
sourceFields.str_version_22: The most rainbow'y rainbow bow of all the rainbow bows ever created by the rainbow bowyer! If you like rainbows, then this bow is the rainbow bow for you!

sourceFields.name: Crown of Seasons
sourceFields.str_version_22: A crown which grants you the power to change the seasons at will! With this crown, wild things will surely happen! Wrench yourself to modify this item's properties. To avoid refund fraud, this item has been made untradeable until August 1st, 2021.

sourceFields.name: Shamrock Shuriken
sourceFields.str_version_22: Perfect for a wannabe Shamrock Ninja! Better take "clover", these are sharp!

sourceFields.name: Hooves of Cernunnos
sourceFields.str_version_22: Will the wild in every step you take! Roots form and wither at your command!

sourceFields.name: Finias' Red Javelin
sourceFields.str_version_22: One of the Four Treasures of the Tuatha DÃ© Danann! This Javelin was said to never miss its target! Is it myth? Is it legend? Well, what are you waiting for? Throw the thing!

sourceFields.name: Mothman Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Urban Myth? Legend? Monster created from our condition to fear the unknown? Or just super awesome moth wings... you decide!

sourceFields.name: Shady Agent Shades
sourceFields.str_version_22: Is it me, or is that UFO following me? Wait... am I the alien?

sourceFields.name: Cardboard Nessie
sourceFields.str_version_22: Some say that the Loch Ness Monster is real. Others, that it's a hoax and was actually a cardboard cut out. We say, Cardboard Nessie for the win!

sourceFields.name: Swamp Monster Onesie
sourceFields.str_version_22: A myth and legend the world over! As old as time itself but even more slimy! Wearing the full suit leaves a mysterious trail of slime behind you!

sourceFields.name: Swamp Monster Head
sourceFields.str_version_22: A myth and legend the world over! As old as time itself but even more slimy! Wearing the full suit leaves a mysterious trail of slime behind you!

sourceFields.name: Mini Minokawa
sourceFields.str_version_22: A Mini Minokawa! A mythical, and very much legendary, bird from the Philippines! People believed the creature was so big that it ate the sun and caused eclipses. This one isn't so big but it's still pretty cool!

sourceFields.name: Wax Jacket
sourceFields.str_version_22: The perfect jacket for taking a stroll in the country. Either yomping over dale with your trusty companion or atop a hill surveying your land, this is the look for you.

sourceFields.name: Feathered Pauldrons
sourceFields.str_version_22: An ornate set of pauldrons adorned with feathers and emblazoned with a ruby in the center. Chosen by Atatip, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for February, 2021!

sourceFields.name: Steampunk Arm
sourceFields.str_version_22: Turn the hands of time with this hand of time.

sourceFields.name: Grow X Rocket Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Take off on a mission to Mars, or wherever your imagination takes you! These rocket wings use the latest in renewable energy, are kind to the environment, and approved for commercial space flight!

sourceFields.name: Easter Jeepney
sourceFields.str_version_22: This popular form of public transport has been given an Easter makeover! All aboard for adventure! Disclaimer... this only actually carries one person but hey it's you, so, you win!

sourceFields.name: Bunny Ear Magnifying Glass
sourceFields.str_version_22: A little bit of detective noir given the Growtopia treatment! Perfect for solving crimes and finding eggs! Careful where you point it as those sun rays are hot!

sourceFields.name: Lil Growpeep's Baaaa Blaster
sourceFields.str_version_22: The latest in undercover sheep herding technology! The latest innovation from Growtech. The culmination of decades of research in safe sheep propulsion! No sheep are harmed in the use of this item!

sourceFields.name: Bloom Aura
sourceFields.str_version_22: Celebrate spring in style, with this blooming good aura!

sourceFields.name: Home Made Butter Lamb
sourceFields.str_version_22: When your expectations don't quite match your skill level... but all the cuter for it! Be proud of the things you've achieved.

sourceFields.name: Sheep Hood
sourceFields.str_version_22: If you've been wishing for a sheep hood, then you're in luck, as this is a sheep hood! Perfect when combined with a Sheep Onesie!

sourceFields.name: Sheep Onesie
sourceFields.str_version_22: A real wool onesie, probably really warm but thats the price you pay for the chic sheep look you're rocking when you wear it.

sourceFields.name: One Winged Angel
sourceFields.str_version_22: This single wing is a symbol for all those who strive to overcome adversity, no matter what the odds. To avoid refund fraud, this item has been made untradeable until August 25th, 2021.

sourceFields.name: Golden Leprechaun Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: You've taken the Leprechaun look up to maximum level! This golden hat, when worn with the Golden Leprechaun Suit item, will give a chance at receiving an extra bonus item when you kiss the Blarney Stone.

sourceFields.name: Golden Leprechaun Suit
sourceFields.str_version_22: You've taken the Leprechaun look up to maximum level! This golden suit, when worn with the Golden Leprechaun Hat item, will give a chance at receiving an extra bonus item when you kiss the Blarney Stone.

sourceFields.name: Helping Hand
sourceFields.str_version_22: Nobody knows how or why this helpful little hand does what it does but for some reason its grown a liking for you. It will help in every way possible with a helpful serving of attitude on the side.

sourceFields.name: Easter Witches Hood
sourceFields.str_version_22: Celebrate Easter the Finnish Way! Virvon, Varvon, for a fresh and healthy coming year!

sourceFields.name: Easter Witches Cape
sourceFields.str_version_22: Celebrate Easter the Finnish Way! Virvon, Varvon, for a fresh and healthy coming year!

sourceFields.name: Field Medics Mecha Med Scarf
sourceFields.str_version_22: Not sure if this concoction is fully approved, but it sure increases your recovery speed!

sourceFields.name: Care Pear
sourceFields.str_version_22: This little guy just wants a hug!

sourceFields.name: Giving Growaxe
sourceFields.str_version_22: Display your generosity for all to see while you earn those big gems!

sourceFields.name: Backwards Ballcap
sourceFields.str_version_22: Wear you cap backwards! All the cool kids are doing it.

sourceFields.name: Grow4Good Ambassador's Sash of Honor
sourceFields.str_version_22: A great honor, bestowed on the leading Grow4Good Ambassador's!

sourceFields.name: Dashing Dolphin Hat
sourceFields.str_version_22: A Dolphin which keeps your head warm and looks cute. Chosen by ALEXALORE, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for March, 2021!

sourceFields.name: Cactus Cannon
sourceFields.str_version_22: A cactoid cannon! Probably best to use this with some very thick gloves otherwise you might end up covered in spiky cactus spines!

sourceFields.name: Sombrero Assault

sourceFields.name: Cooking Recipe - Homemade Fish Taco
sourceFields.str_version_22: To cook this recipe you will need the following:<CR><CR>Ingredients:<CR>   - Tomato<CR>   - Onion<CR>   - Dough<CR>   - Fish Chunk<CR>   - Lettuce<CR><CR>Seasoning:<CR>   - Salt<CR>   - Pepper<CR><CR>Process:<CR>Add Tomato, Onion, and Dough to an oven on Low heat. While the Dough is still hot, add Fish Chunk. Add the seasonings and wait until cooked all the way through. When fully cooked, add Lettuce and immediately remove from the oven.<CR><CR>Timings may vary so you will need to experiment.

sourceFields.name: Cooking Recipe - Apple Strudel
sourceFields.str_version_22: To cook this recipe you will need the following:<CR><CR>Ingredients:<CR>   - Honey<CR>   - Apple<CR>   - Dough<CR>   - Egg<CR><CR>Seasoning:<CR>   - Sugar<CR>   - Sugar<CR>   - Salt<CR><CR>Process:<CR>Add Honey and Apple to an oven on Low heat. While the Apple is still cold, add Dough and Egg. Add the seasonings and wait until cooked all the way through. Remove from the oven when perfectly cooked.<CR><CR>Timings may vary so you will need to experiment.

sourceFields.name: Cooking Recipe - Berry Crepes
sourceFields.str_version_22: To cook this recipe you will need the following:<CR><CR>Ingredients:<CR>   - Flour<CR>   - Egg<CR>   - Milk<CR>   - Blueberry<CR><CR>Seasoning<CR>   - Sugar<CR>   - Sugar<CR><CR>Process:<CR>Add Flour and Egg to an oven on Low heat. While the Egg is still cold, add Milk. When the Egg is mostly cooked, add Blueberry. Add the seasonings and wait until cooked all the way through. Remove from the oven when perfectly cooked.<CR><CR>Timings may vary so you will need to experiment.

sourceFields.name: Cooking Recipe - BBQ Bacon Burger
sourceFields.str_version_22: To cook this recipe you will need the following:<CR><CR>Ingredients:<CR>   - Ground Beef<CR>   - Baking Chocolate<CR>   - Dough<CR>   - Bacon<CR>   - Tomato<CR>   - Lettuce<CR><CR>Seasoning:<CR>   - Salt<CR>   - Pepper<CR>   - Sugar<CR><CR>Process:<CR>Add Ground Beef to an oven on Low heat. When fully cooked, add Lettuce and immediately remove from the oven.<CR><CR>Timings may vary so you will need to experiment.

sourceFields.name: Immortal Swordfish Sword
sourceFields.str_version_22: If you're angling for a sharp pointy fish to use as a sword, then, this is the one for you! The only thing mightier than the Penfish is the Immortal Swordfish! To avoid refund fraud, this item has been made untradeable until 1st November, 2026.

sourceFields.name: Immortal Da Vinci Wings
sourceFields.str_version_22: Da Vinci actually thought he could become immortal and fly with these. He was totally wrong - they only let you double jump and glide... it did immortalize him in history though. To avoid refund fraud, this item has been made untradeable until 1st November, 2026.

sourceFields.name: Immortal Alaskan King Crab Crown

sourceFields.name: Super Scouter

sourceFields.name: Divine Astras

sourceFields.name: Immortal Night Vision Goggles
